news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 9 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 9 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below madrid cincinnati bengals 34 atlanta falcons 17 early window denver broncos 26 carolina panthers 21 dallas cowboys 27 indianapolis colts 23 kansas city chiefs 35 new york jets 12 detroit lions 19 miami dolphins 9 new orleans saints 23 cleveland browns 22 ot new york giants 19 philadelphia eagles 11 los angeles rams 20 washington commanders 13 late window houston texans 44 los angeles chargers 22 san francisco 49ers 38 las vegas raiders 17 green bay packers 45 new england patriots 27 seattle seahawks 17 arizona cardinals 3 sunday night chicago bears 27 tampa bay buccaneers 24 jeremy bergman s takeaways cincy s stars sizzle in espana few teams have had better 10 quarter stretches than the bengals over the past three weeks since being shut out in the first half against baltimore in week 7 cincinnati has responded with 112 points over two and a half games leading the way is joe burrow staking a strong claim in the mvp race burrow was lethal again on sunday in the first half leading cincy s offense to four scoring drives on 9 3 yards per play and completing 82 of his passes for 239 yards eight of those completions went to ja 39 marr chase who set a career high with 142 yards in the first half finishing with 155 and a score on 10 catches showcasing his dynamic ability on an international stage for the first time tee higgins boxed out c j henderson and atlanta s defensive backs for two tds even chase brown season high 6 3 ypc and cincinnati s anemic run game season best 123 yards showed some explosion after sunday s romp cincinnati has now won four straight games with at least 30 points scored for the first time in franchise history if the bengals are capable of this type of production weekly do they even need to swing big for a piece possibly at running back at the trade deadline that s a question for tuesday maybe atlanta will have an answer for cincy s offensive onslaught by then another big bijan day undone by atlanta errors a week after losing to a tampa team that didn t complete a pass the falcons found a more traditional way to fall sunday morning play leaky defense commit penalties repeat in pristine climate controlled conditions inside madrid s bernabeu there were no excuses for atlanta s performance first the positives michael penix threw three fewer interceptions than he did a week prior and scrambled for a career high 50 yards looking svelte and nimble on the spanish pitch bijan robinson who loves an exclusive window rushed for 100 again totaling 147 yards from scrimmage and one td on the day the elusive dynamo was right at home at the home of real madrid s galacticos but jeff ulbrich s defense was a sieve against the nfl s hottest attack allowing 7 1 yards per play and forcing just two punts on the day atlanta also committed 12 accepted penalties for 88 yards repeatedly setting back the offense the falcons o line committed two fouls in the red zone on their second drive leading to the first field goal of a touchdown fight its most critical error though came at the start of the fourth quarter when down two tds at the bengals 10 yard line atlanta was called for offensive holding on a third and 2 incompletion cincy accepted the penalty and forced a fourth and 12 settling for cutting a two score lead to a two score lead nick folk instead shanked a 38 yard field goal and the bengals lead held at 14 the falcons never got closer a tale of two divisions despite the result cincinnati and atlanta will both return to the states tied in the win column for leads in their respective divisions the bengals victory moved them into a 6 2 tie atop the afc north with the steelers setting up a critical sunday night football showdown on the banks of the ohio river in week 10 having already lost this season to pittsburgh the bengals need a home win against aaron rodgers and co to improve their division record and ensure no favor in the head to head tiebreaker down in the cursed nfc south the falcons at 3 6 are nowhere near out of it but are at risk of falling behind hotter clubs after sunday s slate atlanta is essentially tied with carolina 3 5 new orleans 3 5 and tampa bay 3 6 a needed bye awaits for the falcons after a week 10 matchup with patrick mahomes chiefs next gen stats insight for bengals falcons via nfl pro joe burrow was pressured on nine of 32 dropbacks 28 1 against the falcons completing 20 of 23 passes for 237 yards and two touchdowns when kept clean his time to pressure of 3 26 seconds was the longest of his career and the falcons defense had just one quick pressure in the game nfl research joe burrow and ja marr chase connected for their 19th touchdown of at least 40 yards in sunday s win tied with joe montana and jerry rice for the third most by any qb receiver duo since 1980 the only duos with more are peyton manning and marvin harrison 21 tds and steve young and jerry rice 20 tds their first quarter touchdown was the 58th score by the duo overall including playoffs which passed daunte culpepper and randy moss for second most by any qb receiver duo before age 30 trailing only dan marino and mark clayton 68 tds back to top nick shook s takeaways broncos win a game of runs it wasn t quite an avalanche but as is often the case in basketball sunday s game became a tale of runs what began as a one sided contest in favor of denver reversed course just before halftime sunday when the panthers turned an interception into a scoring possession to claw back into the competition that shift in momentum saw bryce young enter a flow state dotting the field with precise confident passes and leading a second scoring drive to double up between halves and put the panthers in a 14 13 lead he appeared poised to extend that lead in the fourth too but a wacky interception snagged by denver safety devon key stopped the panthers in their tracks and swung momentum back in favor of the broncos who rattled off two straight touchdown drives to take a 26 14 lead in the final period good for their latest fourth quarter comeback effort denver had to hang on for dear life in the final minutes after carolina mounted one final push and it s not exactly a resounding victory but it s the latest example of a contending team finding a way to win a back and forth contest by coming through in the most important moments and finishing in a style that fits the team s strengths with edge rusher nik bonitto strip sacking young to stop the panthers final drive in its tracks bo nix looked more like the passer we ve known him to be too a small but encouraging sign as the calendar creeps toward thanksgiving panthers defensive changes fail to produce improvement defensive coordinator ejiro evero became the fall guy when coach dave canales relieved him of his duties following carolina s week 8 loss to green bay installing an interim dc with the hopes it might improve the panthers inconsistent defense in short it didn t the panthers allowed denver to break 300 yards of total offense and mount two touchdown drives that appeared vastly different but produced the same result the first fourth quarter scoring march covered 80 yards over 14 plays while the other needed just six plays to gain 61 yards and finish with a wide open touchdown pass to pat bryant as a result of a blown coverage a symptom of a defense that is still scrambling to take care of the details carolina stood tall late buying its offense a chance to compile a game winning drive but the earlier breakdowns represent a persistent issue had cornerback corey thornton not made an incredibly athletic play on the ball to pick off nix this game might have snowballed out of control in the first half long before the panthers offense was able to climb back into the game had jaylen waddle not exited due to a head injury denver might have continued to rely on the playmaker to break open for big gains this unit was never going to be completely fixed in one week but sunday told us there s still plenty to correct nix begins to break out of his shell it didn t last throughout the entire game but seemingly for the first time in ages bo nix took the training wheels off his own bicycle and let himself play a bit more instinctively proof existed in his decisions made while rolling out in which nix twice opted to throw back against his body to open targets underneath instead of accepting a small scramble gain or throwing it away his bullet ripped through traffic to courtland sutton for a touchdown was another encouraging sign because he was willing to take a minor risk and when bryant streaked open through the carolina secondary nix didn t hesitate to put the ball on him for a score the results are evident in his stat line 25 of 37 237 yards two touchdowns one interception it s not a massive change in performance but it s a start broncos fans have been yearning to see for weeks we ll see if it s a sign of things to come next gen stats insight for broncos panthers via nfl pro bo nix posted a 124 2 passer rating against single high coverage 20 of 26 for 202 yards and two touchdowns but a 15 3 passer rating against split safety coverage 5 of 11 for 35 yards and an interception his 15 3 passer rating against split safety looks was his lowest in a game since his nfl debut in week 1 2024 nfl research the broncos won 26 21 in week 9 against the panthers after trailing by one point entering the fourth quarter their fifth win of the season after trailing at any point in the fourth that is tied with the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings for the most wins after trailing in the fourth quarter in a team s first nine games of a season since 2000 both the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings lost their first playoff game that season in the wild card round back to top kevin patra s takeaways cowboys survive collapse to secure a much needed win over colts brian schottenheimer s squad tried to give the game away luckily the cowboys opponent did a better job dallas built a 10 point lead deep into the third quarter mistakes then gave indianapolis life ceedee lamb fumbled late the cowboys second turnover of the day to wipe out a chance to put the game away despite putting up stats with george pickens out lamb had a mistake filled day in addition to the fumble he was called for offensive pass interference twice and couldn t toe tap a td that cost the cowboys four points in the red zone dallas couldn t get out of its own way for much of the contest dak prescott was far more off the mark than we re used to leading to stalled drives schotty s club was called for 14 penalties for a whopping 153 yards turned the ball over twice and missed a late go ahead field goal that s how you let an opponent amid a fire sale stay in a game despite being outgained 508 271 dallas should have run away with the game instead it trailed late until ryan flournoy the best no 3 wr in the league made a massive play for a 46 yard gain to set up the game winning td a loss would have all but doomed the cowboys who still have a big hill to climb in the nfc east colts offense can t kick it into gear until late facing a bad cowboys defense daniel jones and co couldn t take advantage for long stretches indy went three and out five times including on four of its first five drives the other was a 19 yard td drive following a dak prescott fumble jones was inconsistent and often off the mark completing 20 of 34 passes for 180 yards with a td and an interception the cowboys d entered the game allowing a league high 385 4 yards per game and 5 9 yards per play 29th indy generated just 271 yards and 4 6 yards per play while going 3 for 13 on third down ashton dulin s 55 yard catch and run td was indy s only pass play longer than 16 yards jones averaged 2 6 air yards per completion in the game third fewest of his career minimum 10 completions per next gen stats against a dallas d that s been ripped up jones needed to do more the rushing attack did some solid work generating 105 total yards on the ground with seth mcgowan earning 7 5 yards per carry on six totes with a td if sunday was jonathan taylor s final game in indy mcgowan flashed some upside to take over the bulk of the workload downs calls game when javonte williams scored the go ahead touchdown with a little over a minute remaining the big question was whether a sieve dallas d could hold on caleb downs ensured it would by stepping in front of a daniel jones pass sealing the win over his brother josh downs squad the int capped a game in which downs generated a sack three tackles a qb hit a tackle for loss and two passes defensed allowing just one reception on four targets sunday marked the first time all season that the cowboys defense allowed fewer than 318 total yards doing so against a team that s begun a mid season teardown is one thing the cowboys will have a stiffer test against kyle shanahan and the 49ers in week 10 next gen stats insight for cowboys colts via nfl pro ceedee lamb caught six of 12 targets for 180 yards and a touchdown on downfield throws 10 plus air yards in week 9 against the colts the most receiving yards he has recorded on downfield throws in his career nfl research sunday marked dak prescott s first game with 300 plus passing yards multiple passing touchdowns no interceptions and a game winning drive since 2018 in a week 17 win against the giants prescott had one such game in each of his first three career seasons but none from 2019 2025 back to top bobby kownack s takeaways k9 scores touchdowns kenneth walker s reign of terror over the rest of the league took a couple weeks break as the running back was held to 105 rushing yards and no touchdowns over the previous two contests after torching opponents for 665 rushing yards and eight total scores in his first five outings as a chief unfortunately for the jets his dominance s brief hiatus ended sunday walker was a man on a mission versus gang green almost singlehandedly keeping kansas city afloat amid a slow start that included two fumbles a three and out and a missed field goal over the opening two quarters kansas city s other two first half drives ended a bit differently on 7 and 25 yard touchdown receptions by walker he provided the offensive spark while patrick mahomes worked to piece together a consistent passing game using anyone else and after the rest of the operation caught up to walker s heroics to start pulling away from the jets he added a 2 yard td run in the third quarter walker finished with 102 rushing yards a 5 7 per carry average and four runs of 10 plus yards as well as four catches for 41 yards that s after he was able to take a rest midway through the fourth quarter due to a blowout he helped create he now has five games with multiple scrimmage touchdowns the most in the nfl this season and the most by a chiefs running back since larry johnson eight in 2005 wilson is sorely missed by jets there was a lot of intrigue surrounding new york s offense heading into week 9 how would the jets mix breece hallback into the rotation after braelon allen excelled to such a degree during the starter s four game absence how would the passing offense operate without garrett wilson after omar cooper and adonai mitchell recently took turns breaking out for new york as far as the running backs hall saw 18 touches to allen s 10 with hall turning his into 87 yards and allen totaling 54 both running backs averaged 4 1 yards per carry as for the passing offense it was ugly wilson had appeared frustrated in recent weeks as he produced smaller numbers than his counterparts hauling in 12 catches for 153 yards without a score over his previous three games before sustaining a concussion but it s clear he makes the offense go without the star there to demand attention from kansas city s secondary the chiefs had little problem shutting down geno smith smith threw for only 165 yards cooper led the way with 58 yards on eight receptions while mitchell went from 142 yards on seven catches last week to zero catches on seven looks a game later new york got nothing going settling for four field goals in the first half tied for the most over the last 10 seasons in the second half the jets didn t even get the opportunity to settle smith and co managed 58 yards over five drives on the other side of intermission forced to watch their two point halftime deficit unravel into a 23 point loss chiefs come alive for much needed blowout kansas city rode a two game losing streak into week 9 with a 22 fourth quarter point differential that ranked 31st in the league over the past two games if there s one thing patrick mahomes is going to do though it s beat up on bad teams by defeating the jets he moved to 18 0 in his career against teams entering a matchup four plus games under 500 the best by any quarterback since 1970 minimum 15 starts per nfl research he went 23 of 31 for 242 yards and two touchdowns with a 117 9 passer rating but most importantly seemed ok after a strip sack by david bailey late in the second quarter bent his elbow awkwardly and forced him to receive medical attention on the sideline he returned and overcame a frustrating offensive stupor to blow the doors off the jets while the chiefs defense minimized damage early and inflicted plenty of it throughout kansas city pressured geno smith on half of his dropbacks chris jones and george karlaftis led the team with six pressures and two sacks apiece while drue tranquill logged 13 tackles and nick bolton had 12 plus a forced fumble detractors will point out it s only the jets and there are still some issues to work out think harrison butker missing a 56 yard field goal and the subsequent 51 yarder after getting a reprieve due to an offsides penalty just before half but the chiefs can only play who is in front of them in this case they demolished them next gen stats insight for jets chiefs via nfl pro travis kelce caught four of six targets for 72 yards accounting for two of the chiefs five explosive passes 40 0 nfl research kenneth walker had his first career game with multiple receiving touchdowns to go along with a rushing touchdown in the chiefs win over the jets his second career game with three touchdowns back to top bobby kownack s takeaways usual suspects lift detroit to tightly contested win sunday s victory over miami was not your typical lions affair jared goff and the offense took forever to get going and it seemed as if they knew things weren t quite clicking the lions pulled out all the stops against their one win opponent they went for it on fourth down on the first drive a few plays later jahmyr gibbs took a direct snap and faked a pitch to goff before streaking around the edge for 16 yards two plays into the second quarter detroit converted a fake punt throw by jack fox on fourth and 7 from its own 30 the lions constantly stalled out failing to score a touchdown until 1 20 remained in the third quarter and that was a run by gibbs on fourth down too luckily they had a couple stars to lean on to help guide them through their struggles amon ra st brown was the main source of the team s passing offense deep into the final frame at the start of the lions seventh drive of the game he had seven catches while the rest of detroit s pass catchers had combined for six st brown drew a third down pass interference penalty early on that possession and a few plays later hauled in a key 17 yard catch on third and 8 to keep the chains moving with a perilous seven point lead he eventually finished with 86 yards on eight receptions every other lion combined for 10 catches and 95 yards and though gibbs was frequently met by a pod of dolphins in the backfield he still broke off a number of clutch gainers including the aforementioned 8 yard td run he finished with a game high 74 rushing yards that was about it for offensive highlights but it was enough miami wastes strong defensive performance jeff hafley s defense fought valiantly against the league s no 3 scoring offense if only the rest of the team had been able to repay the group s efforts the dolphins consistently crashed into detroit s backfield to locate jahmyr gibbs containing the electric back who had been averaging 4 9 yards per carry entering week 9 to 3 7 yards per attempt on 20 rushes jared goff struggled to find and hit open passers throwing for a season low 170 yards he was sacked three times and tossed just his second pick of the season to rookie corner chris johnson after josh uche hit his arm during the throwing motion the dolphins didn t bend to the point of allowing a touchdown the only one of the game until the waning minutes of the third quarter malik willis and the offense could do nothing with their opportunities however willis threw for only 128 yards and an interception and seemed hesitant to open it up on the ground two carries for 7 yards while ollie gordon was held to 55 rushing yards when the fins had a chance to make it a tie game heading into halftime they instead committed a holding penalty and missed a 38 yard field goal on the final two plays of the second quarter toward the start of the fourth quarter down 10 with the ball at detroit s 7 yard line willis took two sacks over the next three plays before miami settled for a three points gut wrenching mistakes are no way to beat a contender like the lions and the dolphins certainly made their share of them ugly game all around one of the biggest concerns for any 5 2 team traveling to face a 1 6 opponent is typically avoiding playing down to the lesser squad s level the lions absolutely joined the dolphins in the doldrums for a messy matchup that will have neither side coming away feeling particularly happy the lions and dolphins combined for 20 accepted penalties with detroit committing nine to miami s 11 they went 7 for 24 on third down collectively detroit managed only 270 yards nearly 100 fewer than its previous low on the season 355 miami posted its second lowest yardage total of the year with 228 thanks to the offensive ineptitude a few of the most exciting plays of the matchup were actually fake punts both teams ran one and both teams converted on passes one by lions punter jack fox and another by dolphins punter bradley pinion it was the first time since at least 1950 that multiple punters have completed a pass in the same game per nfl research give credit to the lions defense for showing up and making life miserable for the dolphins but detroit didn t exactly put an exclamation point on this one despite running its winning streak to four next gen stats insight for lions dolphins via nfl pro aidan hutchinson matched up against austin jackson 16 times in week 9 all one on one recording six pressures 37 5 pressure rate including two quick pressures under 2 5 seconds nfl research jahmyr gibbs recorded his 60th career touchdown tying hall of famer ladainian tomlinson for the second most by any player in their first four seasons in nfl history trailing only hall of famer terrell davis with 61 back to top nick shook s takeaways saints come alive to earn much needed win by all accounts sunday was an ugly display of football between two middling teams for most of the afternoon a field goal fest including a charlie smyth first half miss set up for what appeared to be a likely 9 6 finish until the browns finally hit a big play for a touchdown when shedeur sanders connected with rookie kc concepcion for a 64 yard passing touchdown the score seemed to position the browns for another fourth quarter comeback win but instead it awoke the saints with just enough time for chaos to ensue new orleans covered 55 yards in six plays and 50 seconds to take a 16 13 lead allowed the browns to tie the game with 0 08 left then embarked on an efficient relentless 74 yard scoring drive that required 11 plays and ended with a pretty touchdown pass from tyler shough to juwan johnson for a 23 16 lead in overtime the stop of cleveland s two point try in overtime sealed the win but it was only made possible by some late success that must have felt for saints fans like the thawing of an offense that spent far too long frozen within a glacier at 3 5 the saints are back in the thick of a race for an nfc south crown that might only require nine wins to secure if they re going to get there sunday s late push toward a victory was essential browns show clear weaknesses in brutal defeat cleveland has lost its ability to stop the run since losing maliek collins to injury and delivered an embarrassing effort against the saints low ceiling rushing attack sunday allowing audric estim 233 who was a member of the browns less than a month ago tyler shough and alvin kamara to run for 155 yards on 31 attempts pacing an offense that came to life thanks to this newfound balance in the second half even worse cleveland s pass coverage unit struggled losing one on one matchups all afternoon grant delpit ronnie hickman and tyson campbell each struggled in such matchups and especially in the game s most crucial moments e g juwan johnson s overtime touchdown and a 33 yard completion from shough to chris olave late in the fourth quarter paired with an offense that wasn t threatening for most of the afternoon with sanders at quarterback cleveland was guaranteed to be locked in a four quarter battle with a team most expected it to defeat without a major struggle instead the browns fell in a fashion that is a strong competitor with their week 1 blowout loss to jacksonville for worst defeat of the season that s not a good place to be in in week 9 shough finds his stride new orleans offense has lacked juice for some time now draining the saints of their early season optimism that was tied to the trajectory of tyler shough in his second nfl season that finally changed in the fourth quarter sunday when cleveland stunned the superdome crowd with an explosive touchdown pass from shedeur sanders to kc concepcion new orleans offense woke up stringing together well designed passing plays with a rushing attack that finally showed some life to move down the field with relative ease against a browns defense that had limited it all afternoon shough was at the center of all of it calmly dropping dimes on chris olave juwan johnson and even rookie jordyn tyson to propel the offense to two clutch touchdown drives in a wild fourth quarter and overtime period we saw the return of a composed accurate shough whose clutch gene reappeared after going into hiding over the last month the timing couldn t be better for this saints team which will be in a weekly fight for survival in an nfc south that remains wide open there s no guarantee their rushing success carries over but getting shough back on track was a massively important development for coach kellen moore who was able to demonstrate some of his expertise in how he drive touchdown drought dating back to week 5 against denver injuries penalties turnovers it all added up to another lopsided loss the team s eighth of the year offensive coordinator mike mcdaniel tried something new sunday calling plays from the box instead of the sideline the first time doing so since 2021 his lone season as 49ers oc but to no avail the unit which was without no 1 receiver had to be pleased with the texans defensive effort sunday save for that 58 yard chargers garbage time touchdown that snapped l a s td drought his unit relentlessly pressured justin herbert all game sure anyone is going to overtake current favorite josh allen in the mvp race this season but as i predicted he would jordan love planted his flag firmly in the conversation with his performance on lot of heat with the patriots pressuring him on 13 of his 33 dropbacks 39 4 it didn t matter love was locked in and dropping dimes to christian watson and matthew golden making a talented new england secondary look silly at times watson finished with a career high 171 receiving yards on seven catches while golden led the team with 10 grabs for a career high 164 yards the packers were the underdogs entering sunday s game but matt lafleur s crew controlled the contest from start to finish with its 1 2 start to the season feeling like a distant memory green bay gets a rematch at home against the nfc north leading vikings next week one storyline to follow leading up to that battle will be the status of running back josh jacobs who suffered a fractured finger on sunday maye s turnovers too much for patriots to overcome progress isn t always linear and sunday offered pats fans a stark reminder of that fact after drake maye shook off a turnover plagued start to the season to compile a touchdown to interception ratio of 11 1 in his previous four games sunday marked a step back for the third year qb he threw three interceptions in the first half and was lucky to avoid a fourth on a to a banged up offensive line on sunday too it s all far from ideal for a team with playoff aspirations after winning the afc title last season now the patriots will go overseas for a munich matchup with the lions who have won four games in a row packers defense has something special brewing green bay s offense deserves plenty of praise for its performance but we should not overlook the team s defensive showing yes the packers gave up 27 points but the patriots two second half touchdowns were scored in garbage time when the game was out of hand jonathan gannon s defense had drake maye out of sorts from the jump finishing with four sacks and four takeaways all three of maye s ints ended up in the hands of safeties with xavier mckinney picking him off twice and evan williams snagging one on a deflection maye was pressured on 51 2 of his dropbacks the highest pressure rate he has faced in a regular season game just below the 52 8 he faced in the super bowl against the seahawks per next s triumphs this season it wasn t a performance that will take any heat off embattled offensive coordinator brian fleury but the win will quiet critics for the next week and a 5 4 record looks better than a 500 mark at this stage it was also equally important for seattle to keep pace in an nfc west that now features three teams above 500 minshew magic runs out gardner minshew s insertion into the lineup sparked a frantic comeback effort in a thrilling win over dallas in week 8 clearing the way for minshew to take over as starter for arizona to trade jacoby brissett to baltimore and for the cardinals to proceed with another veteran who seemed to have a better rapport with his targets and a higher willingness to take calculated risks in order to jump start the offense that gave cardinals fans reason to believe mike lafleur s offense might finally produce a quality day offensively even against one of the nfl s best defenses instead arizona encountered a familiar experience in its rematch with seattle struggling to generate offense and falling well short of competing with the seahawks in a loss that truly wasn t as close as the score suggested making matters worse was a hit minshew took to his right arm while throwing which seemed to sap him of the arm strength necessary to find open targets in the second half even when arizona flirted with another fourth quarter comeback minshew and the cardinals offense ran aground inside seattle s 10 extinguishing their fading hope of climbing back into the game and reminding arizona of the uphill battle it will face in arrival and instant success proved to be unreliable dropping the cardinals to 3 6 in a season that s likely already starting to look toward april charbonnet shows some juice zach charbonnet the other kept him out until his midseason arrival but with the seahawks desperate for ground game consistency they could use a notable contribution from the power back and finally received one sunday charbonnet rushed 16 times for 77 yards made a handful of defenders miss broke some tackles and looked much more like the runner he was in previous seasons bringing a welcome level of balance to an offense that already relied too heavily on sam darnold and was expected to do the same with backup drew lock jadarian price flashed in the passing game too making a fantastic sideline catch as part of his four receptions for 54 yards it s far from a guarantee that they ve suddenly rediscovered their ability to run the ball opponent must be considered in these small sample sizes but at least it s an gone limp on the hit that forced him to drop possession and suffered a concussion chicago s defense was truly the catalyst for the victory but it wouldn t be possible without williams brilliance early and his final drive dramatics ahead of this one the bears were getting crowned as the new super bowl darlings nothing comes easy in the nfl though and if chicago is to fulfill some high expectations williams must recover get his swagger back and be able to balance it without making the never before seen errors he did on a night in which he and his bears escaped with a w bucky defense have bucs flirting with comeback nine minutes into sunday s proceedings the buccaneers were down 14 points the bears running roughshod on both sides of the ball somehow someway tampa bay made a game of this and astonishing and the bears defense allowing the buccaneers to score just 10 points off those turnovers is the biggest reason why next gen stats insight for buccaneers bears via nfl pro the buccaneers news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints and tampa bay buccaneers catch up on each nfc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints tampa bay buccaneers three key storylines 1 stefanski era begins despite a strong finish to the 2025 season the falcons dismissed raheem morris in january and replaced him with another recently fired head man in kevin stefanski shifting the organizational focus from a defensive minded coach to one with extensive experience on the other side of the ball amid the coaching change stefanski wisely chose to retain defensive coordinator jeff ulbrich attempting to maintain a sense of continuity for a unit that was the team s strength last year now the responsibility of pushing the falcons out of the 500 range falls on the shoulders of stefanski a coach with a point to prove after being unceremoniously dumped by the browns he s had success two playoff appearances a postseason win and two coach of the year awards but nothing would be sweeter to stefanski than immediately leading atlanta to the playoffs in his first season at the helm he ll need to produce results fairly quickly too given the falcons expectation of competing after consecutive 8 9 finishes 2 all eyes on the quarterbacks much of stefanski s first year success will depend on the quarterback situation tua tagovailoa hopped on board after he was cut by the dolphins bringing experience to a room that could use it while also providing the falcons with a second left handed quarterback tagovailoa might need to handle the starting duties early in the season too depending on how quickly michael penix can return from the season ending knee injury suffered in 2025 that dynamic could create its own intrigue or perhaps controversy if tagovailoa excels the fit makes sense too stefanski s wide zone rushing attack has traditionally paired with a timing based passing game the scheme that best matches tagovailoa s strengths with two options under center an optimist will say the falcons are in an advantageous position others will note two options usually means no answer at quarterback that is unless penix returns and gets back on track atlanta s former top 10 pick still needs to prove he s worth that draft status and year 3 is typically the pivotal season his progress or lack thereof will heavily influence the trajectory of this team in 2026 3 ulbrich s new look defense atlanta s defense has its work cut out the 2025 falcons improved to 15th in yards allowed per game and 19th in scoring d while finishing second in sacks numbers that suggest there s reason to feel encouraged entering 2026 plenty of departures have followed though leading tackler kaden elliss left for new orleans veteran arnold ebiketie departed for philadelphia david onyemata signed with the jets and dee alford joined the bills leading sack artist and 2025 first round pick james pearce returns but his status remains uncertain after he was arrested and subsequently entered a pretrial intervention program to resolve three felony charges during the offseason the nfl has yet to determine pearce s fate in 2026 but if he misses significant time the combined absences could be enough to sink the unit atlanta responded by adding linebacker christian harris and defensive tackle maason smith as projected starters and also signed da 39 shawn hand and samson ebukam as key rotational players preventing ulbrich from returning to an empty cupboard still the challenge exists fortunately atlanta s very strong in the secondary with the safety duo of jessie bates and xavier watts flanked by stout cover man a j terrell and in april the franchise spent a second round pick on a j s brother avieon terrell giving the defensive backfield another versatile piece if nickelback billy bowman can bounce back from an achilles tear that abruptly ended his promising rookie campaign last november the falcons are quite well equipped to handle opposing aerial attacks still following an offseason with notable roster churn the defense will need to jell quickly in order for atlanta to start off on the right foot back to top three key storylines 1 crunch time for young three seasons into his nfl career bryce young hasn t quite produced enough hard evidence to prove he s a franchise quarterback carolina s leadership will suggest otherwise publicly in late april general manager dan morgan said we really feel like the arrow is up with bryce but that sentiment will change quickly if young regresses in year 4 in 2025 he showed signs of blossoming but wasn t consistent in 2026 he needs to become more reliable on a weekly basis an outcome that should be more likely after another offseason spent under coach dave canales if this is young s breakout season the panthers will happily start discussing a long term extension with the former no 1 overall pick but even if they don t say it publicly they still need to be convinced young is headed in such a direction otherwise the fifth year of his deal could spell the beginning of a transition 2 upgrades in key defensive spots the panthers defense received some much needed offseason love it s only right that a former linebacker morgan spent much of his team s resources upgrading that side of the ball after fielding a middling unit in 2025 carolina should be better in the front seven thanks to the additions of edge rusher jaelan phillips signed for a four year 120 million deal linebacker devin lloyd three years 45 million and defensive tackle lee hunter a second round pick who has the potential to become an ideal run stuffing complement to derrick brown it s not a full scale overhaul because carolina didn t need one rather it was a measured reinforcement of a unit that will aim to improve especially in the pass rushing department if young can take a step or two forward and the panthers can evolve into a stronger more balanced team they ll be well positioned to defend their nfc south crown 3 backfield depth backfield questions linger in charlotte where the panthers benefited from a one year deal with rico dowdle in 2025 then watched him walk to pittsburgh in free agency their current running back situation is once again headlined by chuba hubbard who has eclipsed 1 000 yards once in five nfl seasons while averaging 4 1 yards per carry much of this position group depends on whether 2024 second rounder jonathon brooks who has played three games in his first two seasons due to two acl tears can prove he s healthy enough to contribute carolina attempted to build in some insurance by signing veteran aj dillon but his own injury history and minimal usage in philadelphia in 2025 make for an uncertain outlook trevor etienne also returns for his second season after spending most of his rookie snaps on special teams in total the picture appears unsure if not incomplete that can change if brooks contributes but that s a big question mark for a team expecting to contend for a division title back to top three key storylines 1 can shough build on promising finish tyler shough s late season rise inspired an offseason of optimism in the big easy where the saints larger vision became at least partially visible by the end of the 2025 campaign as new orleans closed the year with four wins in its final five games shough emerged as a promising quarterback with the potential to become a franchise signal caller under coach kellen moore perhaps quicker than most anyone expected now with a full offseason as qb1 under his belt shough enters year 2 with heightened expectations at 26 he s already older than the average sophomore starter and is paired with a former quarterback in moore who has demonstrated his ability to guide offenses toward fruitful futures both in dallas and philadelphia now moore is equipped with a quarterback he can mold a passer who appears wiser and more capable than the average second year starter thanks in part to his extensive collegiate experience there s legitimate reason to think the saints have already answered the most challenging question that comes with a rebuild now it s about proving those optimists right by continuing to build on the progress shough made as a rookie 2 new offensive weapons moore has some new toys in his offense upon the start of free agency new orleans quickly scooped up running back travis etienne giving the saints a much needed successor to alvin kamara with a similar three down skill set kamara is still on the roster too providing new orleans with some depth in a room that also includes kendre miller and devin neal the receiver position welcomed a prestigious addition too when the saints followed their hearts and selected arizona state star jordyn tyson at no 8 overall adding to an intriguing receiver room that includes chris olave and devaughn vele as has long been the case in new orleans health will be paramount for this club tyson and olave have a history of missing time due to injury and kamara played in a career low 11 games last season beyond olave tyson and vele the saints lack reliable depth at wr two more rookies bryce lance and barion brown are slated to compete for spots among a group that also includes trey palmer kevin austin and ja 39 lynn polk if they can keep their best healthy the saints could surprise some folks but as we ve learned in recent years that s far from guaranteed 3 jordan s last dance cam jordan is back for one final season after an offseason mostly spent unsigned the saints legend ultimately re upped on a one year deal in june signing up for one last run with the team he s helped define since entering the league as a first round pick back in 2011 with that comes a message to the rest of this ascending squad there s no time to waste jordan and chase young comprised a potent edge rushing duo in 2025 with each hitting double digit sacks with playmakers at all three levels the saints defense is ready to match its ninth place finish from 2025 it ll have a little extra to play for in 2026 too back to top three key storylines 1 mayfield entering pivotal season baker mayfield has enjoyed a career renaissance in florida over the last three seasons earning a three year 100 million deal with the team after a strong 2023 campaign and largely living up to the standards that come with such a contract when viewed from a league wide perspective baker deserves his spot and shouldn t worry about his future in tampa but those who have followed this team closely also understand that mayfield is a streaky player he s electrifying when at his best and can propel the buccaneers toward great success but he also struggles to get out of his own way at times in 2025 mayfield started white hot leading tampa bay to a 6 2 start and pushing the team into the national conversation as a possible super bowl contender then injuries struck sending mayfield into a stretch of struggles that coincided with roster losses elsewhere and resulted in a pile of defeats and a postseason spent at home for the first time since 2022 he finished with fewer than 4 000 passing yards instead of watching his offensive coordinator land a head coaching job elsewhere thanks in part to his successes as dave canales and liam coen had done before his play caller was fired now mayfield enters a contract year with a hard negotiating deadline the start of training camp without his favorite target mike evans who left for san francisco and with fresh questions to answer should things go well mayfield will remain the bucs franchise quarterback for the foreseeable future but if he encounters more struggles it could cost him millions and inspire changes beyond his control that drastically change the landscape in tampa 2 bowles seat is warm near the end of a frustrating somewhat inexplicable collapse in 2025 plenty of folks expected the buccaneers to move on from todd bowles and start fresh with a new coach that didn t happen of course and bowles is back to justify the organization s support in 2026 if the bucs struggle like they did last season with bowles defense finishing 20th in points allowed he ll likely be out of a job and tampa bay will be facing a potentially significant shift in identity for the first time since tom brady arrived in 2020 some thought it s precisely what the buccaneers needed after 2025 and pointed toward evans departure as proof that things weren t right at one buc place the team will have to embark on the new campaign without two franchise legends in evans and linebacker lavonte david who retired after 14 seasons another concerning sign about tampa s trajectory it will be up to bowles to prove the concerns are overblown 3 does tampa have enough on defense to win despite being led by a defensive minded head coach bowles buccaneers became an offense first team over the last few seasons as mayfield powered an explosive attack bowles units proved average at best finishing 23rd 18th and 19th in total yards allowed over the last three seasons the bucs haven t landed inside the top 10 since 2022 bowles first season as head coach entering 2026 the bucs seem to have an assortment of pieces that could form an improved defense the team wisely spent its first round pick on miami edge rusher rueben bain supplying bowles with a legitimate threat at the edge position opposite yaya diaby for the first time since the final few years of shaq barrett s career which ended with a one game campaign in 2024 tampa bay s secondary should benefit from another year of development for benjamin morrison jacob parrish and tykee smith but as of now it remains a unit carried by antoine winfield linebacker includes some questions too after david s retirement free agent addition alex anzalone arrives to great expectations and veteran christian rozeboom also entered the fray furthermore tampa spent its second round pick on lb josiah trotter with bowles in charge this defense could very well exceed expectations it could also determine the team s fate and the security of its coach s employment back to top

news_mentions.headline: AFC North training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bengals, Browns, Ravens, Steelers
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top AFC North training camp storylines to monitor for the Baltimore Ravens, Cincinnati Bengals, Cleveland Browns and Pittsburgh Steelers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the baltimore ravens cincinnati bengals cleveland browns and pittsburgh steelers catch up on each afc north team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below baltimore ravens cincinnati bengals cleveland browns pittsburgh steelers three key storylines 1 minter era begins john harbaugh is gone and in steps rookie head coach jesse minter to replace him baltimore needed a fresh start minter is the face of it but with a fresh start comes uncertainty is minter capable of preparing and directing his team toward the super bowl contention that has become the standard expectation in the charm city will the shift from harbaugh to minter a product of the harbaugh family coaching tree be enough to push the ravens back into the postseason or is the similarity between the two too close to produce meaningful change it s not often a team changes coaches and is still expected to compete for division titles and more but that s where the ravens find themselves and as is always the case with rookie coaches there s plenty of learning ahead for better or worse does this move boost baltimore back to the top of the division or will the ravens suffer another disappointing finish like in 2025 2 new oc for lamar with a new coaching staff in baltimore lamar jackson has a new offensive coordinator declan doyle is only 30 years old and less than a year older than jackson which could produce a deeper level of understanding between coach and quarterback but he s a largely unproven play caller doyle spent his first season as an oc under offensive mastermind ben johnson in chicago meaning he wasn t holding the play sheet now he will be jackson who is embracing the new system will need to adjust quickly and help the new coordinator establish a rapport with him in order to maximize the potential of the offense which returns derrick henry mark andrews zay flowers and rashod bateman among others baltimore must find a replacement for departed tight end isaiah likely but if doyle is anything like the coach he spent 2025 under the new oc should produce positive results even if it takes a bit to get going 3 a restored defense a hidden detail in the ravens 2025 struggles existed in their defense a unit that is traditionally a strength but was a sieve early in the campaign the main reason defensive lineman nnamdi madubuike went down with a serious neck injury exposing a weakness and lack of depth up front that rendered baltimore s d mostly ineffective except for the moments in which safety kyle hamilton played superhero to save the day that s not sustainable and the ravens acted accordingly this offseason signing trey hendrickson to restore a fearsome presence in the pass rushing unit madubuike could return in 2026 too and age defying defensive end calais campbell has rejoined the ravens to give them some much needed depth this is the group that minter will direct and regardless of what happens offensively this unit s performance will determine how far baltimore can go in 2026 back to top three key storylines 1 can defense finally deliver a year after navigating the choppy dramatic waters that came with trey hendrickson s holdout the bengals are in a much better place defensively they invested significantly in that side of the ball adding dt jonathan allen de boye mafe s bryan cook and s kyle dugger in free agency before swinging a major trade for dt dexter lawrence on paper cincinnati has finally upgraded defensively and appears poised to chase a super bowl but we all know depth charts only matter so much the bengals defensive inadequacies have led to great frustration in the midst of a third straight playoff less season last december joe burrow openly wondered about his football future largely because he was exasperated by the frequent challenges and predictable disappointments if the d is fixed there s reason to believe these bengals can return to the postseason and embark on a deep run 2 burrow s health can joe burrow stay healthy for once while most of the blame for this team s recent struggles has been rightfully pinned on the defense burrow s lack of availability has also been a near annual problem last season a toe injury required surgery and knocked him out for nine games sending the bengals into a crisis mode that prompted them to trade for joe flacco by the time burrow returned cincinnati needed to be nearly perfect to rescue its playoff hopes an impossible goal the flawed bengals failed to reach in 2023 a similar story played out when burrow missed cincinnati s final seven games due to a season ending wrist injury as is the case with every nfl franchise the bengals title hopes ride on the quarterback s availability that will continue to be true in 2026 3 taylor under major pressure the pressure is on cincinnati s head coach a defensible case could have been made for zac taylor s dismissal after 2025 instead he emerged as the only returning coach in the afc north entering 2026 this time around the usual excuses don t exist the defense is improved and if burrow stays healthy he has the pieces necessary to produce at an elite clip if cincy doesn t live up to the lofty expectations set by burrow the blame will fall on taylor s shoulders his team must succeed in 2026 there is no alternative three key storylines 1 new era begins under monken after six seasons the browns sent kevin stefanski packing terminating a two time nfl coach of the year who produced cleveland s only playoff win since the browns returned as an expansion franchise in 1999 in the same breath owner jimmy haslam opted to retain general manager andrew berry touting the personnel chief s strong 2025 draft class and strangely the improvement of kicker andre szmyt as justification for keeping him around berry responded by compiling another draft class that has plenty of potential in 2026 and continues to rebuild the franchise after overseeing the worst decision made by a gm in the last 25 years if not longer trading three first round picks for deshaun watson who also received a fully guaranteed 230 million contract berry replaced stefanski with veteran oc todd monken who makes his head coaching debut with a team that still isn t quite stocked for legitimate contention monken s arrival seems to have breathed new life into the young browns but with results pending that s all we know about the monken era as of now the most important lesson we could learn from the browns this year might be how much patience haslam possesses because it s unlikely this team will suddenly become a contender in 2026 it s up to monken to get the most out of his players in his first season at the helm 2 serious qb questions cleveland is revamping its offensive approach which had become rather stale under stefanski with monken in charge and travis switzer serving as a first time coordinator a new scheme can t cover for a lack of reliability at quarterback though the browns appear to be laying the groundwork for watson to emerge from irrelevance and regain the starting job while 2025 fifth round pick shedeur sanders lurks in the shadows how long watson holds on to the reins is another story but unless the 30 year old pulls off a miracle and returns to his houston form browns fans can prepare for another season filled with frustration under center which might play perfectly into a plan to select a top signal caller in 2027 s loaded draft 3 how will defense look without garrett and schwartz myles garrett reset the single season sack record in 2025 which proved to be his final campaign in brown and orange berry took a massive swing when he agreed to a forward thinking trade with the rams sending garrett to los angeles in exchange for young star edge rusher jared verse and a collection of picks that includes the rams 2027 first round selection garrett s departure means the browns lose 23 sacks worth of production from last season plus a persistent concern carried by every opposing offense add in the departure of respected coordinator jim schwartz and suddenly cleveland s defense its better side in the last two challenging seasons harbors plenty of questions fortunately the browns still have some studs on that side of the ball defensive rookie of the year carson schwesinger five time pro bowl corner denzel ward verse and promising sophomore defensive tackle mason graham but they re going to need to prove the personnel is strong enough to overcome a change in sideline leadership back to top three key storylines 1 no guarantees in life post tomlin mike mccarthy is back in the nfl having returned to his beloved hometown of pittsburgh to lead a steelers team that is taking on a much different appearance than usual instead of replacing one longtime coach with a young star the steelers opted for the veteran with super bowl experience in mccarthy a move some interpreted as a ploy to convince aaron rodgers to return for a 22nd nfl season if that was indeed the plan it worked whether it bears fruit however remains to be seen mccarthy s track record of directing explosive offenses should encourage steelers fans who have grown tired of watching low ceiling units struggle to compete so too should the acquisition of veteran receiver michael pittman but much of this feels like it s held together by chicken wire at least as of now pittsburgh s backup options behind rodgers are longtime reserve mason rudolph 2025 sixth round pick will howard and 2026 third rounder drew allar if crisis strikes at qb visions of a playoff victory something the steelers haven t achieved since the 2016 campaign will evaporate ideally the mccarthy rodgers partnership evokes memories of their days in green bay that s far from a guarantee along with the steelers annual assuredness to finish at or above 500 now that mike tomlin has left the coaching ranks for a job in television 2 run game concerns pittsburgh became one of the leaders in the nfl s sudden shift toward tight end reliant sets in 2025 leaning on the likes of darnell washington pat freiermuth jonnu smith and connor heyward to beef up and bulldoze opposing defenses though smith and heyward are no longer on the roster the first round selection of arizona state ot max iheanachor should help the ground game but is the backfield good enough jaylen warren is pittsburgh s lead back while rico dowdle arrives via free agency to give the steelers an explosive weapon capable of posting a few huge days as evidenced by his 389 yard outburst in weeks 5 and 6 for carolina last season kaleb johnson however remains a question mark the iowa product averaged just 2 5 yards per carry on 28 attempts as a rookie and hasn t yet proven he can be counted on as a rugged power back pittsburgh will have the hogs to move defenses and create rushing lanes but it will be up to mccarthy to deploy his personnel properly in order to stay on schedule and remain balanced especially with the largely immobile rodgers in the lineup 3 graham to get d back on track tomlin s departure meant the arrival of a new defensive coordinator and mccarthy selected the experienced patrick graham as his new director pittsburgh s defense is paid well but hasn t lived up to expectations of late finishing 26th in total d under former dc teryl austin in 2025 graham s track record isn t a slam dunk either in his last three stops dolphins giants raiders his defenses have hovered near league average peaking at 12th in 2020 with new york and bottoming out at 30th with miami in 2019 to his credit graham found some consistency amid dysfunction in las vegas over the last three seasons guiding the raiders to two 15th place finishes in 2023 and 24 before improving slightly to 14th but 25th in scoring d in 2025 he ll have better talent in pittsburgh which means the true test of his expertise should arrive in 2026 luckily he s working under a coach with a reputation for leading potent offenses if graham can prove himself to be a worthy dc then the steelers might actually be in business back to top

news_mentions.headline: New Orleans Saints training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Michael Baca provides a refresher on the New Orleans Saints' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams michael baca has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc south catch up on the new orleans saints offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 22 rookies veterans location ochsner sports performance center metairie louisiana fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at los angeles chargers 4 05 p m et nfl network on sunday aug 10 week 2 vs jacksonville jaguars 1 p m et nfl network on sunday aug 17 week 3 vs denver broncos 1 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note the saints are one of just three teams browns titans that do not have a prime time game on their schedule nfl research what you need to know 1 kellen moore s undertaking as head coach highlights the immense change happening in new orleans and how the saints adapt to a long overdue overhaul is at the forefront of everyone s mind entering 2025 coming off a super bowl winning season as the eagles offensive coordinator moore brings expertise on offense and a philosophy switch that has been yearned for in the big easy after former defensive coordinator dennis allen followed the sean payton era moore s lone season as oc in philadelphia offers some proof he can successfully acclimate his system to a new team but the disparity in talent won t make it such a seamless transition especially after derek carr s abrupt retirement in may moore s arrival is certainly a breath of fresh air on the surface but how the 36 year old rookie head coach the youngest in the nfl successfully acclimates to the role remains to be seen training camp will provide a first glimpse at moore s initial impact 2 moore s major project during training camp will be figuring out who will lead his offense under center jake haener spencer rattler and second round pick tyler shough enter a three way quarterback competition while undrafted rookie hunter dekkers also looks to get noticed the trial offers great challenges considering the young qbs and the entire offense will be learning a new system rattler enters with the most experience after notching six starts during his rookie season last year his struggles eventually had the saints turn to haener for a start but neither notched a win in carr s absence perhaps that s why shough enters his first training camp with the greatest anticipation in new orleans the 25 year old louisville product comes in with seven years of college experience sports a strong arm that sets him apart from his competition and has a good chance at becoming the first saints rookie to start week 1 since archie manning did it in 1971 having such a rare occurrence coincide with moore s undertaking makes for a stimulating storyline that s appropriate for this new era of saints football but the rookie must win the job first 3 the saints defense could provide some upside in moore s first season several familiar veterans remain at every level including cameron jordan demario davis and tyrann mathieu but the defense will need to adjust to new defensive coordinator brandon staley s 3 4 scheme after a decade under dennis allen the unit s roster makeup isn t short of talent or depth chase young carl granderson bryan bresee and khalen saunders return with jordan on a defensive line that welcomes newcomer davon godchaux davis and pete werner return as the team s leading tacklers last season and will help guide a tackling machine in rookie danny stutsman isaac yiadomwas signed to man the outside corner with kool aid mckinstry returning on the other side and alontae taylor manning the nickel justin reid is the biggest new addition to the defense bringing championship mettle after three seasons with the chiefs and completing a louisiana born backend alongside the honey badger the pieces are seemingly all there but how they fall into place is the big question

news_mentions.headline: Tampa Bay Buccaneers training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Michael Baca provides a refresher on the Tampa Bay Buccaneers' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams michael baca has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc south catch up on the tampa bay buccaneers offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 21 rookies july 22 veterans location adventhealth training center tampa florida fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs tennessee titans 7 30 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at pittsburgh steelers 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs buffalo bills 7 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note the buccaneers who won six of their final seven regular season games in 2024 end the 2025 campaign with six consecutive games against teams that missed the playoffs nfl research what you need to know 1 a new challenge has reared its head just ahead of buccaneers training camp find an early season replacement for tristan wirfs the all pro left tackle underwent knee surgery on july 8 and is likely to begin the season on the physically unable to perform list which would sideline him at least four games there s no replacing the only player in nfl history who has earned all pro honors at both tackle positions but the silver lining is there s plenty of time to prepare currently on the left tackle depth chart are veteran charlie heck a newcomer and undrafted rookie benjamin chukwuma but perhaps a temporary reshuffling is in order will luke goedeke try his hand at a tackle switch or will left guard ben bredeson another newcomer man the position it s too early to tell now but figuring it out will be a camp priority tampa begins the 2025 season with two road games and hosts the defending super bowl champions in week 4 with wirfs likely out 2 the buccaneers surged toward their fourth consecutive nfc title last season thanks to balanced offense that consistently put up points the unit returns in 2025 largely unchanged barring the availability of wirfs but one other facet of the offense that could be interesting over the next few months is how the depth chart shakes out at wide receiver with mike evans leading the way chris godwin s health and potential return to form is the first item to monitor the bucs are hopeful the veteran wr will be ready for week 1 after a brutal ankle dislocation disrupted a fantastic season in 2024 but the club seems to be prepared either way that s where the head scratching begins tampa selected emeka egbuka with the 19th overall pick and the ohio state product seems poised for the slot role especially with godwin s guidance jalen mcmillan came on strong late last season and is in line for more playing time in year 2 add in veteran sterling shepard trey palmer and seventh rounder tez johnson to the mix and therein lies a good problem to have for the bucs 3 haason reddick was the biggest offseason addition for a buccaneers team that is in need of pressure off the edges defensive tackles vita vea and calijah kancey led the team in sacks in 2024 following a lengthy contract squabble that spilled into the regular season reddick s lone campaign with the jets was one to forget but a new beginning in tampa bay could be what the two time pro bowler needs reddick who previously had four consecutive 10 plus sack seasons before 2024 joins an aggressive todd bowles scheme that will lean on his pass rushing talents and bring him opportunity to cash in on his one year deal there s also a fourth round pick to watch david walker the highest nfl draftee ever from central arkansas had coaches buzzing after rookie minicamp

news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 9 of the 2026 NFL season.
