news_mentions.headline: AFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bills, Dolphins, Jets, Patriots
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Jeremy Bergman breaks down the top AFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and New York Jets.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots and new york jets catch up on each afc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots new york jets three key storylines 1 new era in buffalo for a bills roster that is returning most of its 2025 starters the biggest change this summer will be at the top the start of the joe brady era in buffalo gets underway in earnest when training camp kicks off in late july in taking over for sean mcdermott a sturdy leader who oversaw buffalo s longest period of sustained success since the great marv levy was at the helm brady has a lot to live up to the 36 year old first time head coach was elevated to improve on mcdermott s performance and lift buffalo over the hump and into the super bowl a january title game can t be won in august but the foundation of such an achievement can be built in the summer as it is for all champions brady s job starts and ends with accentuating what josh allen does best freeing up the qb to take further control of the offense the defense mcdermott s specialty has been handed off to ex nfl safety jim leonhard who coached the broncos star dbs over the past couple seasons no team with a new head coach is better positioned to win in 2026 than the bills who made it to the divisional round in 25 brady s first camp must set that tone 2 chubb chasing big season as one of buffalo s only notable offseason additions bradley chubb meets the bills at a critical time for both the team and the player chubb is coming off a solid comeback season from his torn acl logging 8 5 sacks for the dolphins in 2025 and playing a full slate of games for the first time since his rookie campaign the bills are in dire need of a pass rusher after gregory rousseau led the team with just seven sacks last year and joey bosa appears closer to retirement than returning entering the fray alongside second round pick t j parker chubb will be tasked with captaining a front seven that struggled to frustrate trevor lawrence and bo nix in the 2025 postseason chubb 30 has expressed that he s never been hungrier buffalo is starving for a true game wrecker off the edge 3 moore enough or more required the bills have missed stefon diggs draftees khalil shakir and keon coleman and free agent additions josh palmer and brandin cooks haven t quite filled his vacancy over the past couple years buffalo s trade for dj moore is meant to do just that reuniting with brady his ex panthers oc moore has an opportunity to be wr1 for josh allen in buffalo in a way he simply wasn t for caleb williams in chicago in 2025 the seeds of their hopefully fruitful partnership will be sowed in july and august moore admitted to growing pains in the spring but expects perfection this fall after the offseason long onboarding process in addition to providing a sure handed outlet for allen moore will be looked at to bring along the embattled coleman who got called out by owner terry pegula in january and has been under a microscope since if moore can bring coleman along and elevate a middling bills wr room then brady s first year returns could be big back to top three key storylines 1 first look at miami s offensive overhaul tua tagovailoa tyreek hill and jaylen waddle are out malik willis is in while de 39 von achane re upped for the long haul who else will fill out the dolphins offensive roster malik washington returns as a solid pass catching option joined by tutu atwell jalen tolbert terrace marshall and jalen reagor all looking to break out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFL midseason All-Rookie Team: Arvell Reese, David Bailey pacing 2026 draft picks
news_mentions.body_text: before the 2026 nfl draft the main debate was over who would be the first non quarterback selected david bailey or arvell reese now at the midway point of the season the debate rages on who is the nfl 39 s rookie of the year is it one of those two defensive stars both have played at extremely high levels with bailey among the most disruptive pass rushers in the league and reese creating a diverse impact using his versatility those two players were easy picks for this exercise other positions weren 39 t as simple our midseason nfl all rookie team quarterback first team jalon daniels tampa bay buccaneers the nfl has yet to see a 2026 draft pick start at quarterback so by default the undrafted daniels retains the spot he held on the quarter mark all rookie team one of the reasons daniels went undrafted was his high turnover rate which has carried over to the nfl he has more interceptions than touchdowns in two of three starts but daniels deserves credit for his week 5 performance as he led the buccaneers to a win over the cowboys he was turnover free that thursday night and used his mobility to avoid negative plays second team joe fagnano baltimore ravens nbsp with all due respect i guess this spot goes to fagnano he is the only other rookie also undrafted to start a game it didn 39 t go well at all but facing the jaguars who rank second in the nfl in scoring defense in your starting debut is a tough ask fagnano ranks second among all rookies in completions and first downs honorable mention fernando mendoza raiders athan kaliakmanis commanders jack strand falcons running back first team jonah coleman denver broncos despite a stint on injured reserve coleman has made a strong case as the nfl 39 s most impactful rookie back he is the only rookie with multiple rushing touchdowns and is tied for the rookie lead with 13 first down carries despite having far fewer attempts than others on the leaderboard coleman has also been productive in the passing game with 13 catches on 14 targets for 128 yards late in the fourth quarter against the chiefs he had a crucial 51 yard catch and run that set up denver 39 s go ahead touchdown a 5 yard run by coleman second team emmett johnson kansas city chiefs johnson ranks seventh among rookies in rushing yards but you can better understand his impact when factoring in receiving production through eight games he has 348 yards of total offense 237 receiving 111 rushing which ranks no 1 among rookie running backs he is also the only rookie back with both a rushing and receiving touchdown honorable mention kaelon black 49ers mike washington raiders jeremiyah love cardinals jadarian price seahawks seth mcgowan colts wide receiver first team denzel boston cleveland browns kc concepcion cleveland browns carnell tate tennessee titans no surprises here the same three names atop the rookie wr rankings at the quarter mark remain in place at the midway point they 39 re led by boston the seventh receiver drafted in april he leads all rookies in receiving yards 507 first down receptions 21 and receiving touchdowns three against the saints on sunday boston recorded his third catch of 50 plus yards which ties him with green bay 39 s christian watson for the nfl lead not far behind is concepcion who scored his first nfl touchdown on sunday in new orleans he ranks no 1 among rookies in receptions 37 and second in receiving yards 437 concepcion also leads all rookie receivers in catches of 20 plus yards eight and yards after the catch 237 which ranks top 20 in the nfl one spot behind amon ra st brown tate slots in just behind the browns 39 rookie duo with 34 catches for 413 yards and one touchdown he was exceptional at ohio state in contested situations and has continued that success in the nfl eight catches on nine contested targets however tate also leads all rookie receivers with four drops and three fumbles second team omar cooper new york jets makai lemon philadelphia eagles germie bernard pittsburgh steelers it has been a small yet impressive sample size from cooper despite almost all his production having come in three games he ranks fifth among rookies in receiving yards 306 and second with a pair of touchdown grabs lemon is tied with concepcion for the rookie lead with 37 receptions while bernard has helped expand the steelers 39 offense using his nose for the sticks honorable mention caleb douglas dolphins antonio williams commanders ted hurst buccaneers kevin coleman dolphins malachi fields giants chris bell dolphins josh cameron jaguars barion brown saints tight end first team kenyon sadiq new york jets the first tight end drafted in 2026 leads all rookie tight ends in catches 21 and receiving yards 235 each game sadiq seems to have a catch on which he is asked to high point and finish showing off his ball skills at different elevations most of his snaps have come in a detached alignment but he has been a capable run blocker when inline 37 7 percent of his snaps second team eli raridon new england patriots with 16 catches for 225 yards raridon joins sadiq as the only rookie tight ends with more than 150 receiving yards raridon leads all rookie tight ends in first down receptions 11 and is one of only two with multiple touchdown catches despite having a brutal drop on a potential walk in touchdown against the packers raridon also leads all rookie tight ends in blocking snaps and has kept his head above water in that area honorable mention nate boerkircher jaguars matthew hibner ravens josh cuevas ravens sam roush bears will kacmarek dolphins offensive tackle first team max iheanachor pittsburgh steelers blake miller detroit lions there isn 39 t a rookie offensive tackle running away with the top spot they 39 ve all been up and down iheanachor has had his share of struggles especially in the run game which was expected considering his inexperience but he hasn 39 t been a liability and the pittsburgh offensive line as a unit has been much better since he became the full time starter at right tackle in week 3 miller has probably been the most consistent rookie ot having allowed just one sack in seven starts at right tackle second team spencer fano cleveland browns markel bell philadelphia eagles fano 39 s tape has been full of high highs and low lows he has struggled against better talent see chase young this past sunday but he played above average against the jets titans and ravens before that fano has performed well enough to believe he can be a long term solution for the browns honorable mention kahlil benson chiefs monroe freeling panthers caleb lomu patriots travis burke chargers jayden williams cardinals interior offensive line first team vega ioane baltimore ravens austin barber cleveland browns francis mauigoa new york giants whether the ravens have needed him at guard or center ioane has been up for the challenge he hasn 39 t given up a sack since week 1 and has been the steadiest run blocker of all rookie offensive linemen barber is coming off arguably his worst game as a pro but there has been far more good than bad on his rookie tape he has been an iron man while battling through injuries and is tied with his teammate fano for the rookie lead in snaps played 588 i had higher hopes for mauigoa a top 10 pick but he has been good enough at right guard second team kadyn proctor miami dolphins jake slaughter los angeles chargers emmanuel pregnon jacksonville jaguars proctor had a strong case for the first team and it won 39 t be a surprise if he 39 s there before the end of the season slaughter has been solid although his rookie missteps have been costly mistakes pregnon leads the jaguars in snaps played but his mistakes are starting to add up nfl high 10 penalties honorable mention nbsp trey zuhn raiders keylan rutledge texans logan taylor chargers fernando carmona titans edge rusher first team david bailey new york jets gabe jacas new england patriots there isn 39 t much debate for the top two spots bailey leads all rookies in sacks 7 5 tackles for loss 11 forced fumbles five also tied for the league lead and pressures 31 he has taken his game to another level over his last four outings including a disruptive afternoon against patrick mahomes and the chiefs on sunday jacas is second among rookie edge rushers in sacks three and pressures 26 and he 39 s added an interception off aaron rodgers no less he needs to show better discipline with missed tackles and damaging penalties two roughing the passer two offsides but jacas has outplayed his draft spot second team dani dennis sutton green bay packers akheem mesidor los angeles chargers despite not being a starter dennis sutton has become a valuable role player on sub downs he ranks third among all rookies in pressures 23 and sacks three and he 39 s made an impact on kick and punt return coverage also coming off the bench mesidor has been one of the better all around rookie defensive linemen making plays both in pass rushing and in stopping the run he posted a career high seven pressures against the texans on sunday honorable mention r mason thomas chiefs cashius howell bengals romello height 49ers rueben bain buccaneers derrick moore lions caden curry colts defensive tackle first team gracen halton san francisco 49ers skyler gill howard detroit lions defensive tackle was not a strong position in the 2026 nfl draft and unsurprisingly it has been light in rookie output the 49ers had d line questions entering the season but halton has helped provide some answers he ranks third among all rookies in tackles for loss five and had one of the coolest rookie moments of the season when he forced a fumble against the seahawks and recovered it for his first nfl touchdown unfortunately halton suffered a broken ankle on sunday which will end his rookie season a subpackage defender gill howard ranks third on the lions and leads all rookie interior linemen in pressures 16 he was a day 3 steal second team lee hunter carolina panthers darrell jackson new york jets hunter is averaging fewer than 25 snaps per game but he is making the most of his playing time even if he isn 39 t dominating the box score you can feel his impact on tape jackson 39 s snap count has steadily increased too as he 39 s earned more trust from the coaching staff he leads all rookie defensive tackles in tackles 26 and has stacked positive reps see his week 8 snaps vs tyler linderbaum honorable mention chris mcclellan packers peter woods chiefs aaron hall panthers caleb banks vikings lt overton cowboys linebacker first team arvell reese new york giants jacob rodriguez miami dolphins reese terrorized the eagles this past sunday to the tune of 12 tackles three sacks and a forced fumble on a sack that took just 2 29 seconds the fastest sack in the nfl since week 7 of last season according to nextgenstats reese was my top ranked player in the 2026 draft and he hasn 39 t disappointed his main appeal as a prospect was his versatility which is also why he is one of the favorites for defensive rookie of the year he is the only nfl player not just among rookies with 65 plus tackles eight plus tackles for loss and at least one interception add in his forced fumble from sunday and 4 5 sacks and reese has made an impact for the nfc east leading giants there are multiple other rookie linebackers with a case to be on the first team but rodriguez has filled up the stat sheet 79 tackles four tackles for loss one forced fumble and one interception his most impressive stat though is an nfl best 33 34 defensive stops 34 reese ranks second with 32 second team anthony hill tennessee titans josiah trotter tampa bay buccaneers sonny styles washington commanders any of these three linebackers easily could have joined reese on the first team it 39 s a loaded year for rookies at the position hill averages 10 3 tackles per game which ranks third in the nfl behind only alex singleton and nakobe dean trotter has always been a hammer looking for a nail against the run but his improvements in coverage are promising styles and roquan smith are the only nfl linebackers with 67 plus tackles eight plus pressures and at least one interception and one forced fumble honorable mention kendal daniels falcons jaishawn barham cowboys harold perkins falcons jaden dugger 49ers bryce boettcher colts cj allen colts cornerback first team brandon cisse green bay packers mansoor delane kansas city chiefs this was a tough category because of the volatility from the rookie cb class cisse who leads all rookie corners in snaps played had some rough moments over the first month of the season but he has been stacking positive outings since the start of october over his last five games cisse has allowed zero touchdowns and just 50 percent completions when targeted along with four passes defended and one interception delane has missed three games because of a right shoulder injury but he performed at a high level in the five games he was on the field despite playing half the number of snaps as cisse he has almost as many passes defended four and the same number of interceptions one it helps that he has been strong as a tackler and has yet to commit a penalty second team davison igbinosun buffalo bills malik muhammad chicago bears igbinosun is one of nine nfl players and the only rookie with at least five pass breakups and one interception he was known for his hands on approach in coverage at ohio state and that has followed him to the nfl but he also does a great job using his length to suffocate passing windows over the past three games he has allowed only two catches with two pass breakups and his first career interception i was ready to put hezekiah masses here because he leads all rookies with three interceptions but his coverage tape over the last month just hasn 39 t been good enough muhammad has been banged up and had some rough patches as well see the packers game but he has played more reliable football honorable mention will lee panthers daylen everette steelers hezekiah masses raiders jermod mccoy raiders colton hood giants nickelback first team keionte scott tampa bay buccaneers scott fell further than expected on draft night because he is a very specific type of player an undersized nickel who is much better downhill than in reverse but when used in the correct role scott can shine and he has played well for a fast and physical bucs defense he has almost as many solo tackles as styles and is tied with caleb downs for the most defensive stops 14 among rookie dbs second team chris johnson miami dolphins nbsp johnson who just turned 22 this week has shown his youth at times but i have been impressed with his resiliency especially given that miami has used him both inside and outside johnson notched his first career interception on sunday off jared goff honorable mention kenneth harris colts keith abney lions avieon terrell falcons chandler rivers ravens d 39 angelo ponds jets safety first team treydan stukes las vegas raiders caleb downs dallas cowboys it can be tough not to have recency bias for an exercise like this but stukes 39 interception on sunday against the 49ers helped land him on the first team stukes now has a pair of interceptions and is tied for the rookie lead with three passes defended there certainly have been ups and downs for downs but he is coming off one of his most impactful games of his young career against the colts and his older brother josh downs he finished with three tackles two passes defended one sack and his first nfl interception to seal a win second team zakee wheatley carolina panthers dillon thieneman chicago bears wheatley has made his presence felt in different ways for the panthers he had a forced fumble in his nfl debut then picked off jordan love in week 8 for his first career interception his consistency in both run support and coverage has been an exciting development thieneman hasn 39 t been as consistent but he leads all rookie safeties in tackles 52 and we have seen an uptick in chicago 39 s willingness to vary his role including letting him loose as a blitzer honorable mention emmanuel mcneil warren browns michael taaffe dolphins genesis smith chargers a j haulcy colts robert spears jennings steelers xavier nwankpa chiefs kicker first team drew stevens washington commanders stevens has been the most consistent of the rookie kickers connecting on 12 of 12 field goal attempts of under 50 yards he had a few missed extra points early in the season but has been more reliable over the past month honorable mention trey smack packers dominic zvada giants punter first team tommy doman buffalo bills doman could have earn this spot solely based on his jarring hit on a kickoff against the vikings to force a fumble but he also ranks third in the nfl in hangtime 4 62 seconds with a respectable 43 2 yard net average honorable mention nbsp ryan eckley ravens brett thorson vikings this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Packers RB Josh Jacobs to undergo surgery on finger this week; timeline to return TBD
news_mentions.description: Josh Jacobs will undergo surgery on his fractured finger this week, Green Bay coach Matt LaFleur said Monday. His timeline to return is "to be determined," LaFleur added.
news_mentions.body_text: the green bay packers will go back to life without josh jacobs at least for the time being jacobs will undergo surgery on his fractured finger this week green bay coach matt lafleur told reporters on monday his timeline to return is to be determined lafleur added asked if jacobs could be placed on injured reserve lafleur said i think everything s on the table a stint on ir would keep jacobs out for at least four games the running back s setback comes just three games into his return from the commissioner exempt list where he spent the first six weeks of the season in his limited action this season jacobs a three time pro bowler has struggled totaling 148 total yards on 47 touches his 2 2 yards per carry through two plus games is by far the worst average of his career jacobs left sunday s blowout win over new england in the first quarter after totaling five yards on four carries without jacobs green bay s league worst run game will turn back to kaleb johnson marshawn lloyd pierre strong and chris brooks the latter of whom has been on ir since oct 10 with jacobs and lloyd inactive due to knee injury sidelined during sunday s game johnson a second year trade acquisition racked up a career high 68 yards on 14 carries jacobs absence due to injury comes amid the release of allegations that were made against him years before he pleaded no contest to two misdemeanor charges stemming from a may altercation with his then girlfriend lawyers representing jacobs said he has a substantial body of tangible evidence disputing the new allegations that surfaced in a records release last month the packers rb spent the first six games of the season on the exempt list after pleading no contest on sept 10 to charges of battery and criminal damage to property he was arrested may 26 after his then girlfriend said he had thrown her to the ground three days earlier the nfl s investigation into allegations against jacobs is ongoing in the thick of a hypercompetitive nfc north race green bay 6 3 hosts the rival vikings next sunday before its week 11 bye then the packers play at the rams on thanksgiving eve and at new orleans in week 13 before hosting the afc best bills in week 14

news_mentions.headline: Giants' Devin Singletary ready for showcase as likely RB1 vs. Eagles: 'I know what I can do'
news_mentions.description: New York Giants running back Devin Singletary, the team's overtime hero in Week 7, could be in line to lead the way on the ground this Sunday against the Philadelphia Eagles. After three healthy scratches earlier this season, he's ready for that chance.
news_mentions.body_text: just like that devin singletary will potentially be the last man standing on sunday against the eagles the giants running back room has been whittled down from a core four earlier this season to one as cam skattebo is currently doubtful to play due to a hamstring injury tyrone tracy was placed on injured reserve and najee harris was released on oct 20 the 29 year old singletary who played the hero with a 30 yard game winning touchdown run in overtime against the texans in week 7 is ready to meet the moment i know what i can do singletary said via the new york post i want to be able to display that singletary s newfound opportunity is surprising not just because of new york s rb depth only a few weeks ago but because of where the veteran ball carrier found himself in the pecking order he was a healthy scratch fourth of four on the depth chart in weeks 3 5 though that was something new for singletary who hasn t missed more than two games in a season for any reason since his 2019 rookie campaign he maintained the right attitude i just stayed positive because that s who i am singletary said do you want it to go down like this no but it s the nature of the beast i wouldn t say it was frustrating it s how the game goes a lot of competition deep backfield when that opportunity comes you want to be ready instead of being so mad or sad that you can t capture the moment when it s here singletary finally got back on the field in week 6 against the saints as new york momentarily shifted away from its normal lead back skattebo for the outing skattebo didn t receive a carry whereas six other giants players logged at least one rushing attempt singletary had four for 18 yards plus a 19 yard reception the giants released harris following the contest and tracy injured his hamstring the following game against houston in that one skattebo resumed his typical workload handling 17 carries for 124 yards and a score but on his final attempt a 42 yarder into texans territory during ot he felt something in his hamstring skattebo slid down to protect against injuring it further singletary stepped up and he broke through for the 30 yard game winner the very next play although skattebo hasn t been ruled out he managed only a limited practice friday before receiving a doubtful designation that means singletary could very well see an extended chance to build on his big run that took place before the team s week 8 bye he would be joined by rookie gregory desrosiers and phil mafah who was elevated from the practice squad in the backfield should singletary get the start it will be his first since week 2 of 2025 a very much unforeseen development for the eight year vet hoping to stack some success for big blue

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 9 Sunday aftermath: Myles Garrett's return buoys Rams; Jordan Love, Joe Burrow shine
news_mentions.description: Kevin Patra breaks down the key storylines from Week 9's slate of games on Sunday, including Myles Garrett's return to action for the Rams and the explosive outings from Jordan Love and Joe Burrow.
news_mentions.body_text: we re at the season s halfway point and sunday saw a number of teams and quarterbacks make loud statements as we gear up for 2026 s stretch run the nfc north continues to be an absolute buzzsaw of a division going 3 0 on sunday with the vikings set to face the bills on monday night the afc north is shaping up to be a two team race and the seahawks got back over 500 with sam darnold sidelined let s examine some key storylines in sunday s aftermath including prolific packers attack fueled by deep ball burrow marching toward first mvp another one score win for payton s broncos giants overcome adversity once again stroud s historic afternoon in los angeles but first we start with the rams who saw the return of their prized offseason acquisition and immediately reaped the benefits garrett to the rams rescue welcome back myles garrett the nfl sack champion returned from a seven game stint on injured reserve to bolster the rams pass rush which had struggled to pester signal callers without the two time defensive player of the year garrett didn t just return to the lineup on sunday no no no he blasted off like a heat seeking missile at commanders quarterback jayden daniels first there was the second quarter strip sack that set up points then in the fourth quarter garrett walloped daniels twice for two pivotal sacks that helped seal the win on a day the offense couldn t find a groove man it was a weight off my shoulders garrett said of the three sacks that helped key l a s 20 13 win in his return from september knee surgery just getting back to who i am i m nowhere near where i want to be as far as like my performance and the things i know i can do how i can move but this is a confidence booster for sure just try to boost the confidence of the guys around me as well garrett played 35 of 58 defensive snaps 60 3 in his return from injury he generated six pressures and three sacks on 27 pass rushes 22 2 pressure rate per next gen stats getting the dominant edge rusher back will also make aaron donald more menacing sunday was the first time this season that garrett and donald were active together with both on the field 23 plays the rams defense allowed 5 0 yards per play and recorded four sacks per ngs on all other plays the defense allowed 8 1 yards per play and one touchdown with zero sacks as the duo plays together more the upside is enormous garrett s return is massive for a rams squad that has struggled this season they re finally on the right side of 500 at 5 4 but still have work to do to get into playoff positioning with puka nacua s reported knee injury adding uncertainty to sean mcvay s offense the l a d might need to carry the load for the next few weeks editor s update sean mcvay told reporters monday that wr puka nacua has mcl and pcl sprains and a turf toe injury and will probably be placed on injured reserve packers air it out to demolish pats many offenses prefer to dink and dunk their way down the field executing the kind of safe approach that doesn t put the ball at risk and keeps the attack in advantageous down and distance situations and then there is green bay jordan love entered sunday already leading the league in splash plays then he dropped dime after dime after deep dime on a bewildered patriots defense in foxborough the packers qb along with burner christian watson 7 171 1 and ascending second year wideout matthew golden 10 164 1 made pats star cb christian gonzalez look like a sixth round scrub putting himself squarely in the mvp conversation love generated 372 passing yards three passing touchdowns and a regular season career high 153 2 passer rating in green bay s 45 27 shellacking of the patriots he joined aaron rodgers as the only packers quarterbacks with multiple passing touchdowns in at least eight of the first nine games of a season with rodgers doing so in 2011 and 2020 winning mvp in each of those seasons love s 153 2 passer rating in week 9 is the highest by any packers quarterback in a regular season start since rodgers had a perfect 158 3 against the raiders in 2019 it really doesn t matter who it is on defense love said after the game we trust the game plan and trust guys are gonna get open and make plays it s the nfl we see great dbs every week our mindset is we gotta keep attacking attack they did love was flawless and his deep shots were on the freaking money when he s driving the ball downfield hitting receivers in stride there isn t a prettier sight in the game right now love completed 10 of his 12 downfield pass attempts 10 air yards for 294 yards and two touchdowns against the patriots the third most downfield passing yards by a quarterback this season per next gen stats he averaged 24 5 yards per attempt on those downfield passes the fifth most in a single game since 2018 he completed six of his eight deep attempts 20 air yards for 235 yards and one touchdown better still love was pressured on nine pass attempts he completed six of those for 153 yards averaging a whopping 17 0 ypa when pressured per ngs those numbers are pure comedy but it s crazy because i know there s probably a lot more in there golden said we ve still got so many more plays out there to make there are still aspects to clean up with the offensive line still somewhat of a mess and the ground game not getting into gear until late with josh jacobs now dealing with a fractured finger the pack could use some rb help jonathan taylor anyone but when love is on the money and his two dynamic receivers aren t flubbing passes the pack can score with anyone with the lions escaping miami on sunday with a 19 9 win over the fighting fins and the bears overcoming five turnovers to best the buccaneers at home the nfc north continues to be the hottest division in the league is anyone playing better than burrow jordan love is on fire but joe burrow has been blazing for a month the bengals quarterback in sunday s 34 17 win over the falcons generated his fourth straight game with at least four passing rushing touchdowns tied for the second longest streak since 1970 behind only peyton manning s five game streak in his 2004 mvp season per nfl research over the past four tilts burrow has a thrown hilarious 16 touchdown passes while completing 77 of his passes becoming just the fourth qb fifth instance overall to pull off that feat joining tom brady 2007 manning 2013 and russell wilson 2015 and 2020 joe is playing at an unbelievably high level right now bengals head coach zac taylor said joe doesn t force the ball he takes the ball where it needs to go based on the looks and even if sometimes they re leaning into a guy or doubling a guy he s still going to give him an opportunity and some of those opportunities came up big for us so that s just something we re used to it helps to have ja 39 marr chase 10 155 1 and tee higgins 5 32 2 on your side as they did at lsu burrow and chase toasted falcons corner a j terrell with a 47 yard td bomb to get the ball rolling on a 24 point first half that all but sealed a win in madrid before the break chase was asked after the game if burrow is playing like an mvp i can t answer that because i ve been playing with him my whole life so it s kind of hard for me to sit up here and say that chase said but i ve been thinking he should have won the mvp i said this when we went to the super bowl that year and he didn t get it that year i mean he s up for it every year broncos magic in one score games continues credit sean payton s squad for continuing to come up clutch streaking to their fifth consecutive victory on sunday four of which have come by less than a touchdown sunday s 26 21 win over the panthers came after trailing by one point entering the fourth quarter the broncos fifth win of the season after trailing at any point in the fourth that ties the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings for the most wins after trailing in the fourth quarter in a team s first nine games of a season since 2000 per nfl research both the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings lost their first playoff game on wild card weekend i think it s just the character of our guys the toughness competitiveness of our guys broncos quarterback bo nix said after the game we re just comfortable in that moment when things get close there at the end of the game whatever it is we have had a couple scores and then we always want to make it one score just glad we re on this side and winning em the broncos jumped out to a 10 0 advantage before the panthers got back in the game and took a third quarter lead carolina controlled the middle portion of the game but nix and co took over late with two fourth quarter touchdown drives capped by a 26 yard strike from nix to pat bryant after the offense failed to get a game sealing first down late the defense stepped up and forced a fumble to squash the panthers final drive i just think we ve been there before so we know how to handle the situation nik bonitto who had the game sealing strip sack of bryce young said at the end of the day it was our job as a defense to just go out and finish the victory set an nfl record with their 16th consecutive regular season win in a one score contest broncos games are rarely normal sunday s included a miraculous interception in the end zone that took a replay review of when payton s challenge flag was thrown before it could be reviewed we could say the magic will eventually run out and the broncos will regress to the mean in one score games however there have been enough of them to admit it s part of the makeup of payton s broncos maybe it will never be pretty but that win column sure looks nice right now for the 7 2 squad harbaugh s giants keep finding ways to win it s not just that john harbaugh has guided the giants to the top of the nfc east with a 5 2 1 record it s how they ve morphed into a reliable steady team that stands in stark contrast to the past decade plus of ineptitude for the most part the giants haven t beaten themselves sure there was cam skattebo s fumble against washington that led to a week 5 tie and jameis winston s early turnover barrage in their week 6 loss to new orleans but big blue has become better at not letting things unravel on sunday against a reeling eagles squad in a place lincoln financial field that has been a bugaboo for new york for a dozen years things could have spiraled out of control particularly when j j mccarthy exited due to a hip injury instead winston entered and calmly converted a third down and a fourth down to lead the giants only td drive of the game he then handed the reins back to mccarthy who finished out the win it was a prime example of all 46 active players doing their part to secure a victory perhaps more important than the offense doing just enough is a defense coming on strong under coordinator dennard wilson in previous years new york s offensive struggles got most of the attention despite the fact that the limp d had been equally or more disappointing given the up front talent under wilson this unit is a bullying menace stopping a sleepy eagles offense that saw joe milton start his first career game on sunday isn t anything to write home about on the surface but how new york did it is very noteworthy most notable arvell reese was a dominant force the rookie earned a career high three sacks and led the giants with 12 tackles becoming the first rookie since at least 1994 to record three sacks and at least 10 tackles in a game per nfl research reese joins fellow top five pick david bailey of the jets as the only rookies with at least three sacks in a game this season defensive rookie of the year that s set in stone cornerback greg newsome said of reece per the new york daily news now we re looking at defensive player of the year the superlatives for the rookie linebacker are just starting i don t know any young players that can do the things he does i m gonna be honest with you veteran defensive tackle d j reader said maybe the kid in seattle no 3 nick emmanwori because you don t find a kid that can cover the way he can cover come down and fill gaps in the run game rush the passer doesn t miss tackles kid s serious man it s special to watch he s really special the offense will come and go especially if the rushing attack is slowed like sunday but if big blue can rest its hat on a defense led by a dynamic rookie linebacker the giants can still run away with the nfc east week 9 sunday spotlight

news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 9 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 9 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below madrid cincinnati bengals 34 atlanta falcons 17 early window denver broncos 26 carolina panthers 21 dallas cowboys 27 indianapolis colts 23 kansas city chiefs 35 new york jets 12 detroit lions 19 miami dolphins 9 new orleans saints 23 cleveland browns 22 ot new york giants 19 philadelphia eagles 11 los angeles rams 20 washington commanders 13 late window houston texans 44 los angeles chargers 22 san francisco 49ers 38 las vegas raiders 17 green bay packers 45 new england patriots 27 seattle seahawks 17 arizona cardinals 3 sunday night chicago bears 27 tampa bay buccaneers 24 jeremy bergman s takeaways cincy s stars sizzle in espana few teams have had better 10 quarter stretches than the bengals over the past three weeks since being shut out in the first half against baltimore in week 7 cincinnati has responded with 112 points over two and a half games leading the way is joe burrow staking a strong claim in the mvp race burrow was lethal again on sunday in the first half leading cincy s offense to four scoring drives on 9 3 yards per play and completing 82 of his passes for 239 yards eight of those completions went to ja 39 marr chase who set a career high with 142 yards in the first half finishing with 155 and a score on 10 catches showcasing his dynamic ability on an international stage for the first time tee higgins boxed out c j henderson and atlanta s defensive backs for two tds even chase brown season high 6 3 ypc and cincinnati s anemic run game season best 123 yards showed some explosion after sunday s romp cincinnati has now won four straight games with at least 30 points scored for the first time in franchise history if the bengals are capable of this type of production weekly do they even need to swing big for a piece possibly at running back at the trade deadline that s a question for tuesday maybe atlanta will have an answer for cincy s offensive onslaught by then another big bijan day undone by atlanta errors a week after losing to a tampa team that didn t complete a pass the falcons found a more traditional way to fall sunday morning play leaky defense commit penalties repeat in pristine climate controlled conditions inside madrid s bernabeu there were no excuses for atlanta s performance first the positives michael penix threw three fewer interceptions than he did a week prior and scrambled for a career high 50 yards looking svelte and nimble on the spanish pitch bijan robinson who loves an exclusive window rushed for 100 again totaling 147 yards from scrimmage and one td on the day the elusive dynamo was right at home at the home of real madrid s galacticos but jeff ulbrich s defense was a sieve against the nfl s hottest attack allowing 7 1 yards per play and forcing just two punts on the day atlanta also committed 12 accepted penalties for 88 yards repeatedly setting back the offense the falcons o line committed two fouls in the red zone on their second drive leading to the first field goal of a touchdown fight its most critical error though came at the start of the fourth quarter when down two tds at the bengals 10 yard line atlanta was called for offensive holding on a third and 2 incompletion cincy accepted the penalty and forced a fourth and 12 settling for cutting a two score lead to a two score lead nick folk instead shanked a 38 yard field goal and the bengals lead held at 14 the falcons never got closer a tale of two divisions despite the result cincinnati and atlanta will both return to the states tied in the win column for leads in their respective divisions the bengals victory moved them into a 6 2 tie atop the afc north with the steelers setting up a critical sunday night football showdown on the banks of the ohio river in week 10 having already lost this season to pittsburgh the bengals need a home win against aaron rodgers and co to improve their division record and ensure no favor in the head to head tiebreaker down in the cursed nfc south the falcons at 3 6 are nowhere near out of it but are at risk of falling behind hotter clubs after sunday s slate atlanta is essentially tied with carolina 3 5 new orleans 3 5 and tampa bay 3 6 a needed bye awaits for the falcons after a week 10 matchup with patrick mahomes chiefs next gen stats insight for bengals falcons via nfl pro joe burrow was pressured on nine of 32 dropbacks 28 1 against the falcons completing 20 of 23 passes for 237 yards and two touchdowns when kept clean his time to pressure of 3 26 seconds was the longest of his career and the falcons defense had just one quick pressure in the game nfl research joe burrow and ja marr chase connected for their 19th touchdown of at least 40 yards in sunday s win tied with joe montana and jerry rice for the third most by any qb receiver duo since 1980 the only duos with more are peyton manning and marvin harrison 21 tds and steve young and jerry rice 20 tds their first quarter touchdown was the 58th score by the duo overall including playoffs which passed daunte culpepper and randy moss for second most by any qb receiver duo before age 30 trailing only dan marino and mark clayton 68 tds back to top nick shook s takeaways broncos win a game of runs it wasn t quite an avalanche but as is often the case in basketball sunday s game became a tale of runs what began as a one sided contest in favor of denver reversed course just before halftime sunday when the panthers turned an interception into a scoring possession to claw back into the competition that shift in momentum saw bryce young enter a flow state dotting the field with precise confident passes and leading a second scoring drive to double up between halves and put the panthers in a 14 13 lead he appeared poised to extend that lead in the fourth too but a wacky interception snagged by denver safety devon key stopped the panthers in their tracks and swung momentum back in favor of the broncos who rattled off two straight touchdown drives to take a 26 14 lead in the final period good for their latest fourth quarter comeback effort denver had to hang on for dear life in the final minutes after carolina mounted one final push and it s not exactly a resounding victory but it s the latest example of a contending team finding a way to win a back and forth contest by coming through in the most important moments and finishing in a style that fits the team s strengths with edge rusher nik bonitto strip sacking young to stop the panthers final drive in its tracks bo nix looked more like the passer we ve known him to be too a small but encouraging sign as the calendar creeps toward thanksgiving panthers defensive changes fail to produce improvement defensive coordinator ejiro evero became the fall guy when coach dave canales relieved him of his duties following carolina s week 8 loss to green bay installing an interim dc with the hopes it might improve the panthers inconsistent defense in short it didn t the panthers allowed denver to break 300 yards of total offense and mount two touchdown drives that appeared vastly different but produced the same result the first fourth quarter scoring march covered 80 yards over 14 plays while the other needed just six plays to gain 61 yards and finish with a wide open touchdown pass to pat bryant as a result of a blown coverage a symptom of a defense that is still scrambling to take care of the details carolina stood tall late buying its offense a chance to compile a game winning drive but the earlier breakdowns represent a persistent issue had cornerback corey thornton not made an incredibly athletic play on the ball to pick off nix this game might have snowballed out of control in the first half long before the panthers offense was able to climb back into the game had jaylen waddle not exited due to a head injury denver might have continued to rely on the playmaker to break open for big gains this unit was never going to be completely fixed in one week but sunday told us there s still plenty to correct nix begins to break out of his shell it didn t last throughout the entire game but seemingly for the first time in ages bo nix took the training wheels off his own bicycle and let himself play a bit more instinctively proof existed in his decisions made while rolling out in which nix twice opted to throw back against his body to open targets underneath instead of accepting a small scramble gain or throwing it away his bullet ripped through traffic to courtland sutton for a touchdown was another encouraging sign because he was willing to take a minor risk and when bryant streaked open through the carolina secondary nix didn t hesitate to put the ball on him for a score the results are evident in his stat line 25 of 37 237 yards two touchdowns one interception it s not a massive change in performance but it s a start broncos fans have been yearning to see for weeks we ll see if it s a sign of things to come next gen stats insight for broncos panthers via nfl pro bo nix posted a 124 2 passer rating against single high coverage 20 of 26 for 202 yards and two touchdowns but a 15 3 passer rating against split safety coverage 5 of 11 for 35 yards and an interception his 15 3 passer rating against split safety looks was his lowest in a game since his nfl debut in week 1 2024 nfl research the broncos won 26 21 in week 9 against the panthers after trailing by one point entering the fourth quarter their fifth win of the season after trailing at any point in the fourth that is tied with the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings for the most wins after trailing in the fourth quarter in a team s first nine games of a season since 2000 both the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings lost their first playoff game that season in the wild card round back to top kevin patra s takeaways cowboys survive collapse to secure a much needed win over colts brian schottenheimer s squad tried to give the game away luckily the cowboys opponent did a better job dallas built a 10 point lead deep into the third quarter mistakes then gave indianapolis life ceedee lamb fumbled late the cowboys second turnover of the day to wipe out a chance to put the game away despite putting up stats with george pickens out lamb had a mistake filled day in addition to the fumble he was called for offensive pass interference twice and couldn t toe tap a td that cost the cowboys four points in the red zone dallas couldn t get out of its own way for much of the contest dak prescott was far more off the mark than we re used to leading to stalled drives schotty s club was called for 14 penalties for a whopping 153 yards turned the ball over twice and missed a late go ahead field goal that s how you let an opponent amid a fire sale stay in a game despite being outgained 508 271 dallas should have run away with the game instead it trailed late until ryan flournoy the best no 3 wr in the league made a massive play for a 46 yard gain to set up the game winning td a loss would have all but doomed the cowboys who still have a big hill to climb in the nfc east colts offense can t kick it into gear until late facing a bad cowboys defense daniel jones and co couldn t take advantage for long stretches indy went three and out five times including on four of its first five drives the other was a 19 yard td drive following a dak prescott fumble jones was inconsistent and often off the mark completing 20 of 34 passes for 180 yards with a td and an interception the cowboys d entered the game allowing a league high 385 4 yards per game and 5 9 yards per play 29th indy generated just 271 yards and 4 6 yards per play while going 3 for 13 on third down ashton dulin s 55 yard catch and run td was indy s only pass play longer than 16 yards jones averaged 2 6 air yards per completion in the game third fewest of his career minimum 10 completions per next gen stats against a dallas d that s been ripped up jones needed to do more the rushing attack did and maintaining possession over the final 4 35 to secure a 17 3 win seattle accomplished this with backup drew lock playing in place of sam darnold while also dealing with his own elbow injury and sustaining an oblique injury during sunday s game generating enough offense to build a satisfactory lead for the defense to protect for the remainder of the game perhaps most importantly the seahawks won a game without receiving a massive contribution from jaxon smith njigba who finished with seven catches for 51 yards and didn t need to become the game breaking weapon he s been in most of seattle s triumphs this season it wasn t a performance that will take any heat off embattled offensive coordinator brian fleury but the win will quiet critics for the next week and a 5 4 record looks better than a 500 mark at this stage it was also equally important for seattle to keep pace in an nfc west that now features three teams above 500 minshew magic runs out gardner minshew s insertion into the lineup sparked a frantic comeback effort in a thrilling win over dallas in week 8 clearing the way for minshew to take over as starter for arizona to trade jacoby brissett to baltimore and for the cardinals to proceed with another veteran who seemed to have a better rapport with his targets and a higher willingness to take calculated risks in order to jump start the offense that gave cardinals fans reason to believe mike lafleur s offense might finally produce a quality day offensively even against one of the nfl s best defenses instead arizona encountered a familiar experience in its rematch with seattle struggling to generate offense and falling well short of competing with the seahawks in a loss that truly wasn t as close as the score suggested making matters worse was a hit minshew took to his right arm while throwing which seemed to sap him of the arm strength necessary to find open targets in the second half even when arizona flirted with another fourth quarter comeback minshew and the cardinals offense ran aground inside seattle s 10 extinguishing their fading hope of climbing back into the game and reminding arizona of the uphill battle it will face in most matchups going forward does this mean we might see rookie carson beck soon no not yet unless minshew s arm ends up being hurt worse than what was detectable sunday but the thrill of minshew s arrival and instant success proved to be unreliable dropping the cardinals to 3 6 in a season that s likely already starting to look toward april charbonnet shows some juice zach charbonnet the other half of seattle s past two headed backfield finally returned to the field in week 8 but didn t generate much in terms of production or pop it wasn t surprising given the nature of the knee injury that kept him out until his midseason arrival but with the seahawks desperate for ground game consistency they could use a notable contribution from the power back and finally received one sunday charbonnet rushed 16 times for 77 yards made a handful of defenders miss broke some tackles and looked much more like the runner he was in previous seasons bringing a welcome level of balance to an offense that already relied too heavily on sam darnold and was expected to do the same with backup drew lock jadarian price flashed in the passing game too making a fantastic sideline catch as part of his four receptions for 54 yards it s far from a guarantee that they ve suddenly rediscovered their ability to run the ball opponent must be considered in these small sample sizes but at least it s an encouraging sign for an offense that still hasn t found much of a rhythm next gen stats insight for cardinals seahawks via nfl pro seattle entered week 9 ranked 24th in rushing success rate 37 3 and enjoyed an uptick in that category on sunday finishing with a designed run success rate of 44 8 zach charbonnet accounted for most of the improvement finishing with a designed run success rate of 43 8 nfl research drew lock has faced the cardinals in both of his starts in 2026 and beat them in both lock is just the fourth quarterback since starts were tracked in 1950 to face the same team in each of his first two starts of a season and beat them in both joining frankie albert versus the lions in 1952 daryle lamonica versus the jets in 1963 and derek anderson versus the buccaneers in 2014 back to top grant gordon s takeaways bears survive sunday night disaster dazzling at the onset disastrous for most of the final three quarters caleb williams and the bears survived calamity to emerge with their fourth straight win after the buccaneers tied the game with 2 51 to play on sunday night williams seemingly absent of the confidence that was oozing earlier in the evening was able to drive the bears down the field thanks mostly to a 38 yard hook up with a wide open colston loveland the final drive set up cairo santos for a game winning 38 yard field goal with zeroes on the clock it wasn t in the realm of possibility that the game would end in such fashion after williams had hit luther burden on a crosser for a 56 yard touchdown that led to a 14 0 lead at the conclusion of the first quarter williams had completed six of his eight pass attempts for 105 yards and two touchdowns each of the incompletions coming on drops thereafter williams was an atrocious 16 of 29 for 174 yards zero touchdowns a career worst four interceptions and a 33 5 rating in all the bears had five turnovers with williams first three picks coming on ill advised balls in which he appeared to be trying to throw the ball away while fading back and going airborne his fourth was off a deflection and the fifth giveaway was a burden fumble that set up the game tying score burden looked to have potentially gone limp on the hit that forced him to drop possession and suffered a concussion chicago s defense was truly the catalyst for the victory but it wouldn t be possible without williams brilliance early and his final drive dramatics ahead of this one the bears were getting crowned as the new super bowl darlings nothing comes easy in the nfl though and if chicago is to fulfill some high expectations williams must recover get his swagger back and be able to balance it without making the never before seen errors he did on a night in which he and his bears escaped with a w bucky defense have bucs flirting with comeback nine minutes into sunday s proceedings the buccaneers were down 14 points the bears running roughshod on both sides of the ball somehow someway tampa bay made a game of this and came oh so close to a stunning win the somehow was the bucs defense and the someway was bucky irving the defense had the aforementioned quintet of takeaways and held the bears offense to six points after giving up touchdowns on the first two drives zyon mccollum had a pair of picks alex anzalone had an interception and four qb pressures and josiah trotter brought the hat all night long leading a hard hitting defensive effort offensively irving did his best to do it all the squiggly runner had a game high 97 yards on 20 carries and both of tampa s touchdowns he added a team high four receptions for 28 yards it was irving who scored from 6 yards out with 2 51 to go to bring the score to 24 22 baker mayfield then ran in the tying two point conversion mayfield was limping throughout much of the game and it s been made clear that just as the defense is the hallmark of tampa s success irving is the motor driving the bucs offense with tampa sitting at 3 0 this season when irving hits 100 yards rushing he fell just short this night and so did the bucs fortunately at 3 6 the bucs are in the nfc south and right in the thick of the race for the division crown defense saves bears leads win after a torrid start the chicago offense went rogue as it pertained to the script the defense was savage throughout however with jeffery simmons austin booker and the gang absolutely brutalizing baker mayfield and a jaylon johnson interception return for a touchdown keying the win the simmons effect is real so far with the acquisition of the pro bowl defensive tackle having spurred the defense to back to back excellent outings a week after grounding the seahawks the bears got stellar outings from devin bush nine tackles cam lewis six tackles interception simmons sack and booker sack four qb pressures johnson the high priced pro bowler has been terrible for most of the season as his 38 1 pro football focus grade would attest however with the bears clinging to a 17 13 lead and the buccaneers driving johnson jumped on a mayfield pass and weaved 67 yards the other way for a touchdown for a team to have five turnovers and still come out with a victory is next door to astonishing and the bears defense allowing the buccaneers to score just 10 points off those turnovers is the biggest reason why next gen stats insight for buccaneers bears via nfl pro the buccaneers blitzed caleb williams on 26 of 41 dropbacks 63 4 tied for the third most blitzes any quarterback has faced in a game this season williams was pressured on 13 of those 26 blitzes 50 but was sacked just once he started 7 of 10 for 124 yards and two touchdowns against the blitz went 4 of 10 for 22 yards and three interceptions on his next nine drives and completed 3 of 4 passes for 52 yards against the blitz on the bears game winning drive nfl research zyon mccollum s brilliant toe tapping interception in the second quarter was his career best third of the season each of them coming over the last three games mccollum who added another later in the first half became the first buccaneers player to record an interception in three straight games since lavonte david in 2013 williams four total interceptions were a career high having never thrown that many in an nfl game in college or high school back to top

news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 7 games: Giants' Tyrone Tracy Jr. injures  hamstring
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news developments we're monitoring around the league on this Week 7 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news developments we re monitoring around the league on this week 7 sunday baltimore ravens guard olaivavega ioane knee was ruled out of sunday s loss to cincinnati carolina panthers offensive tackle taylor moton suffered a fractured fibula in sunday s loss to tampa bay and will be out for a while head coach dave canales said cincinnati bengals tight end erick all knee and safety kyle dugger quadricep were ruled out of sunday s win over baltimore cleveland browns cornerback myles harden hamstring did not return to sunday s win over tennessee detroit lions cornerback ennis rakestraw ankle did not return to sunday s win over the packers green bay packers center sean rhyan ankle and offensive lineman jacob monk quad did not return to sunday s loss to the lions houston texans wide receiver jaylin noel has a turf toe injury head coach demeco ryans told reporters after sunday s loss to the giants las vegas raiders defensive end patrick johnson stinger neck did not return to sunday s loss to the rams miami dolphins cornerback julius brents stinger did not return to sunday s win over the jets minnesota vikings running back aaron jones knee did not return to sunday s win over indianapolis new orleans saints safety justin reid concussion and running back cj donaldson shoulder were ruled out of sunday s loss to pittsburgh in paris new york giants running back tyrone tracy hamstring did not return to sunday s win over houston running back cam skattebo said after the game that he felt something in his hamstring on his 42 yard run in overtime skattebo added that he did not slide on purpose on the play per espn new york jets defensive tackle t 39 vondre sweat knee was ruled out of sunday s loss to miami seattle seahawks wide receiver rashid shaheed knee was ruled out against the chiefs rb velus jones hamstring was also ruled out
