news_mentions.headline: NFC North training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bears, Lions, Packers, Vikings
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top NFC North training camp storylines to monitor for the Chicago Bears, Detroit Lions, Green Bay Packers and Minnesota Vikings.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers and minnesota vikings catch up on each nfc north team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers minnesota vikings three key storylines 1 can caleb find consistency we could discuss the bears offense taking another leap forward in ben johnson s second season we could consider the burgeoning potential of luther burden alongside rome odunze or ponder who will win the primary wr3 duties we could chatter about how much higher tight end colston loveland could fly or how johnson will use his diverse te room none of that really strikes a chord without caleb williams taking his game to new heights the former no 1 pick showed what the highs can look like in year 1 under johnson the explosive jaw dropping plays were plentiful and the qb led a trove of comebacks now he must flatten out some of the lulls the drive stalling misfires and become a more potent every snap quarterback keep the extraordinary peaks and raise the floor and williams will be in the thick of the mvp discussion the madden nfl 27 cover athlete heads into year 3 with heightened expectations if he meets them there is no telling how far the bears can go 2 defensive uncertainty from front to back questions on defense will hover over training camp the bears did precious little to upgrade a wanting front four the club added a few rotational interior defenders but is counting significantly on bounce back campaigns from grady jarrett and gervon dexter montez sweat still doesn t have a proven pass rusher on the opposite side austin booker showed signs down the stretch last year but can he take his game to another level is there enough down the line will shemar turner be healthy following last october s acl tear the questions up front are echoed on the back end where the bears are replacing both starting safeties coby bryant and cam lewis are solid but can they produce as many turnovers as the previous crew the key is first round pick dillon thieneman will the rookie be ready to thrive in dennis allen s scheme by week 1 3 two questions on the offensive line ozzy trapilo s patellar tendon injury in the wild card round means the bears can t count on the left tackle for at least the beginning of the season veteran braxton jones is penciled into the starting lineup but he will have to win the battle with jedrick wills and theo benedet to earn the week 1 assignment the position is one to keep an eye on the rest of the o line profiles as one of the better units in the nfl but if the left side becomes leaky it could be a cascading problem also i m going to keep tabs on the center spot the bears replaced drew dalman who abruptly retired this offseason with garrett bradbury as the presumptive starter however second round rookie logan jones could push the veteran for the starting gig during camp back to top three key storylines 1 offensive line overhaul the lions offensive line collapsed last season swiftly going from asset to liability detroit attacked the unit flipping penei sewell to left tackle drafting blake miller to man the right edge signing center cade mays and adding veteran depth at each spot how the line shakes out will be the main storyline to track during camp is sewell s transition going smoothly is miller a plug and play rookie or does he need time to adjust the key will be young guards christian mahogany and tate ratledge who struggled with consistency in 2025 will the duo improve or could they get pushed out of the starting lineup if the lions don t get better blocking in 2026 the explosive potential will be squandered 2 this is gibbs backfield sonic is now the featured character in detroit the offseason trade of david montgomery calcified the reality that jahmyr gibbs bell cow era is full go gibbs began to take over the majority of the backfield touches last season and his reps should continue to grow the lions likely won t want the dual threat back to creep to the 300 carry threshold but barring injury he ll blast past his career high of 250 totes gibbs should also see his role in the passing game continue to rise after posting a career best 77 catches for 616 yards and five touchdowns in 2025 gibbs combination of shiftiness speed and ability to make hay between and outside the tackles makes him a dynamic threat the lions want to ensure that threat stays on the field as much as possible he profiles for a christian mccaffrey type workload and should be in the offensive player of the year discussion by the end of the season with the expected rise in reps gibbs extension is also one we ve been waiting to see this offseason the lions have gotten in front of extensions in recent years so everyone expects a top of the rb market contract for gibbs to come barreling down the pike 3 can detroit return to health detroit has significant injuries to track at the onset of camp tight end sam laporta is the name to watch on offense but the defense has greater concerns brian branch suffered a late season achilles tear and while the lions haven t put a hard timeline on the safety s recovery it will be a surprise if he s good to go to open the season the bigger question is whether given the type of injury he sustained branch will be his normal buzzing self at all this season then there is kerby joseph whose knee injury limited him to just six games last season the lions have given few tangible updates on the safety s status while taking a wait and see approach without certainty from either starter the lions secondary sits in a precarious spot couple that with the release of cb terrion arnold and detroit could be relying once again on filler and journeymen in the defensive backfield back to top three key storylines 1 who rushes the passer until micah returns after tearing up his knee last december micah parsons is set to start camp on the physically unable to perform list and in all likelihood he ll start the season on pup wiping out his first four games there is always the chance parsons gets back earlier but given how he spoke about his timetable last month i expect him and the club to play it safe sans the dynamic pass rusher for the opening gambit there are significant questions up front in green bay the offseason trade of rashan gary made sense for the club but his absence further highlights a shallow edge group the packers need former first round pick lukas van ness to finally find his footing how he looks early in camp could tell us if green bay needs to add another veteran fourth round rookie dani dennis sutton also could have some say in that plan until parsons returns this might be a mix and match crew van ness is the key to whether the pack can survive the early portion of the calendar 2 jacobs uncertainty looms large josh jacobs situation continues to hover over the franchise after he was arrested in may at this stage it s unclear how local authorities will handle the situation in turn we don t know whether the league will take disciplinary action jacobs was on the field with his team last month and if things remain unchanged he should be there for camp if any action is taken against jacobs it could have a significant impact on the on field product in green bay jacobs is the workhorse and engine of the ground attack if he s unavailable or gets injured during the season matt lafleur s offense could be in some trouble next up are former undrafted free agent chris brooks a third down back and marshawn lloyd who has been unable to stay healthy the packers believe lloyd finally has turned a corner but until we see it in action that s a projection we can t assume we need to see the third year back produce during camp and into the preseason while staying healthy in the process 3 pass catching puzzle solved the pass catching unit in green bay is also something i m intrigued by the packers watched romeo doubs leave in free agency and traded dontayvion wicks then they inked jayden reed and christian watson to extensions those two and 2025 first rounder matthew golden comprise the top receiving trio with a clearer rotation at wr i believe the three can each thrive golden is the one to watch after he finished an uneven rookie campaign with a productive effort four catches for 84 yards and a score in the packers wild card weekend loss at chicago there are some depth questions particularly given the crew s injury history so that battle among reserves will be worth tracking tucker kraft s health is another piece to keep an eye on despite tearing his acl last november the pivotal playmaker is aiming to be ready for week 1 could he return with a new contract as well back to top three key storylines 1 kyler vs j j competition or coronation vikings coach kevin o connell continues to insist he s running a legitimate quarterback competition he keeps having to say it because frankly not many believe that j j mccarthy has a shot to keep kyler murray out of the starting lineup perhaps we ll be stunned but every indicator suggests it s murray s job to lose the former no 1 overall pick enters with proven ability while mccarthy has struggled when on the field and had issues staying healthy murray could open up the offense and his propensity to force feed his top targets could be a harbinger of a justin jefferson bounce back this competition in whatever form that takes will be tracked daily come camp within that context i m interested in how murray fits into koc s system and whether his mobility adds an element we haven t seen much of in minnesota over the past few years 2 next men up on the edge the trade of jonathan greenard took a chunk out of the defense not only because greenard was a proven disruptor but also due to the fact that the vikings now aren t very flush at the position dallas turner whom the club is counting on to have a full breakout in year 3 and andrew van ginkel sit atop the edge rusher corps but bo richter chaz chambliss and tyler batty are the next three players up on the depth chart they ve combined for one career sack chambliss defensive lineman tyrion ingram dawkins has also taken some reps on the edge the vikings could look to add another veteran rusher during camp or early in the season we trust brian flores defense but a coach who generally relies on vets who understand his system will be asking a lot out of youngsters how rookies caleb banks domonique orange jakobe thomas and charles demmings make the transition will have a significant say in the vikings outcome this season 3 one last dance with hitman we expected to have a resolution one way or the other on harrison smith s future surprisingly the situation still lingers will he return for another go or will he officially retire the club has made it clear they d welcome a return and didn t add a veteran to take smith s place jakobe thomas a third round pick was the only significant addition the club made to the safety crew given how much flores relies on the versatility of his safeties a return by smith would have a significant impact if he decides to retire jay ward theo jackson and thomas will battle for reps keep an eye on thomas and charles demmings in camp and preseason each could play key roles in 2026 back to top

news_mentions.headline: Chicago Bears training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Kevin Patra provides a refresher on the Chicago Bears' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the chicago bears offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 19 rookies july 22 veterans location halas hall lake forest illinois fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at miami dolphins sunday aug 10 at 1 p m et nfl network week 2 vs buffalo bills sunday aug 17 at 8 p m fox week 3 at kansas city chiefs thursday aug 22 at 8 20 p m et 2025 schedule note the bears are one of just seven teams that are not scheduled to play on a thursday this season however they will play the eagles on black friday nfl research what you need to know 1 a new hope wafts through chicago like a dense fog rolling in off lake michigan the arrival of ben johnson created a palpable buzz around the bears that an offense perpetually stuck in the mud might finally take flight johnson proved in his three seasons calling plays in detroit that he can manufacture explosives on the ground and through the air it was more than just the gadget or trick plays johnson s intelligence and play sequencing are some of the best in the nfl like a good boxer who can set up a knockout punch johnson knows how to counter a defense the bears stealing johnson from a division rival is the most significant coup for quarterback caleb williams who experienced a rollercoaster rookie season it s been an incredible offseason for williams his new coach and offense are a massive improvement the offensive line was dramatically rebuilt and should be the most improved blocking group in the league the additions of tight end colston loveland and wide receiver luther burden provide dynamic playmaking to grow with the young signal caller everything is built for williams to thrive in 2025 hey maybe the bears will finally join modern football with a qb throwing for 4 000 yards for the first time in club history one question entering camp is the running back rotation chicago didn t add a back until kyle monangai in the seventh round will d 39 andre swift bounce back behind a better offensive line will roschon johnson play the david montgomery role in johnson s offense we know the new coach wants to lean on the ground game to springboard the passing attack but does he have the horses in chicago 2 the bears drafted three second rounders in 2025 normally that s not a notable fact in mid july however this season there is a holdup on second round picks signing their contracts as of publication 30 remain unsigned the delay stems from the top two second rounders receiving fully guaranteed contracts the first in nfl history to do so for the bears the standoff is significant with receiver luther burden offensive tackle ozzy trapilo and defensive tackle shemar turner all in line for prominent roles out of the gate editor s note turner agreed to his rookie contract on thursday after this story was published if the issue remains unresolved pushing into august we could see the rookies presence early in the season curtailed bears fans will remember roquan smith starting his rookie season on a pitch count after an elongated contract dispute missed time in camp is significant for first year players we haven t seen burden on the field since he suffered a soft tissue injury in rookie minicamp trapilo could be in a position to battle for the left tackle gig if braxton jones isn t healthy 3 the biggest camp battle in chicago could be the left tackle job braxton jones fractured his ankle in december and didn t participate this offseason jones was solid in 2024 allowing 26 pressures in 12 games the injury could open the door for ozzy trapilo to swipe the gig particularly if jones isn t healthy to open the season obviously if the second rounder remains unsigned and jones can t practice the lt gig becomes an even bigger question 2024 third round pick kiran amegadjie struggled mightily when tossed into the fire last season but should get a clean slate under ben johnson another competition to keep an eye on is at the corner position where tyrique stevenson will attempt to avoid being unseated by terell smith and rookie zah frazier for the starting gig opposite jaylon johnson and nickel back kyler gordon

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 9 Sunday aftermath: Myles Garrett's return buoys Rams; Jordan Love, Joe Burrow shine
news_mentions.description: Kevin Patra breaks down the key storylines from Week 9's slate of games on Sunday, including Myles Garrett's return to action for the Rams and the explosive outings from Jordan Love and Joe Burrow.
news_mentions.body_text: we re at the season s halfway point and sunday saw a number of teams and quarterbacks make loud statements as we gear up for 2026 s stretch run the nfc north continues to be an absolute buzzsaw of a division going 3 0 on sunday with the vikings set to face the bills on monday night the afc north is shaping up to be a two team race and the seahawks got back over 500 with sam darnold sidelined let s examine some key storylines in sunday s aftermath including prolific packers attack fueled by deep ball burrow marching toward first mvp another one score win for payton s broncos giants overcome adversity once again stroud s historic afternoon in los angeles but first we start with the rams who saw the return of their prized offseason acquisition and immediately reaped the benefits garrett to the rams rescue welcome back myles garrett the nfl sack champion returned from a seven game stint on injured reserve to bolster the rams pass rush which had struggled to pester signal callers without the two time defensive player of the year garrett didn t just return to the lineup on sunday no no no he blasted off like a heat seeking missile at commanders quarterback jayden daniels first there was the second quarter strip sack that set up points then in the fourth quarter garrett walloped daniels twice for two pivotal sacks that helped seal the win on a day the offense couldn t find a groove man it was a weight off my shoulders garrett said of the three sacks that helped key l a s 20 13 win in his return from september knee surgery just getting back to who i am i m nowhere near where i want to be as far as like my performance and the things i know i can do how i can move but this is a confidence booster for sure just try to boost the confidence of the guys around me as well garrett played 35 of 58 defensive snaps 60 3 in his return from injury he generated six pressures and three sacks on 27 pass rushes 22 2 pressure rate per next gen stats getting the dominant edge rusher back will also make aaron donald more menacing sunday was the first time this season that garrett and donald were active together with both on the field 23 plays the rams defense allowed 5 0 yards per play and recorded four sacks per ngs on all other plays the defense allowed 8 1 yards per play and one touchdown with zero sacks as the duo plays together more the upside is enormous garrett s return is massive for a rams squad that has struggled this season they re finally on the right side of 500 at 5 4 but still have work to do to get into playoff positioning with puka nacua s reported knee injury adding uncertainty to sean mcvay s offense the l a d might need to carry the load for the next few weeks editor s update sean mcvay told reporters monday that wr puka nacua has mcl and pcl sprains and a turf toe injury and will probably be placed on injured reserve packers air it out to demolish pats many offenses prefer to dink and dunk their way down the field executing the kind of safe approach that doesn t put the ball at risk and keeps the attack in advantageous down and distance situations and then there is green bay jordan love entered sunday already leading the league in splash plays then he dropped dime after dime after deep dime on a bewildered patriots defense in foxborough the packers qb along with burner christian watson 7 171 1 and ascending second year wideout matthew golden 10 164 1 made pats star cb christian gonzalez look like a sixth round scrub putting himself squarely in the mvp conversation love generated 372 passing yards three passing touchdowns and a regular season career high 153 2 passer rating in green bay s 45 27 shellacking of the patriots he joined aaron rodgers as the only packers quarterbacks with multiple passing touchdowns in at least eight of the first nine games of a season with rodgers doing so in 2011 and 2020 winning mvp in each of those seasons love s 153 2 passer rating in week 9 is the highest by any packers quarterback in a regular season start since rodgers had a perfect 158 3 against the raiders in 2019 it really doesn t matter who it is on defense love said after the game we trust the game plan and trust guys are gonna get open and make plays it s the nfl we see great dbs every week our mindset is we gotta keep attacking attack they did love was flawless and his deep shots were on the freaking money when he s driving the ball downfield hitting receivers in stride there isn t a prettier sight in the game right now love completed 10 of his 12 downfield pass attempts 10 air yards for 294 yards and two touchdowns against the patriots the third most downfield passing yards by a quarterback this season per next gen stats he averaged 24 5 yards per attempt on those downfield passes the fifth most in a single game since 2018 he completed six of his eight deep attempts 20 air yards for 235 yards and one touchdown better still love was pressured on nine pass attempts he completed six of those for 153 yards averaging a whopping 17 0 ypa when pressured per ngs those numbers are pure comedy but it s crazy because i know there s probably a lot more in there golden said we ve still got so many more plays out there to make there are still aspects to clean up with the offensive line still somewhat of a mess and the ground game not getting into gear until late with josh jacobs now dealing with a fractured finger the pack could use some rb help jonathan taylor anyone but when love is on the money and his two dynamic receivers aren t flubbing passes the pack can score with anyone with the lions escaping miami on sunday with a 19 9 win over the fighting fins and the bears overcoming five turnovers to best the buccaneers at home the nfc north continues to be the hottest division in the league is anyone playing better than burrow jordan love is on fire but joe burrow has been blazing for a month the bengals quarterback in sunday s 34 17 win over the falcons generated his fourth straight game with at least four passing rushing touchdowns tied for the second longest streak since 1970 behind only peyton manning s five game streak in his 2004 mvp season per nfl research over the past four tilts burrow has a thrown hilarious 16 touchdown passes while completing 77 of his passes becoming just the fourth qb fifth instance overall to pull off that feat joining tom brady 2007 manning 2013 and russell wilson 2015 and 2020 joe is playing at an unbelievably high level right now bengals head coach zac taylor said joe doesn t force the ball he takes the ball where it needs to go based on the looks and even if sometimes they re leaning into a guy or doubling a guy he s still going to give him an opportunity and some of those opportunities came up big for us so that s just something we re used to it helps to have ja 39 marr chase 10 155 1 and tee higgins 5 32 2 on your side as they did at lsu burrow and chase toasted falcons corner a j terrell with a 47 yard td bomb to get the ball rolling on a 24 point first half that all but sealed a win in madrid before the break chase was asked after the game if burrow is playing like an mvp i can t answer that because i ve been playing with him my whole life so it s kind of hard for me to sit up here and say that chase said but i ve been thinking he should have won the mvp i said this when we went to the super bowl that year and he didn t get it that year i mean he s up for it every year broncos magic in one score games continues credit sean payton s squad for continuing to come up clutch streaking to their fifth consecutive victory on sunday four of which have come by less than a touchdown sunday s 26 21 win over the panthers came after trailing by one point entering the fourth quarter the broncos fifth win of the season after trailing at any point in the fourth that ties the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings for the most wins after trailing in the fourth quarter in a team s first nine games of a season since 2000 per nfl research both the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings lost their first playoff game on wild card weekend i think it s just the character of our guys the toughness competitiveness of our guys broncos quarterback bo nix said after the game we re just comfortable in that moment when things get close there at the end of the game whatever it is we have had a couple scores and then we always want to make it one score just glad we re on this side and winning em the broncos jumped out to a 10 0 advantage before the panthers got back in the game and took a third quarter lead carolina controlled the middle portion of the game but nix and co took over late with two fourth quarter touchdown drives capped by a 26 yard strike from nix to pat bryant after the offense failed to get a game sealing first down late the defense stepped up and forced a fumble to squash the panthers final drive i just think we ve been there before so we know how to handle the situation nik bonitto who had the game sealing strip sack of bryce young said at the end of the day it was our job as a defense to just go out and finish the victory set an nfl record with their 16th consecutive regular season win in a one score contest broncos games are rarely normal sunday s included a miraculous interception in the end zone that took a replay review of when payton s challenge flag was thrown before it could be reviewed we could say the magic will eventually run out and the broncos will regress to the mean in one score games however there have been enough of them to admit it s part of the makeup of payton s broncos maybe it will never be pretty but that win column sure looks nice right now for the 7 2 squad harbaugh s giants keep finding ways to win it s not just that john harbaugh has guided the giants to the top of the nfc east with a 5 2 1 record it s how they ve morphed into a reliable steady team that stands in stark contrast to the past decade plus of ineptitude for the most part the giants haven t beaten themselves sure there was cam skattebo s fumble against washington that led to a week 5 tie and jameis winston s early turnover barrage in their week 6 loss to new orleans but big blue has become better at not letting things unravel on sunday against a reeling eagles squad in a place lincoln financial field that has been a bugaboo for new york for a dozen years things could have spiraled out of control particularly when j j mccarthy exited due to a hip injury instead winston entered and calmly converted a third down and a fourth down to lead the giants only td drive of the game he then handed the reins back to mccarthy who finished out the win it was a prime example of all 46 active players doing their part to secure a victory perhaps more important than the offense doing just enough is a defense coming on strong under coordinator dennard wilson in previous years new york s offensive struggles got most of the attention despite the fact that the limp d had been equally or more disappointing given the up front talent under wilson this unit is a bullying menace stopping a sleepy eagles offense that saw joe milton start his first career game on sunday isn t anything to write home about on the surface but how new york did it is very noteworthy most notable arvell reese was a dominant force the rookie earned a career high three sacks and led the giants with 12 tackles becoming the first rookie since at least 1994 to record three sacks and at least 10 tackles in a game per nfl research reese joins fellow top five pick david bailey of the jets as the only rookies with at least three sacks in a game this season defensive rookie of the year that s set in stone cornerback greg newsome said of reece per the new york daily news now we re looking at defensive player of the year the superlatives for the rookie linebacker are just starting i don t know any young players that can do the things he does i m gonna be honest with you veteran defensive tackle d j reader said maybe the kid in seattle no 3 nick emmanwori because you don t find a kid that can cover the way he can cover come down and fill gaps in the run game rush the passer doesn t miss tackles kid s serious man it s special to watch he s really special the offense will come and go especially if the rushing attack is slowed like sunday but if big blue can rest its hat on a defense led by a dynamic rookie linebacker the giants can still run away with the nfc east week 9 sunday spotlight

news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 9 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 9 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below madrid cincinnati bengals 34 atlanta falcons 17 early window denver broncos 26 carolina panthers 21 dallas cowboys 27 indianapolis colts 23 kansas city chiefs 35 new york jets 12 detroit lions 19 miami dolphins 9 new orleans saints 23 cleveland browns 22 ot new york giants 19 philadelphia eagles 11 los angeles rams 20 washington commanders 13 late window houston texans 44 los angeles chargers 22 san francisco 49ers 38 las vegas raiders 17 green bay packers 45 new england patriots 27 seattle seahawks 17 arizona cardinals 3 sunday night chicago bears 27 tampa bay buccaneers 24 jeremy bergman s takeaways cincy s stars sizzle in espana few teams have had better 10 quarter stretches than the bengals over the past three weeks since being shut out in the first half against baltimore in week 7 cincinnati has responded with 112 points over two and a half games leading the way is joe burrow staking a strong claim in the mvp race burrow was lethal again on sunday in the first half leading cincy s offense to four scoring drives on 9 3 yards per play and completing 82 of his passes for 239 yards eight of those completions went to ja 39 marr chase who set a career high with 142 yards in the first half finishing with 155 and a score on 10 catches showcasing his dynamic ability on an international stage for the first time tee higgins boxed out c j henderson and atlanta s defensive backs for two tds even chase brown season high 6 3 ypc and cincinnati s anemic run game season best 123 yards showed some explosion after sunday s romp cincinnati has now won four straight games with at least 30 points scored for the first time in franchise history if the bengals are capable of this type of production weekly do they even need to swing big for a piece possibly at running back at the trade deadline that s a question for tuesday maybe atlanta will have an answer for cincy s offensive onslaught by then another big bijan day undone by atlanta errors a week after losing to a tampa team that didn t complete a pass the falcons found a more traditional way to fall sunday morning play leaky defense commit penalties repeat in pristine climate controlled conditions inside madrid s bernabeu there were no excuses for atlanta s performance first the positives michael penix threw three fewer interceptions than he did a week prior and scrambled for a career high 50 yards looking svelte and nimble on the spanish pitch bijan robinson who loves an exclusive window rushed for 100 again totaling 147 yards from scrimmage and one td on the day the elusive dynamo was right at home at the home of real madrid s galacticos but jeff ulbrich s defense was a sieve against the nfl s hottest attack allowing 7 1 yards per play and forcing just two punts on the day atlanta also committed 12 accepted penalties for 88 yards repeatedly setting back the offense the falcons o line committed two fouls in the red zone on their second drive leading to the first field goal of a touchdown fight its most critical error though came at the start of the fourth quarter when down two tds at the bengals 10 yard line atlanta was called for offensive holding on a third and 2 incompletion cincy accepted the penalty and forced a fourth and 12 settling for cutting a two score lead to a two score lead nick folk instead shanked a 38 yard field goal and the bengals lead held at 14 the falcons never got closer a tale of two divisions despite the result cincinnati and atlanta will both return to the states tied in the win column for leads in their respective divisions the bengals victory moved them into a 6 2 tie atop the afc north with the steelers setting up a critical sunday night football showdown on the banks of the ohio river in week 10 having already lost this season to pittsburgh the bengals need a home win against aaron rodgers and co to improve their division record and ensure no favor in the head to head tiebreaker down in the cursed nfc south the falcons at 3 6 are nowhere near out of it but are at risk of falling behind hotter clubs after sunday s slate atlanta is essentially tied with carolina 3 5 new orleans 3 5 and tampa bay 3 6 a needed bye awaits for the falcons after a week 10 matchup with patrick mahomes chiefs next gen stats insight for bengals falcons via nfl pro joe burrow was pressured on nine of 32 dropbacks 28 1 against the falcons completing 20 of 23 passes for 237 yards and two touchdowns when kept clean his time to pressure of 3 26 seconds was the longest of his career and the falcons defense had just one quick pressure in the game nfl research joe burrow and ja marr chase connected for their 19th touchdown of at least 40 yards in sunday s win tied with joe montana and jerry rice for the third most by any qb receiver duo since 1980 the only duos with more are peyton manning and marvin harrison 21 tds and steve young and jerry rice 20 tds their first quarter touchdown was the 58th score by the duo overall including playoffs which passed daunte culpepper and randy moss for second most by any qb receiver duo before age 30 trailing only dan marino and mark clayton 68 tds back to top nick shook s takeaways broncos win a game of runs it wasn t quite an avalanche but as is often the case in basketball sunday s game became a tale of runs what began as a one sided contest in favor of denver reversed course just before halftime sunday when the panthers turned an interception into a scoring possession to claw back into the competition that shift in momentum saw bryce young enter a flow state dotting the field with precise confident passes and leading a second scoring drive to double up between halves and put the panthers in a 14 13 lead he appeared poised to extend that lead in the fourth too but a wacky interception snagged by denver safety devon key stopped the panthers in their tracks and swung momentum back in favor of the broncos who rattled off two straight touchdown drives to take a 26 14 lead in the final period good for their latest fourth quarter comeback effort denver had to hang on for dear life in the final minutes after carolina mounted one final push and it s not exactly a resounding victory but it s the latest example of a contending team finding a way to win a back and forth contest by coming through in the most important moments and finishing in a style that fits the team s strengths with edge rusher nik bonitto strip sacking young to stop the panthers final drive in its tracks bo nix looked more like the passer we ve known him to be too a small but encouraging sign as the calendar creeps toward thanksgiving panthers defensive changes fail to produce improvement defensive coordinator ejiro evero became the fall guy when coach dave canales relieved him of his duties following carolina s week 8 loss to green bay installing an interim dc with the hopes it might improve the panthers inconsistent defense in short it didn t the panthers allowed denver to break 300 yards of total offense and mount two touchdown drives that appeared vastly different but produced the same result the first fourth quarter scoring march covered 80 yards over 14 plays while the other needed just six plays to gain 61 yards and finish with a wide open touchdown pass to pat bryant as a result of a blown coverage a symptom of a defense that is still scrambling to take care of the details carolina stood tall late buying its offense a chance to compile a game winning drive but the earlier breakdowns represent a persistent issue had cornerback corey thornton not made an incredibly athletic play on the ball to pick off nix this game might have snowballed out of control in the first half long before the panthers offense was able to climb back into the game had jaylen waddle not exited due to a head injury denver might have continued to rely on the playmaker to break open for big gains this unit was never going to be completely fixed in one week but sunday told us there s still plenty to correct nix begins to break out of his shell it didn t last throughout the entire game but seemingly for the first time in ages bo nix took the training wheels off his own bicycle and let himself play a bit more instinctively proof existed in his decisions made while rolling out in which nix twice opted to throw back against his body to open targets underneath instead of accepting a small scramble gain or throwing it away his bullet ripped through traffic to courtland sutton for a touchdown was another encouraging sign because he was willing to take a minor risk and when bryant streaked open through the carolina secondary nix didn t hesitate to put the ball on him for a score the results are evident in his stat line 25 of 37 237 yards two touchdowns one interception it s not a massive change in performance but it s a start broncos fans have been yearning to see for weeks we ll see if it s a sign of things to come next gen stats insight for broncos panthers via nfl pro bo nix posted a 124 2 passer rating against single high coverage 20 of 26 for 202 yards and two touchdowns but a 15 3 passer rating against split safety coverage 5 of 11 for 35 yards and an interception his 15 3 passer rating against split safety looks was his lowest in a game since his nfl debut in week 1 2024 nfl research the broncos won 26 21 in week 9 against the panthers after trailing by one point entering the fourth quarter their fifth win of the season after trailing at any point in the fourth that is tied with the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings for the most wins after trailing in the fourth quarter in a team s first nine games of a season since 2000 both the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings lost their first playoff game that season in the wild card round back to top kevin patra s takeaways cowboys survive collapse to secure a much needed win over colts brian schottenheimer s squad tried to give the game away luckily the cowboys opponent did a better job dallas built a 10 point lead deep into the third quarter mistakes then gave indianapolis life ceedee lamb fumbled late the cowboys second turnover of the day to wipe out a chance to put the game away despite putting up stats with george pickens out lamb had a mistake filled day in addition to the fumble he was called for offensive pass interference twice and couldn t toe tap a td that cost the cowboys four points in the red zone dallas couldn t get out of its own way for much of the contest dak prescott was far more off the mark than we re used to leading to stalled drives schotty s club was called for 14 penalties for a whopping 153 yards turned the ball over twice and missed a late go ahead field goal that s how you let an opponent amid a fire sale stay in a game despite being outgained 508 271 dallas should have run away with the game instead it trailed late until ryan flournoy the best no 3 wr in the league made a massive play for a 46 yard gain to set up the game winning td a loss would have all but doomed the cowboys who still have a big hill to climb in the nfc east colts offense can t kick it into gear until late facing a bad cowboys defense daniel jones and co couldn t take advantage for long stretches indy went three and out five times including on four of its first five drives the other was a 19 yard td drive following a dak prescott fumble jones was inconsistent and often off the mark completing 20 of 34 passes for 180 yards with a td and an interception the cowboys d entered the game allowing a league high 385 4 yards per game and 5 9 yards per play 29th indy generated just 271 yards and 4 6 yards per play while going 3 for 13 on third down ashton dulin s 55 yard catch and run td was indy s only pass play longer than 16 yards jones averaged 2 6 air yards per completion in the game third fewest of his career minimum 10 completions per next gen stats against a dallas d that s been ripped up jones needed to do more the rushing attack did some solid work generating 105 total yards on the ground with seth mcgowan earning 7 5 yards per carry on six totes with a td if sunday was jonathan taylor s final game in indy mcgowan flashed some upside to take over the bulk of the workload downs calls game when javonte williams scored the go ahead touchdown with a little over a minute remaining the big question was whether a sieve dallas d could hold on caleb downs ensured it would by stepping in front of a daniel jones pass sealing the win over his brother josh downs squad the int capped a game in which downs generated a sack three tackles a qb hit a tackle for loss and two passes defensed allowing just one reception on four targets sunday marked the first time all season that the cowboys defense allowed fewer than 318 total yards doing so against a team that s begun a mid season teardown is one thing the cowboys will have a stiffer test against kyle shanahan and the 49ers in week 10 next gen stats insight for cowboys colts via nfl pro ceedee lamb caught six of 12 targets for 180 yards and a touchdown on downfield throws 10 plus air yards in week 9 against the colts the most receiving yards he has recorded on downfield throws in his career nfl research sunday marked dak prescott s first game with 300 plus passing yards multiple passing touchdowns no interceptions and a game winning drive since 2018 in a week 17 win against the giants prescott had one such game in each of his first three career seasons but none from 2019 2025 back to top bobby kownack s takeaways k9 scores touchdowns kenneth walker s reign of terror over the rest of the league took a couple weeks break as the running back was held to 105 rushing yards and no touchdowns over the previous two contests after torching opponents for 665 rushing yards and eight total scores in his first five outings as a chief unfortunately for the jets his dominance s brief hiatus ended sunday walker was a man on a mission versus gang green almost singlehandedly keeping kansas city afloat amid a slow start that included two fumbles a three and out and a missed field goal over the opening two quarters kansas city s other two first half drives ended a bit differently on 7 and 25 yard touchdown receptions by walker he provided the offensive spark while patrick mahomes worked to piece together a consistent passing game using anyone else and after the rest of the operation caught up to walker s heroics to start pulling away from the jets he added a 2 yard td run in the third quarter walker finished with 102 rushing yards a 5 7 per carry average and four runs of 10 plus yards as well as four catches for 41 yards that s after he was able to take a rest midway through the fourth quarter due to a blowout he helped create he now has five games with multiple scrimmage touchdowns the most in the nfl this season and the most by a chiefs running back since larry johnson eight in 2005 wilson is sorely missed by jets there was a lot of intrigue surrounding new york s offense heading into week 9 how would the jets mix breece hallback into the rotation after braelon allen excelled to such a degree during the starter s four game absence how would the passing offense operate without garrett wilson after omar cooper and adonai mitchell recently took turns breaking out for new york as far as the running backs hall saw 18 touches to allen s 10 with hall turning his into 87 yards and allen totaling 54 both running backs averaged 4 1 yards per carry as for the passing offense it was ugly wilson had appeared frustrated in recent weeks as he produced smaller numbers than his counterparts hauling in 12 catches for 153 yards without a score over his previous three games before sustaining a concussion but it s clear he makes the offense go without the star there to demand attention from kansas city s secondary the chiefs had little problem shutting down geno smith smith threw for only 165 yards cooper led the way with 58 yards on eight receptions while mitchell went from 142 yards on seven catches last week to zero catches on seven looks a game later new york got nothing going settling for four field goals in the first half tied for the most over the last 10 seasons in the second half the jets didn t even get the opportunity to settle smith and co managed 58 yards over five drives on the other side of intermission forced to watch their two point halftime deficit unravel into a 23 point loss chiefs come alive for much needed blowout kansas city rode a two game losing streak into week 9 with a 22 fourth quarter point differential that ranked 31st in the league over the past two games if there s one thing patrick mahomes is going to do though it s beat up on bad teams by defeating the jets he moved to 18 0 in his career against teams entering a matchup four plus games under 500 the best by any quarterback since 1970 minimum 15 starts per nfl research he went 23 of 31 for 242 yards and two touchdowns with a 117 9 passer rating but most importantly seemed ok after a strip sack by david bailey late in the second quarter bent his elbow awkwardly and forced him to receive medical attention on the sideline he returned and overcame a frustrating offensive stupor to blow the doors off the jets while the chiefs defense minimized damage early and inflicted plenty of it throughout kansas city pressured geno smith on half of his dropbacks chris jones and george karlaftis led the team with six pressures and two sacks apiece while drue tranquill logged 13 tackles and nick bolton had 12 plus a forced fumble detractors will point out it s only the jets and there are still some issues to work out think harrison butker missing a 56 yard field goal and the subsequent 51 yarder after getting a reprieve due to an offsides penalty just before half but the chiefs can only play who is in front of them in this case they demolished them next gen stats insight for jets chiefs via nfl pro travis kelce caught four of six targets for 72 yards accounting for two of the chiefs five explosive passes 40 0 nfl research kenneth walker had his first career game with multiple receiving touchdowns to go along with a rushing touchdown in the chiefs win over the jets his second career game with three touchdowns back to top bobby kownack s takeaways usual suspects lift detroit to tightly contested win sunday s victory over miami was not your typical lions affair jared goff and the offense took forever to get going and it seemed as if they knew things weren t quite clicking the lions pulled out all the stops against their one win opponent they went for it on fourth down on the first drive a few plays later jahmyr gibbs took a direct snap and faked a pitch to goff before streaking around the edge for 16 yards two plays into the second quarter detroit converted a fake punt throw by jack fox on fourth and 7 from its own 30 the lions constantly stalled out failing to score a touchdown until 1 20 remained in the third quarter and that was a run by gibbs on fourth down too luckily they had a couple stars to lean on to help guide them through their struggles amon ra st brown was the main source of the team s passing offense deep into the final frame at the start of the lions seventh drive of the game he had seven catches while the rest of detroit s pass catchers had combined for six st brown drew a third down pass interference penalty early on that possession and a few plays later hauled in a key 17 yard catch on third and 8 to keep the chains moving with a perilous seven point lead he eventually finished with 86 yards on eight receptions every other lion combined for 10 catches and 95 yards and though gibbs was frequently met by a pod of dolphins in the backfield he still broke off a number of clutch gainers including the aforementioned 8 yard td run he finished with a game high 74 rushing yards that was about it for offensive highlights but it was enough miami wastes strong defensive performance jeff hafley s defense fought valiantly against the league s no 3 scoring offense if only the rest of the team had been able to repay the group s efforts the dolphins consistently crashed into detroit s backfield to locate jahmyr gibbs containing the electric back who had been averaging 4 9 yards per carry entering week 9 to 3 7 yards per attempt on 20 rushes jared goff struggled to find and hit open passers throwing for a season low 170 yards he was sacked three times and tossed just his second pick of the season to rookie corner chris johnson after josh uche hit his arm during the throwing motion the dolphins didn t bend to the point of allowing a touchdown the only one of the game until the waning minutes of the third quarter malik willis and the offense could do nothing with their opportunities however willis threw for only 128 yards and an interception and seemed hesitant to open it up on the ground two carries for 7 yards while ollie gordon was held to 55 rushing yards when the fins had a chance to make it a tie game heading into halftime they instead committed a holding penalty and missed a 38 yard field goal on the final two plays of the second quarter toward the start of the fourth quarter down 10 with the ball at detroit s 7 yard line willis took two sacks over the next three plays before miami settled for a three points gut wrenching mistakes are no way to beat a contender like the lions and the dolphins certainly made their share of them ugly game all around one of the biggest concerns for any 5 2 team traveling to face a 1 6 opponent is typically avoiding playing down to the lesser squad s level the lions absolutely joined the dolphins in the doldrums for a messy matchup that will have neither side coming away feeling particularly happy the lions and dolphins combined for 20 accepted penalties with detroit committing nine to miami s 11 they went 7 for 24 on third down collectively detroit managed only 270 yards nearly 100 fewer than its previous low on the season 355 miami posted its second lowest yardage total of the year with 228 thanks to the offensive ineptitude a few of the most exciting plays of the matchup were actually fake punts both teams ran one and both teams converted on passes one by lions punter jack fox and another by dolphins punter bradley pinion it was the first time since at least 1950 that multiple punters have completed a pass in the same game per nfl research give credit to the lions defense for showing up and making life miserable for the dolphins but detroit didn t exactly put an exclamation point on this one despite running its winning streak to four next gen stats insight for lions dolphins via nfl pro aidan hutchinson matched up against austin jackson 16 times in week 9 all one on one recording six pressures 37 5 pressure rate including two quick pressures under 2 5 seconds nfl research jahmyr gibbs recorded his 60th career touchdown tying hall of famer ladainian tomlinson for the second most by any player in their first four seasons in nfl history trailing only hall of famer terrell davis with 61 back to top nick shook s takeaways saints come alive to earn much needed win by all accounts sunday was an ugly display of football between two middling teams for most of the afternoon a field goal fest including a charlie smyth first half miss set up for what appeared to be a likely 9 6 finish until the browns finally hit a big play for a touchdown when shedeur sanders connected with rookie kc concepcion for a 64 yard passing touchdown the score seemed to position the browns for another fourth quarter comeback win but instead it awoke the saints with just enough time for chaos to ensue new orleans covered 55 yards in six plays and 50 seconds to take a 16 13 lead allowed the browns to tie the game with 0 08 left then embarked on an efficient relentless 74 yard scoring drive that required 11 plays and ended with a pretty touchdown pass from tyler shough to juwan johnson for a 23 16 lead in overtime the stop of cleveland s two point try in overtime sealed the win but it was only made possible by some late success that must have felt for saints fans like the thawing of an offense that spent far too long frozen within a glacier at 3 5 the saints are back in the thick of a race for an nfc south crown that might only require nine wins to secure if they re going to get there sunday s late push toward a victory was essential browns show clear weaknesses in brutal defeat cleveland has lost its ability to stop the run since losing maliek collins to injury and delivered an embarrassing effort against the saints low ceiling rushing attack sunday allowing audric estim 233 who was a member of the browns less than a month ago tyler shough and alvin kamara to run for 155 yards on 31 attempts pacing an offense that came to life thanks to this newfound balance in the second half even worse cleveland s pass coverage unit struggled losing one on one matchups all afternoon grant delpit ronnie hickman and tyson campbell each struggled in such matchups and especially in the game s most crucial moments e g juwan johnson s overtime touchdown and a 33 yard completion from shough to chris olave late in the fourth quarter paired with an offense that wasn t threatening for most of the afternoon with sanders at quarterback cleveland was guaranteed to be locked in a four quarter battle with a team most expected it to defeat without a major struggle instead the browns fell in a fashion that is a strong competitor with their week 1 blowout loss to jacksonville for worst defeat of the season that s not a good place to be in in week 9 shough finds his stride new orleans offense has lacked juice for some time now draining the saints of their early season optimism that was tied to the trajectory of tyler shough in his second nfl season that finally changed in the fourth quarter sunday when cleveland stunned the superdome crowd with an explosive touchdown pass from shedeur sanders to kc concepcion new orleans offense woke up stringing together well designed passing plays with a rushing attack that finally showed some life to move down the field with relative ease against a browns defense that had limited it all afternoon shough was at the center of all of it calmly dropping dimes on chris olave juwan johnson and even rookie jordyn tyson to propel the offense to two clutch touchdown drives in a wild fourth quarter and overtime period we saw the return of a composed accurate shough whose clutch gene reappeared after going into hiding over the last month the timing couldn t be better for this saints team which will be in a weekly fight for survival in an nfc south that remains wide open there s no guarantee their rushing success carries over but getting shough back on track was a massively important development for coach kellen moore who was able to demonstrate some of his expertise in how he called the game in the final period plus the extra frame next gen stats insight for browns saints via nfl pro shedeur sanders completed three of his six downfield attempts for 154 yards and a touchdown against the saints with all six attempts occurring in the second half and overtime sanders fourth quarter deep pass to jerry jeudy set up a game tying field goal attempt that sent the game to overtime sanders added 55 5 win probability on downfield attempts a career high mark nfl research this is the fourth game in nfl history including playoffs with 12 or fewer combined points in the first three quarters to feature at least 33 combined points in the fourth quarter and overtime philadelphia eagles cleveland browns in 1982 35 points new york yanks chicago bears in 1951 35 points and news_mentions.headline: Bears QB Caleb Williams undaunted by 4-INT night in win over Bucs: 'I'm going to keep grippin' it, keep rippin' it'
news_mentions.description: Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams threw four interceptions, but led the game-winning drive to move to 7-2 on the season.
news_mentions.body_text: caleb williams career high four interception night in a last second 27 24 win over the tampa bay buccaneers won t make the chicago bears quarterback gun shy i m going to throw until i can t throw anymore williams said via espn that s how i live i work my tail off to be in this position i ll never not throw the ball i could throw 100 picks in one game if it comes down to it i m going to throw that pass that i did to tight end https www nfl com players colston loveland or if it s a tighter window i m going to rip it in there that s how i grew up that s who i am i don t get gun shy that s not me that s not my identity that s not who i am with that i m going to keep grippin it keep rippin it and coach calls it it s time to go make a play the four ints were the most for williams in the nfl college or high school per nfl research chicago got off to a scorching start sunday night with williams ripping off platform throws all over the field as the bears built a 14 0 lead on two flawless drives then the interceptions started williams threw picks on three of the next four drives he got greedy on his first int trying to fit a ball to rome odunze at the goal line between two defenders his next two turnovers were poor attempts to throw the ball away the final int came when bucs cornerback jacob parrish tipped a pass and linebacker alex anzalone snagged it through it all the bears maintained their lead with a ferocious defensive effort that kept forcing punts and generated a couple of turnovers of their own chicago s fifth turnover came late in the fourth quarter when wide receiver luther burden took a helmet shot that caused a concussion and fumbled deep in his own territory tampa turned the fumble into the game tying td and converted the two point try despite the second half struggles in which chicago had a single first down on its first six drives williams let it rip on the final possession the qb converted a big first down coming out of the two minute warning then found colston loveland deep for 38 yards to set up the game winning field goal despite the displeasure i might be presenting right now there s a lot of good in terms of building this team that comes from a win like this because it s like i said one it s hard to win under those circumstances coach ben johnson said we really haven t been in that situation where in the fourth quarter with little time left needing to go and field goal touchdown whatever that is it just hasn t happened a whole lot this year and yet i feel like our guys we are prepped for that and we re ready for it that s what i know now after going through that i know as a play caller i certainly felt great it was as calm as i felt on calling plays there that last drive as i was all game long sunday marked the third time since 2000 the bears have won a game committing at least five turnovers the previous two such games came in the 2006 season when they appeared in super bowl xli williams four ints were the most by any quarterback in a win since jared goff had five interceptions in a week 10 2024 win over the texans also on sunday night football williams performance against the bucs blitzes told the story he started 7 of 10 for 124 yards and two touchdowns against the blitz then he went 4 of 10 for 22 yards and three interceptions on his next nine drives on the game winning drive he completed 3 of 4 passes for 52 yards against the blitz they sent the same blitz a couple of times and they got through and that s what happens williams said when a defense sends a similar blitz or sends a blitz over and over that just means that they re getting through that means they re going to keep going until we stop it we have to find ways to get better we have to find ways to push through that we have to find ways when it does happen we have to make the adjustments and then when it does happen i have to be the big eraser it wasn t pretty for williams whose impressive 70 completion percentage entering the game took a hit but it didn t cost the bears a win in a hotly contested nfc north race and that s what really matters
