news_mentions.headline: AFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bills, Dolphins, Jets, Patriots
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Jeremy Bergman breaks down the top AFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and New York Jets.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots and new york jets catch up on each afc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots new york jets three key storylines 1 new era in buffalo for a bills roster that is returning most of its 2025 starters the biggest change this summer will be at the top the start of the joe brady era in buffalo gets underway in earnest when training camp kicks off in late july in taking over for sean mcdermott a sturdy leader who oversaw buffalo s longest period of sustained success since the great marv levy was at the helm brady has a lot to live up to the 36 year old first time head coach was elevated to improve on mcdermott s performance and lift buffalo over the hump and into the super bowl a january title game can t be won in august but the foundation of such an achievement can be built in the summer as it is for all champions brady s job starts and ends with accentuating what josh allen does best freeing up the qb to take further control of the offense the defense mcdermott s specialty has been handed off to ex nfl safety jim leonhard who coached the broncos star dbs over the past couple seasons no team with a new head coach is better positioned to win in 2026 than the bills who made it to the divisional round in 25 brady s first camp must set that tone 2 chubb chasing big season as one of buffalo s only notable offseason additions bradley chubb meets the bills at a critical time for both the team and the player chubb is coming off a solid comeback season from his torn acl logging 8 5 sacks for the dolphins in 2025 and playing a full slate of games for the first time since his rookie campaign the bills are in dire need of a pass rusher after gregory rousseau led the team with just seven sacks last year and joey bosa appears closer to retirement than returning entering the fray alongside second round pick t j parker chubb will be tasked with captaining a front seven that struggled to frustrate trevor lawrence and bo nix in the 2025 postseason chubb 30 has expressed that he s never been hungrier buffalo is starving for a true game wrecker off the edge 3 moore enough or more required the bills have missed stefon diggs draftees khalil shakir and keon coleman and free agent additions josh palmer and brandin cooks haven t quite filled his vacancy over the past couple years buffalo s trade for dj moore is meant to do just that reuniting with brady his ex panthers oc moore has an opportunity to be wr1 for josh allen in buffalo in a way he simply wasn t for caleb williams in chicago in 2025 the seeds of their hopefully fruitful partnership will be sowed in july and august moore admitted to growing pains in the spring but expects perfection this fall after the offseason long onboarding process in addition to providing a sure handed outlet for allen moore will be looked at to bring along the embattled coleman who got called out by owner terry pegula in january and has been under a microscope since if moore can bring coleman along and elevate a middling bills wr room then brady s first year returns could be big back to top three key storylines 1 first look at miami s offensive overhaul tua tagovailoa tyreek hill and jaylen waddle are out malik willis is in while de 39 von achane re upped for the long haul who else will fill out the dolphins offensive roster malik washington returns as a solid pass catching option joined by tutu atwell jalen tolbert terrace marshall and jalen reagor all looking to break out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top

news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 9 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 9 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below madrid cincinnati bengals 34 atlanta falcons 17 early window denver broncos 26 carolina panthers 21 dallas cowboys 27 indianapolis colts 23 kansas city chiefs 35 new york jets 12 detroit lions 19 miami dolphins 9 new orleans saints 23 cleveland browns 22 ot new york giants 19 philadelphia eagles 11 los angeles rams 20 washington commanders 13 late window houston texans 44 los angeles chargers 22 san francisco 49ers 38 las vegas raiders 17 green bay packers 45 new england patriots 27 seattle seahawks 17 arizona cardinals 3 sunday night chicago bears 27 tampa bay buccaneers 24 jeremy bergman s takeaways cincy s stars sizzle in espana few teams have had better 10 quarter stretches than the bengals over the past three weeks since being shut out in the first half against baltimore in week 7 cincinnati has responded with 112 points over two and a half games leading the way is joe burrow staking a strong claim in the mvp race burrow was lethal again on sunday in the first half leading cincy s offense to four scoring drives on 9 3 yards per play and completing 82 of his passes for 239 yards eight of those completions went to ja 39 marr chase who set a career high with 142 yards in the first half finishing with 155 and a score on 10 catches showcasing his dynamic ability on an international stage for the first time tee higgins boxed out c j henderson and atlanta s defensive backs for two tds even chase brown season high 6 3 ypc and cincinnati s anemic run game season best 123 yards showed some explosion after sunday s romp cincinnati has now won four straight games with at least 30 points scored for the first time in franchise history if the bengals are capable of this type of production weekly do they even need to swing big for a piece possibly at running back at the trade deadline that s a question for tuesday maybe atlanta will have an answer for cincy s offensive onslaught by then another big bijan day undone by atlanta errors a week after losing to a tampa team that didn t complete a pass the falcons found a more traditional way to fall sunday morning play leaky defense commit penalties repeat in pristine climate controlled conditions inside madrid s bernabeu there were no excuses for atlanta s performance first the positives michael penix threw three fewer interceptions than he did a week prior and scrambled for a career high 50 yards looking svelte and nimble on the spanish pitch bijan robinson who loves an exclusive window rushed for 100 again totaling 147 yards from scrimmage and one td on the day the elusive dynamo was right at home at the home of real madrid s galacticos but jeff ulbrich s defense was a sieve against the nfl s hottest attack allowing 7 1 yards per play and forcing just two punts on the day atlanta also committed 12 accepted penalties for 88 yards repeatedly setting back the offense the falcons o line committed two fouls in the red zone on their second drive leading to the first field goal of a touchdown fight its most critical error though came at the start of the fourth quarter when down two tds at the bengals 10 yard line atlanta was called for offensive holding on a third and 2 incompletion cincy accepted the penalty and forced a fourth and 12 settling for cutting a two score lead to a two score lead nick folk instead shanked a 38 yard field goal and the bengals lead held at 14 the falcons never got closer a tale of two divisions despite the result cincinnati and atlanta will both return to the states tied in the win column for leads in their respective divisions the bengals victory moved them into a 6 2 tie atop the afc north with the steelers setting up a critical sunday night football showdown on the banks of the ohio river in week 10 having already lost this season to pittsburgh the bengals need a home win against aaron rodgers and co to improve their division record and ensure no favor in the head to head tiebreaker down in the cursed nfc south the falcons at 3 6 are nowhere near out of it but are at risk of falling behind hotter clubs after sunday s slate atlanta is essentially tied with carolina 3 5 new orleans 3 5 and tampa bay 3 6 a needed bye awaits for the falcons after a week 10 matchup with patrick mahomes chiefs next gen stats insight for bengals falcons via nfl pro joe burrow was pressured on nine of 32 dropbacks 28 1 against the falcons completing 20 of 23 passes for 237 yards and two touchdowns when kept clean his time to pressure of 3 26 seconds was the longest of his career and the falcons defense had just one quick pressure in the game nfl research joe burrow and ja marr chase connected for their 19th touchdown of at least 40 yards in sunday s win tied with joe montana and jerry rice for the third most by any qb receiver duo since 1980 the only duos with more are peyton manning and marvin harrison 21 tds and steve young and jerry rice 20 tds their first quarter touchdown was the 58th score by the duo overall including playoffs which passed daunte culpepper and randy moss for second most by any qb receiver duo before age 30 trailing only dan marino and mark clayton 68 tds back to top nick shook s takeaways broncos win a game of runs it wasn t quite an avalanche but as is often the case in basketball sunday s game became a tale of runs what began as a one sided contest in favor of denver reversed course just before halftime sunday when the panthers turned an interception into a scoring possession to claw back into the competition that shift in momentum saw bryce young enter a flow state dotting the field with precise confident passes and leading a second scoring drive to double up between halves and put the panthers in a 14 13 lead he appeared poised to extend that lead in the fourth too but a wacky interception snagged by denver safety devon key stopped the panthers in their tracks and swung momentum back in favor of the broncos who rattled off two straight touchdown drives to take a 26 14 lead bears down the field thanks mostly to a 38 yard hook up with a wide open colston loveland the final drive set up cairo santos for a game winning 38 yard field goal with zeroes on the clock it wasn t takeaways cincy s stars sizzle in espana few teams have had better 10 quarter stretches than the bengals over the past three weeks since being shut out in the first half against baltimore in week 7 cincinnati has responded with 112 points over two and a half games leading the way is joe burrow staking a strong claim in the mvp race burrow was lethal again on sunday in the first half leading cincy s offense to four scoring drives on 9 3 yards per play and completing 82 of his passes for 239 yards eight of those completions went to ja 39 marr chase who set a career high with 142 yards in the first half finishing with 155 and a score on 10 catches showcasing his dynamic ability on an international stage for the first time tee higgins boxed out c j henderson and atlanta s defensive backs for two tds even chase brown season high 6 3 ypc and cincinnati s anemic run game season best 123 yards showed some explosion after sunday s romp cincinnati has now won four straight games with at least 30 points scored for the first time in franchise history if the bengals are capable of this type of production weekly do they even need to swing big for a piece possibly at running back at the trade deadline that s a question for tuesday maybe atlanta will have an answer for cincy s offensive onslaught by then another big bijan day undone by atlanta errors a week after losing to a tampa team that didn t complete a pass the falcons found a more traditional way to fall sunday morning play leaky defense commit penalties repeat in pristine climate controlled conditions inside madrid s bernabeu there were no excuses for atlanta s performance first the positives michael penix threw three fewer interceptions than he did a week prior and scrambled for a career high 50 yards looking svelte and nimble on the spanish pitch bijan robinson who loves an exclusive window rushed for 100 again totaling 147 yards from scrimmage and one td on the day the elusive dynamo was right at home at the home of real madrid s galacticos but jeff ulbrich s defense was a sieve against the nfl s hottest attack allowing 7 1 yards per play and forcing just two punts on the day atlanta also committed 12 accepted penalties for 88 yards repeatedly setting back the offense the falcons o line committed two fouls in the red zone on their second drive leading to the first field goal of a touchdown fight its most critical error though came at the start of the fourth quarter when down two tds at the bengals 10 yard line atlanta was called for offensive holding on a third and 2 incompletion cincy accepted the penalty and forced a fourth and 12 settling for cutting a two score lead to a two score lead nick folk instead shanked a 38 yard field goal and the bengals lead held at 14 the falcons never got closer a tale of two divisions despite the result cincinnati and atlanta will both return to the states tied in the win column for leads in their respective divisions the bengals victory moved them into a 6 2 tie atop the afc north with the steelers setting up a critical sunday night football showdown on the banks of the ohio river in week 10 having already lost this season to pittsburgh the bengals need a home win against aaron rodgers and co to improve their division record and ensure no favor in the head to head tiebreaker down in the cursed nfc south the falcons at 3 6 are nowhere near out of it but are at risk of falling behind hotter clubs after sunday s slate atlanta is essentially tied with carolina 3 5 new orleans 3 5 and tampa bay 3 6 a needed bye awaits for the falcons after a week 10 matchup with patrick mahomes chiefs next gen stats insight for bengals falcons via nfl pro joe burrow was pressured on nine of 32 dropbacks 28 1 against the falcons win a game of runs it wasn t quite an avalanche but as is often the case in basketball sunday s game became a tale of runs what began as a one sided contest in favor of denver reversed course just before halftime sunday when the panthers turned an interception into a scoring possession to claw back into the competition that shift in momentum saw bryce young enter a flow state dotting the field with precise confident passes and leading a second scoring drive to double up between halves and put the panthers in a 14 13 lead he appeared poised to extend that lead in the fourth too but a wacky interception snagged by denver safety devon key stopped the panthers in their tracks and swung momentum back in favor of the broncos who rattled off two straight touchdown drives to take a 26 14 lead in the final period good for their latest fourth quarter comeback effort denver had to hang on for dear life in the final minutes after carolina mounted one final push and it s not exactly a resounding victory but it s the latest example of a contending team finding a way to win a back and forth contest by coming through in the most important moments and finishing in a style that fits the team s strengths with edge rusher nik bonitto strip sacking young to stop the panthers final drive in its tracks bo nix looked more like the passer we ve known him to be too a small but encouraging sign as the calendar creeps toward thanksgiving panthers defensive changes fail to produce improvement defensive coordinator ejiro evero became the fall guy when coach dave canales relieved him of his duties following carolina s week 8 loss to green bay installing an interim dc with the hopes it might improve the panthers inconsistent defense in short it didn t the panthers allowed denver to break 300 yards of total offense and mount two touchdown drives that appeared vastly different but produced the same result the first fourth quarter scoring march covered 80 yards over 14 plays while the other needed just six plays to gain 61 yards and finish with a wide open touchdown pass to pat bryant as a result of a blown coverage a symptom of a defense that is still scrambling to take care of the details carolina stood tall late buying its offense a chance to compile a game winning drive but the earlier breakdowns represent a persistent issue had cornerback corey thornton not made an incredibly athletic play on the ball to pick off nix this game might have snowballed out of control in the first half long before the panthers offense was able to climb back into the game had jaylen waddle not exited due to a head injury denver might have continued to rely on the playmaker to break open for big gains this unit was never going to be completely fixed in one week but sunday told us there s still plenty to correct nix begins to break out of his shell it didn t last throughout the entire game but seemingly for the first time in ages bo nix took the training wheels off his own bicycle and let himself play a bit more instinctively proof existed in his decisions made while rolling out in which nix twice opted to throw back against his body to open targets underneath instead of accepting a small scramble gain or throwing it away his bullet ripped through traffic to courtland sutton for a touchdown was another encouraging sign because he was willing to take a minor risk and when bryant streaked open through the carolina secondary nix didn t hesitate to put the ball on him for a score the results are evident in his stat line 25 of 37 237 yards two touchdowns one interception it s not a massive change in performance but it s a start broncos fans have been yearning to see for weeks we ll see if it s a sign of things to come next gen stats insight for broncos quarter williams had completed six of his eight pass attempts for 105 yards and two touchdowns each of the incompletions coming on drops thereafter williams was an atrocious 16 of 29 for 174 yards zero touchdowns a career worst four interceptions and a 33 5 rating in all the bears had five turnovers with williams first three picks coming on ill advised balls in which he appeared to be trying to throw the ball away while fading back and going airborne his fourth was off a deflection and the fifth giveaway was a burden fumble that set up the game tying score burden looked to have potentially gone limp on the hit that forced him to drop possession and suffered a concussion chicago s defense was truly the catalyst for the victory but it wouldn t be possible without williams brilliance early and his final drive dramatics ahead of this one the bears were getting crowned as the new super bowl darlings nothing comes easy in the nfl though and if chicago is to fulfill some high expectations williams must recover get his swagger back and be able to balance it without making the never before seen errors he did on a night in which he and his bears escaped with a w bucky defense have bucs flirting with comeback nine minutes into sunday s proceedings the buccaneers were down 14 points the bears running roughshod on both sides of the ball somehow someway tampa bay made a game of this and came oh so close to a stunning win the somehow was the bucs defense and the someway was bucky irving the defense had the aforementioned quintet of takeaways and held the bears offense to six points after giving up touchdowns on the first two drives zyon mccollum had a pair of picks alex anzalone had an interception and four qb pressures and josiah trotter brought the hat all night long leading a hard hitting defensive effort offensively irving did his best to do it all the squiggly runner had a game high 97 yards on 20 carries and both of tampa s touchdowns he added a team high four receptions for 28 yards it was irving who scored from 6 yards out with 2 51 to go to bring the score to 24 22 baker mayfield then ran in the tying two point conversion mayfield was limping throughout much of the game and it s been made clear that just as the defense is the hallmark of tampa s success irving is the motor driving the bucs offense with tampa sitting at 3 0 this season when irving hits 100 yards rushing he fell just short this night and so did the bucs fortunately at 3 6 the bucs are in the nfc south and right in the thick of the race for the division crown defense saves bears leads win after a torrid start the chicago offense went rogue as it pertained to the script the defense was savage throughout however with jeffery simmons austin booker and the gang absolutely brutalizing baker mayfield and a jaylon johnson interception return for a touchdown keying the win the simmons effect is real so far with the acquisition of the pro bowl defensive tackle having spurred the defense to back to back excellent outings a week after grounding the seahawks the bears got stellar outings from devin bush nine tackles cam lewis six tackles interception simmons sack and booker sack four qb pressures johnson the high priced pro bowler has been terrible for most of the season as his 38 1 pro football focus grade would attest however with the bears clinging to a 17 13 lead and the buccaneers driving johnson jumped on a mayfield pass and weaved 67 yards the other way for a touchdown for a team to have five turnovers and still come out with a victory is next door to astonishing and the bears defense allowing the buccaneers to score just 10 points off those turnovers is the biggest reason why next gen stats insight for buccaneers bears via nfl pro the buccaneers blitzed caleb williams on 26 of 41 dropbacks 63 4 tied for the third most blitzes any quarterback has faced in a game this season williams was pressured on 13 of those 26 blitzes 50 but was sacked just once he started 7 of 10 for 124 yards and two touchdowns against the blitz went 4 of 10 for 22 yards and three interceptions on his next nine drives and completed 3 of 4 passes for 52 yards against the blitz on the bears game winning drive nfl research zyon mccollum s brilliant toe tapping interception in the second quarter was his career best third of the season each of them coming over the last three games mccollum who added another later in the first half became the first buccaneers player to record an interception in three straight games since lavonte david in 2013 williams four total interceptions were a career high having never thrown that many in an nfl game in college or high school back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFL midseason All-Rookie Team: Arvell Reese, David Bailey pacing 2026 draft picks
news_mentions.body_text: before the 2026 nfl draft the main debate was over who would be the first non quarterback selected david bailey or arvell reese now at the midway point of the season the debate rages on who is the nfl 39 s rookie of the year is it one of those two defensive stars both have played at extremely high levels with bailey among the most disruptive pass rushers in the league and reese creating a diverse impact using his versatility those two players were easy picks for this exercise other positions weren 39 t as simple our midseason nfl all rookie team quarterback first team jalon daniels tampa bay buccaneers the nfl has yet to see a 2026 draft pick start at quarterback so by default the undrafted daniels retains the spot he held on the quarter mark all rookie team one of the reasons daniels went undrafted was his high turnover rate which has carried over to the nfl he has more interceptions than touchdowns in two of three starts but daniels deserves credit for his week 5 performance as he led the buccaneers to a win over the cowboys he was turnover free that thursday night and used his mobility to avoid negative plays second team joe fagnano baltimore ravens nbsp with all due respect i guess this spot goes to fagnano he is the only other rookie also undrafted to start a game it didn 39 t go well at all but facing the jaguars who rank second in the nfl in scoring defense in your starting debut is a tough ask fagnano ranks second among all rookies in completions and first downs honorable mention fernando mendoza raiders athan kaliakmanis commanders jack strand falcons running back first team jonah coleman denver broncos despite a stint on injured reserve coleman has made a strong case as the nfl 39 s most impactful rookie back he is the only rookie with multiple rushing touchdowns and is tied for the rookie lead with 13 first down carries despite having far fewer attempts than others on the leaderboard coleman has also been productive in the passing game with 13 catches on 14 targets for 128 yards late in the fourth quarter against the chiefs he had a crucial 51 yard catch and run that set up denver 39 s go ahead touchdown a 5 yard run by coleman second team emmett johnson kansas city chiefs johnson ranks seventh among rookies in rushing yards but you can better understand his impact when factoring in receiving production through eight games he has 348 yards of total offense 237 receiving 111 rushing which ranks no 1 among rookie running backs he is also the only rookie back with both a rushing and receiving touchdown honorable mention kaelon black 49ers mike washington raiders jeremiyah love cardinals jadarian price seahawks seth mcgowan colts wide receiver first team denzel boston cleveland browns kc concepcion cleveland browns carnell tate tennessee titans no surprises here the same three names atop the rookie wr rankings at the quarter mark remain in place at the midway point they 39 re led by boston the seventh receiver drafted in april he leads all rookies in receiving yards 507 first down receptions 21 and receiving touchdowns three against the saints on sunday boston recorded his third catch of 50 plus yards which ties him with green bay 39 s christian watson for the nfl lead not far behind is concepcion who scored his first nfl touchdown on sunday in new orleans he ranks no 1 among rookies in receptions 37 and second in receiving yards 437 concepcion also leads all rookie receivers in catches of 20 plus yards eight and yards after the catch 237 which ranks top 20 in the nfl one spot behind amon ra st brown tate slots in just behind the browns 39 rookie duo with 34 catches for 413 yards and one touchdown he was exceptional at ohio state in contested situations and has continued that success in the nfl eight catches on nine contested targets however tate also leads all rookie receivers with four drops and three fumbles second team omar cooper new york jets makai lemon philadelphia eagles germie bernard pittsburgh steelers it has been a small yet impressive sample size from cooper despite almost all his production having come in three games he ranks fifth among rookies in receiving yards 306 and second with a pair of touchdown grabs lemon is tied with concepcion for the rookie lead with 37 receptions while bernard has helped expand the steelers 39 offense using his nose for the sticks honorable mention caleb douglas dolphins antonio williams commanders ted hurst buccaneers kevin coleman dolphins malachi fields giants chris bell dolphins josh cameron jaguars barion brown saints tight end first team kenyon sadiq new york jets the first tight end drafted in 2026 leads all rookie tight ends in catches 21 and receiving yards 235 each game sadiq seems to have a catch on which he is asked to high point and finish showing off his ball skills at different elevations most of his snaps have come in a detached alignment but he has been a capable run blocker when inline 37 7 percent of his snaps second team eli raridon new england patriots with 16 catches for 225 yards raridon joins sadiq as the only rookie tight ends with more than 150 receiving yards raridon leads all rookie tight ends in first down receptions 11 and is one of only two with multiple touchdown catches despite having a brutal drop on a potential walk in touchdown against the packers raridon also leads all rookie tight ends in blocking snaps and has kept his head above water in that area honorable mention nate boerkircher jaguars matthew hibner ravens josh cuevas ravens sam roush bears will kacmarek dolphins offensive tackle first team max iheanachor pittsburgh steelers blake miller detroit lions there isn 39 t a rookie offensive tackle running away with the top spot they 39 ve all been up and down iheanachor has had his share of struggles especially in the run game which was expected considering his inexperience but he hasn 39 t been a liability and the pittsburgh offensive line as a unit has been much better since he became the full time starter at right tackle in week 3 miller has probably been the most consistent rookie ot having allowed just one sack in seven starts at right tackle second team spencer fano cleveland browns markel bell philadelphia eagles fano 39 s tape has been full of high highs and low lows he has struggled against better talent see chase young this past sunday but he played above average against the jets titans and ravens before that fano has performed well enough to believe he can be a long term solution for the browns honorable mention kahlil benson chiefs monroe freeling panthers caleb lomu patriots travis burke chargers jayden williams cardinals interior offensive line first team vega ioane baltimore ravens austin barber cleveland browns francis mauigoa new york giants whether the ravens have needed him at guard or center ioane has been up for the challenge he hasn 39 t given up a sack since week 1 and has been the steadiest run blocker of all rookie offensive linemen barber is coming off arguably his worst game as a pro but there has been far more good than bad on his rookie tape he has been an iron man while battling through injuries and is tied with his teammate fano for the rookie lead in snaps played 588 i had higher hopes for mauigoa a top 10 pick but he has been good enough at right guard second team kadyn proctor miami dolphins jake slaughter los angeles chargers emmanuel pregnon jacksonville jaguars proctor had a strong case for the first team and it won 39 t be a surprise if he 39 s there before the end of the season slaughter has been solid although his rookie missteps have been costly mistakes pregnon leads the jaguars in snaps played but his mistakes are starting to add up nfl high 10 penalties honorable mention nbsp trey zuhn raiders keylan rutledge texans logan taylor chargers fernando carmona titans edge rusher first team david bailey new york jets gabe jacas new england patriots there isn 39 t much debate for the top two spots bailey leads all rookies in sacks 7 5 tackles for loss 11 forced fumbles five also tied for the league lead and pressures 31 he has taken his game to another level over his last four outings including a disruptive afternoon against patrick mahomes and the chiefs on sunday jacas is second among rookie edge rushers in sacks three and pressures 26 and he 39 s added an interception off aaron rodgers no less he needs to show better discipline with missed tackles and damaging penalties two roughing the passer two offsides but jacas has outplayed his draft spot second team dani dennis sutton green bay packers akheem mesidor los angeles chargers despite not being a starter dennis sutton has become a valuable role player on sub downs he ranks third among all rookies in pressures 23 and sacks three and he 39 s made an impact on kick and punt return coverage also coming off the bench mesidor has been one of the better all around rookie defensive linemen making plays both in pass rushing and in stopping the run he posted a career high seven pressures against the texans on sunday honorable mention r mason thomas chiefs cashius howell bengals romello height 49ers rueben bain buccaneers derrick moore lions caden curry colts defensive tackle first team gracen halton san francisco 49ers skyler gill howard detroit lions defensive tackle was not a strong position in the 2026 nfl draft and unsurprisingly it has been light in rookie output the 49ers had d line questions entering the season but halton has helped provide some answers he ranks third among all rookies in tackles for loss five and had one of the coolest rookie moments of the season when he forced a fumble against the seahawks and recovered it for his first nfl touchdown unfortunately halton suffered a broken ankle on sunday which will end his rookie season a subpackage defender gill howard ranks third on the lions and leads all rookie interior linemen in pressures 16 he was a day 3 steal second team lee hunter carolina panthers darrell jackson new york jets hunter is averaging fewer than 25 snaps per game but he is making the most of his playing time even if he isn 39 t dominating the box score you can feel his impact on tape jackson 39 s snap count has steadily increased too as he 39 s earned more trust from the coaching staff he leads all rookie defensive tackles in tackles 26 and has stacked positive reps see his week 8 snaps vs tyler linderbaum honorable mention chris mcclellan packers peter woods chiefs aaron hall panthers caleb banks vikings lt overton cowboys linebacker first team arvell reese new york giants jacob rodriguez miami dolphins reese terrorized the eagles this past sunday to the tune of 12 tackles three sacks and a forced fumble on a sack that took just 2 29 seconds the fastest sack in the nfl since week 7 of last season according to nextgenstats reese was my top ranked player in the 2026 draft and he hasn 39 t disappointed his main appeal as a prospect was his versatility which is also why he is one of the favorites for defensive rookie of the year he is the only nfl player not just among rookies with 65 plus tackles eight plus tackles for loss and at least one interception add in his forced fumble from sunday and 4 5 sacks and reese has made an impact for the nfc east leading giants there are multiple other rookie linebackers with a case to be on the first team but rodriguez has filled up the stat sheet 79 tackles four tackles for loss one forced fumble and one interception his most impressive stat though is an nfl best 33 34 defensive stops 34 reese ranks second with 32 second team anthony hill tennessee titans josiah trotter tampa bay buccaneers sonny styles washington commanders any of these three linebackers easily could have joined reese on the first team it 39 s a loaded year for rookies at the position hill averages 10 3 tackles per game which ranks third in the nfl behind only alex singleton and nakobe dean trotter has always been a hammer looking for a nail against the run but his improvements in coverage are promising styles and roquan smith are the only nfl linebackers with 67 plus tackles eight plus pressures and at least one interception and one forced fumble honorable mention kendal daniels falcons jaishawn barham cowboys harold perkins falcons jaden dugger 49ers bryce boettcher colts cj allen colts cornerback first team brandon cisse green bay packers mansoor delane kansas city chiefs this was a tough category because of the volatility from the rookie cb class cisse who leads all rookie corners in snaps played had some rough moments over the first month of the season but he has been stacking positive outings since the start of october over his last five games cisse has allowed zero touchdowns and just 50 percent completions when targeted along with four passes defended and one interception delane has missed three games because of a right shoulder injury but he performed at a high level in the five games he was on the field despite playing half the number of snaps as cisse he has almost as many passes defended four and the same number of interceptions one it helps that he has been strong as a tackler and has yet to commit a penalty second team davison igbinosun buffalo bills malik muhammad chicago bears igbinosun is one of nine nfl players and the only rookie with at least five pass breakups and one interception he was known for his hands on approach in coverage at ohio state and that has followed him to the nfl but he also does a great job using his length to suffocate passing windows over the past three games he has allowed only two catches with two pass breakups and his first career interception i was ready to put hezekiah masses here because he leads all rookies with three interceptions but his coverage tape over the last month just hasn 39 t been good enough muhammad has been banged up and had some rough patches as well see the packers game but he has played more reliable football honorable mention will lee panthers daylen everette steelers hezekiah masses raiders jermod mccoy raiders colton hood giants nickelback first team keionte scott tampa bay buccaneers scott fell further than expected on draft night because he is a very specific type of player an undersized nickel who is much better downhill than in reverse but when used in the correct role scott can shine and he has played well for a fast and physical bucs defense he has almost as many solo tackles as styles and is tied with caleb downs for the most defensive stops 14 among rookie dbs second team chris johnson miami dolphins nbsp johnson who just turned 22 this week has shown his youth at times but i have been impressed with his resiliency especially given that miami has used him both inside and outside johnson notched his first career interception on sunday off jared goff honorable mention kenneth harris colts keith abney lions avieon terrell falcons chandler rivers ravens d 39 angelo ponds jets safety first team treydan stukes las vegas raiders caleb downs dallas cowboys it can be tough not to have recency bias for an exercise like this but stukes 39 interception on sunday against the 49ers helped land him on the first team stukes now has a pair of interceptions and is tied for the rookie lead with three passes defended there certainly have been ups and downs for downs but he is coming off one of his most impactful games of his young career against the colts and his older brother josh downs he finished with three tackles two passes defended one sack and his first nfl interception to seal a win second team zakee wheatley carolina panthers dillon thieneman chicago bears wheatley has made his presence felt in different ways for the panthers he had a forced fumble in his nfl debut then picked off jordan love in week 8 for his first career interception his consistency in both run support and coverage has been an exciting development thieneman hasn 39 t been as consistent but he leads all rookie safeties in tackles 52 and we have seen an uptick in chicago 39 s willingness to vary his role including letting him loose as a blitzer honorable mention emmanuel mcneil warren browns michael taaffe dolphins genesis smith chargers a j haulcy colts robert spears jennings steelers xavier nwankpa chiefs kicker first team drew stevens washington commanders stevens has been the most consistent of the rookie kickers connecting on 12 of 12 field goal attempts of under 50 yards he had a few missed extra points early in the season but has been more reliable over the past month honorable mention trey smack packers dominic zvada giants punter first team tommy doman buffalo bills doman could have earn this spot solely based on his jarring hit on a kickoff against the vikings to force a fumble but he also ranks third in the nfl in hangtime 4 62 seconds with a respectable 43 2 yard net average honorable mention nbsp ryan eckley ravens brett thorson vikings this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL fantasy football waiver wire, Week 10: Jordyn Tyson, Tank Dell headline top 15 targets
news_mentions.description: Which players should you scoop up to give your fantasy team a boost heading into Week 10? Matt Okada spotlights the best waiver-wire targets at each position, with rookie Jordyn Tyson topping the board at wide receiver.
news_mentions.body_text: nine sundays of fantasy football are in the books time for the week 10 waiver wire some of the names listed below might end up winning leagues at the very least several of them could be difference makers in the immediate future do not take the waiver wire for granted this is where the rubber meets the road in our imaginary game i ll be here every week from now until fantasy championships hope to have you along for the full ride let s win some hardware notes players must be rostered in less than 60 of espn leagues to be eligible for the column all statistics come courtesy of next gen stats unless otherwise noted top 15 overall waiver wire targets this ranking is conditional depending on the seriousness of rhamondre stevenson s knee injury this ranking is a prospective bet on jonathan taylor being traded before tuesday s 4 p m et deadline and here are my top waiver wire targets by position quarterbacks running backs wide receivers tight ends note new england s hunter henry is rostered in 61 of leagues making him barely ineligible for this column but he should be the top te priority if he s available ahead of a week 10 matchup with the lions in munich germany defenses

news_mentions.headline: AFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bills, Dolphins, Jets, Patriots
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Jeremy Bergman breaks down the top AFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and New York Jets.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots and new york jets catch up on each afc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots new york jets three key storylines 1 new era in buffalo for a bills roster that is returning most of its 2025 starters the biggest change this summer will be at the top the start of the joe brady era in buffalo gets underway in earnest when training camp kicks off in late july in taking over for sean mcdermott a sturdy leader who oversaw buffalo s longest period of sustained success since the great marv levy was at the helm brady has a lot to live up to the 36 year old first time head coach was elevated to improve on mcdermott s performance and lift buffalo over the hump and into the super bowl a january title game can t be won in august but the foundation of such an achievement can be built in the summer as it is for all champions brady s job starts and ends with accentuating what josh allen does best freeing up the qb to take further control of the offense the defense mcdermott s specialty has been handed off to ex nfl safety jim leonhard who coached the broncos star dbs over the past couple seasons no team with a new head coach is better positioned to win in 2026 than the bills who made it to the divisional round in 25 brady s first camp must set that tone 2 chubb chasing big season as one of buffalo s only notable offseason additions bradley chubb meets the bills at a critical time for both the team and the player chubb is coming off a solid comeback season from his torn acl logging 8 5 sacks for the dolphins in 2025 and playing a full slate of games for the first time since his rookie campaign the bills are in dire need of a pass rusher after gregory rousseau led the team with just seven sacks last year and joey bosa appears closer to retirement than returning entering the fray alongside second round pick t j parker chubb will be tasked with captaining a front seven that struggled to frustrate trevor lawrence and bo nix in the 2025 postseason chubb 30 has expressed that he s never been hungrier buffalo is starving for a true game wrecker off the edge 3 moore enough or more required the bills have missed stefon diggs draftees khalil shakir and keon coleman and free agent additions josh palmer and brandin cooks haven t quite filled his vacancy over the past couple years buffalo s trade for dj moore is meant to do just that reuniting with brady his ex panthers oc moore has an opportunity to be wr1 for josh allen in buffalo in a way he simply wasn t for caleb williams in chicago in 2025 the seeds of their hopefully fruitful partnership will be sowed in july and august moore admitted to growing pains in the spring but expects perfection this fall after the offseason long onboarding process in addition to providing a sure handed outlet for allen moore will be looked at to bring along the embattled coleman who got called out by owner terry pegula in january and has been under a microscope since if moore can bring coleman along and elevate a middling bills wr room then brady s first year returns could be big back to top three key storylines 1 first look at miami s offensive overhaul tua tagovailoa tyreek hill and jaylen waddle are out malik willis is in while de 39 von achane re upped for the long haul who else will fill out the dolphins offensive roster malik washington returns as a solid pass catching option joined by tutu atwell jalen tolbert terrace marshall and jalen reagor all looking to break out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top

news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 9 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 9 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below madrid cincinnati bengals 34 atlanta falcons 17 early window denver broncos 26 carolina panthers 21 dallas cowboys 27 indianapolis colts 23 kansas city chiefs 35 new york jets 12 detroit lions 19 miami dolphins 9 new orleans saints 23 cleveland browns 22 ot new york giants 19 philadelphia eagles 11 los angeles rams 20 washington commanders 13 late window houston texans 44 los angeles chargers 22 san francisco 49ers 38 las vegas raiders 17 green bay packers 45 new england patriots 27 seattle seahawks 17 arizona cardinals 3 sunday night chicago bears 27 tampa bay buccaneers 24 jeremy bergman s takeaways cincy s stars sizzle in espana few teams have had better 10 quarter stretches than the bengals over the past three weeks since being shut out in the first half against baltimore in week 7 cincinnati has responded with 112 points over two and a half games leading the way is joe burrow staking a strong claim in the mvp race burrow was lethal again on sunday in the first half leading cincy s offense to four scoring drives on 9 3 yards per play and completing 82 of his passes for 239 yards eight of those completions went to ja 39 marr chase who set a career high with 142 yards in the first half finishing with 155 and a score on 10 catches showcasing his dynamic ability on an international stage for the first time tee higgins boxed out c j henderson and atlanta s defensive backs for two tds even chase brown season high 6 3 ypc and cincinnati s anemic run game season best 123 yards showed some explosion after sunday s romp cincinnati has now won four straight games with at least 30 points scored for the first time in franchise history if the bengals are capable of this type of production weekly do they even need to swing big for a piece possibly at running back at the trade deadline that s a question for tuesday maybe atlanta will have an answer for cincy s offensive onslaught by then another big bijan day undone by atlanta errors a week after losing to a tampa team that didn t complete a pass the falcons found a more traditional way to fall sunday morning play leaky defense commit penalties repeat in pristine climate controlled conditions inside madrid s bernabeu there were no excuses for atlanta s performance first the positives michael penix threw three fewer interceptions than he did a week prior and scrambled for a career high 50 yards looking svelte and nimble on the spanish pitch bijan robinson who loves an exclusive window rushed for 100 again totaling 147 yards from scrimmage and one td on the day the elusive dynamo was right at home at the home of real madrid s galacticos but jeff ulbrich s defense was a sieve against the nfl s hottest attack allowing 7 1 yards per play and forcing just two punts on the day atlanta also committed 12 accepted penalties for 88 yards repeatedly setting back the offense the falcons o line committed two fouls in the red zone on their second drive leading to the first field goal of a touchdown fight its most critical error though came at the start of the fourth quarter when down two tds at the bengals 10 yard line atlanta was called for offensive holding on a third and 2 incompletion cincy accepted the penalty and forced a fourth and 12 settling for cutting a two score lead to a two score lead nick folk instead shanked a 38 yard field goal and the bengals lead held at 14 the falcons never got closer a tale of two divisions despite the result cincinnati and atlanta will both return to the states tied in the win column for leads in their respective divisions the bengals victory moved them into a 6 2 tie atop the afc north with the steelers setting up a critical sunday night football showdown on the banks of the ohio river in week 10 having already lost this season to pittsburgh the bengals need a home win against aaron rodgers and co to improve their division record and ensure no favor in the head to head tiebreaker down in the cursed nfc south the falcons at 3 6 are nowhere near out of it but are at risk of falling behind hotter clubs after sunday s slate atlanta is essentially tied with carolina 3 5 new orleans 3 5 and tampa bay 3 6 a needed bye awaits for the falcons after a week 10 matchup with patrick mahomes chiefs next gen stats insight for bengals falcons via nfl pro joe burrow was pressured on nine of 32 dropbacks 28 1 against the falcons completing 20 of 23 passes for 237 yards and two touchdowns when kept clean his time to pressure of 3 26 seconds was the longest of his career and the falcons defense had just one quick pressure in the game nfl research joe burrow and ja marr chase connected for their 19th touchdown of at least 40 yards in sunday s win tied with joe montana and jerry rice for the third most by any qb receiver duo since 1980 the only duos with more are peyton manning and marvin harrison 21 tds and steve young and jerry rice 20 tds their first quarter touchdown was the 58th score by the duo overall including playoffs which passed daunte culpepper and randy moss for second most by any qb receiver duo before age 30 trailing only dan marino and mark clayton 68 tds back to top nick shook s takeaways broncos win a game of runs it wasn t quite an avalanche but as is often the case in basketball sunday s game became a tale of runs what began as a one sided contest in favor of denver reversed course just before halftime sunday when the panthers turned an interception into a scoring possession to claw back into the competition that shift in momentum saw bryce young enter a flow state dotting the field with precise confident passes and leading a second scoring drive to double up between halves and put the panthers in a 14 13 lead he appeared poised to extend that lead in the fourth too but a wacky interception snagged by denver safety devon key stopped the panthers in their tracks and swung momentum back in favor of the broncos who rattled off two straight touchdown drives to take a 26 14 lead in the final period good for their latest fourth quarter comeback effort denver had to hang on for dear life in the final minutes after carolina mounted one final push and it s not exactly a resounding victory but it s the latest example of a contending team finding a way to win a back and forth contest by coming through in the most important moments and finishing in a style that fits the team s strengths with edge rusher nik bonitto strip sacking young to stop the panthers final drive in its tracks bo nix looked more like the passer we ve known him to be too a small but encouraging sign as the calendar creeps toward thanksgiving panthers defensive changes fail to produce improvement defensive coordinator ejiro evero became the fall guy when coach dave canales relieved him of his duties following carolina s week 8 loss to green bay installing an interim dc with the hopes it might improve the panthers inconsistent defense in short it didn t the panthers allowed denver to break 300 yards of total offense and mount two touchdown drives that appeared vastly different but produced the same result the first fourth quarter scoring march covered 80 yards over 14 plays while the other needed just six plays to gain 61 yards and finish with a wide open touchdown pass to pat bryant as a result of a blown coverage a symptom of a defense that is still scrambling to take care of the details carolina stood tall late buying its offense a chance to compile a game winning drive but the earlier breakdowns represent a persistent issue had cornerback corey thornton not made an incredibly athletic play on the ball to pick off nix this game might have snowballed out of control in the first half long before the panthers offense was able to climb back into the game had jaylen waddle not exited due to a head injury denver might have continued to rely on the playmaker to break open for big gains this unit was never going to be completely fixed in one week but sunday told us there s still plenty to correct nix begins to break out of his shell it didn t last throughout the entire game but seemingly for the first time in ages bo nix took the training wheels off his own bicycle and let himself play a bit more instinctively proof existed in his decisions made while rolling out in which nix twice opted to throw back against his body to open targets underneath instead of accepting a small scramble gain or throwing it away his bullet ripped through traffic to courtland sutton for a touchdown was another encouraging sign because he was willing to take a minor risk and when bryant streaked open through the carolina secondary nix didn t hesitate to put the ball on him for a score the results are evident in his stat line 25 of 37 237 yards two touchdowns one interception it s not a massive change in performance but it s a start broncos fans have been yearning to see for weeks we ll see if it s a sign of things to come next gen stats insight for broncos panthers via nfl pro bo nix posted a 124 2 passer rating against single high coverage 20 of 26 for 202 yards and two touchdowns but a 15 3 passer rating against split safety coverage 5 of 11 for 35 yards and an interception his 15 3 passer rating against split safety looks was his lowest in a game since his nfl debut in week 1 2024 nfl research the broncos won 26 21 in week 9 against the panthers after trailing by one point entering the fourth quarter their fifth win of the season after trailing at any point in the fourth that is tied with the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings for the most wins after trailing in the fourth quarter in a team s first nine games of a season since 2000 both the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings lost their first playoff game that season in the wild card round back to top kevin patra s takeaways cowboys survive collapse to secure a much needed win over colts brian schottenheimer s squad tried to give the game away luckily the cowboys opponent did a better job dallas built a 10 point lead deep into the third quarter mistakes then gave indianapolis life ceedee lamb fumbled late the cowboys second turnover of the day to wipe out a chance to put the game away despite putting up stats with george pickens out lamb had a mistake filled day in addition to the fumble he was called for offensive pass interference twice and couldn t toe tap a td that cost the cowboys four points in the red zone dallas couldn t get out of its own way for much of the contest dak prescott was far more off the mark than we re used to leading to stalled drives schotty s club was called for 14 penalties for a whopping 153 yards turned the ball over twice and missed a late go ahead field goal that s how you let an opponent amid a fire sale stay in a game despite being outgained 508 271 dallas should have run away with the game instead it trailed late until ryan flournoy the best no 3 wr in the league made a massive play for a 46 yard gain to set up the game winning td a loss would have all but doomed the cowboys who still have a big hill to climb in the nfc east colts offense can t kick it into gear until late facing a bad cowboys defense daniel jones and co couldn t take advantage for long stretches indy went three and out five times including on four of its first five drives the other was a 19 yard td drive following a dak prescott fumble jones was inconsistent and often off the mark completing 20 of 34 passes for 180 yards with a td and an interception the cowboys d entered the game allowing a league high 385 4 yards per game and 5 9 yards per play 29th indy generated just 271 yards and 4 6 yards per play while going 3 for 13 on third down ashton dulin s 55 yard catch and run td was indy s only pass play longer than 16 yards jones averaged 2 6 air yards per completion in the game third fewest of his career minimum 10 completions per next gen stats against a dallas d that s been ripped up jones needed to do more the rushing attack did some solid work generating 105 total yards on the ground with seth mcgowan earning 7 5 yards per carry on six totes with a td if sunday was jonathan taylor s final game in indy mcgowan flashed some upside to take over the bulk of the workload downs calls game when javonte williams scored the go ahead touchdown with a little over a minute remaining the big question was whether a sieve dallas d could hold on caleb downs ensured it would by stepping in front of a daniel jones pass sealing the win over his brother josh downs squad the int capped a game in which downs generated a sack three tackles a qb hit a tackle for loss and two passes defensed allowing just one reception on four targets sunday marked the first time all season that the cowboys defense allowed fewer than 318 total yards doing so against a team that s begun a mid season teardown is one thing the cowboys will have a stiffer test against kyle shanahan and the 49ers in week 10 next gen stats insight for cowboys colts via nfl pro ceedee lamb caught six of 12 targets for 180 yards and a touchdown on downfield throws 10 plus air yards in week 9 against the colts the most receiving yards he has recorded on downfield throws in his career nfl research sunday marked dak prescott s first game with 300 plus passing yards multiple passing touchdowns no interceptions and a game winning drive since 2018 in a
