news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFL midseason All-Rookie Team: Arvell Reese, David Bailey pacing 2026 draft picks
news_mentions.body_text: before the 2026 nfl draft the main debate was over who would be the first non quarterback selected david bailey or arvell reese now at the midway point of the season the debate rages on who is the nfl 39 s rookie of the year is it one of those two defensive stars both have played at extremely high levels with bailey among the most disruptive pass rushers in the league and reese creating a diverse impact using his versatility those two players were easy picks for this exercise other positions weren 39 t as simple our midseason nfl all rookie team quarterback first team jalon daniels tampa bay buccaneers the nfl has yet to see a 2026 draft pick start at quarterback so by default the undrafted daniels retains the spot he held on the quarter mark all rookie team one of the reasons daniels went undrafted was his high turnover rate which has carried over to the nfl he has more interceptions than touchdowns in two of three starts but daniels deserves credit for his week 5 performance as he led the buccaneers to a win over the cowboys he was turnover free that thursday night and used his mobility to avoid negative plays second team joe fagnano baltimore ravens nbsp with all due respect i guess this spot goes to fagnano he is the only other rookie also undrafted to start a game it didn 39 t go well at all but facing the jaguars who rank second in the nfl in scoring defense in your starting debut is a tough ask fagnano ranks second among all rookies in completions and first downs honorable mention fernando mendoza raiders athan kaliakmanis commanders jack strand falcons running back first team jonah coleman denver broncos despite a stint on injured reserve coleman has made a strong case as the nfl 39 s most impactful rookie back he is the only rookie with multiple rushing touchdowns and is tied for the rookie lead with 13 first down carries despite having far fewer attempts than others on the leaderboard coleman has also been productive in the passing game with 13 catches on 14 targets for 128 yards late in the fourth quarter against the chiefs he had a crucial 51 yard catch and run that set up denver 39 s go ahead touchdown a 5 yard run by coleman second team emmett johnson kansas city chiefs johnson ranks seventh among rookies in rushing yards but you can better understand his impact when factoring in receiving production through eight games he has 348 yards of total offense 237 receiving 111 rushing which ranks no 1 among rookie running backs he is also the only rookie back with both a rushing and receiving touchdown honorable mention kaelon black 49ers mike washington raiders jeremiyah love cardinals jadarian price seahawks seth mcgowan colts wide receiver first team denzel boston cleveland browns kc concepcion cleveland browns carnell tate tennessee titans no surprises here the same three names atop the rookie wr rankings at the quarter mark remain in place at the midway point they 39 re led by boston the seventh receiver drafted in april he leads all rookies in receiving yards 507 first down receptions 21 and receiving touchdowns three against the saints on sunday boston recorded his third catch of 50 plus yards which ties him with green bay 39 s christian watson for the nfl lead not far behind is concepcion who scored his first nfl touchdown on sunday in new orleans he ranks no 1 among rookies in receptions 37 and second in receiving yards 437 concepcion also leads all rookie receivers in catches of 20 plus yards eight and yards after the catch 237 which ranks top 20 in the nfl one spot behind amon ra st brown tate slots in just behind the browns 39 rookie duo with 34 catches for 413 yards and one touchdown he was exceptional at ohio state in contested situations and has continued that success in the nfl eight catches on nine contested targets however tate also leads all rookie receivers with four drops and three fumbles second team omar cooper new york jets makai lemon philadelphia eagles germie bernard pittsburgh steelers it has been a small yet impressive sample size from cooper despite almost all his production having come in three games he ranks fifth among rookies in receiving yards 306 and second with a pair of touchdown grabs lemon is tied with concepcion for the rookie lead with 37 receptions while bernard has helped expand the steelers 39 offense using his nose for the sticks honorable mention caleb douglas dolphins antonio williams commanders ted hurst buccaneers kevin coleman dolphins malachi fields giants chris bell dolphins josh cameron jaguars barion brown saints tight end first team kenyon sadiq new york jets the first tight end drafted in 2026 leads all rookie tight ends in catches 21 and receiving yards 235 each game sadiq seems to have a catch on which he is asked to high point and finish showing off his ball skills at different elevations most of his snaps have come in a detached alignment but he has been a capable run blocker when inline 37 7 percent of his snaps second team eli raridon new england patriots with 16 catches for 225 yards raridon joins sadiq as the only rookie tight ends with more than 150 receiving yards raridon leads all rookie tight ends in first down receptions 11 and is one of only two with multiple touchdown catches despite having a brutal drop on a potential walk in touchdown against the packers raridon also leads all rookie tight ends in blocking snaps and has kept his head above water in that area honorable mention nate boerkircher jaguars matthew hibner ravens josh cuevas ravens sam roush bears will kacmarek dolphins offensive tackle first team max iheanachor pittsburgh steelers blake miller detroit lions there isn 39 t a rookie offensive tackle running away with the top spot they 39 ve all been up and down iheanachor has had his share of struggles especially in the run game which was expected considering his inexperience but he hasn 39 t been a liability and the pittsburgh offensive line as a unit has been much better since he became the full time starter at right tackle in week 3 miller has probably been the most consistent rookie ot having allowed just one sack in seven starts at right tackle second team spencer fano cleveland browns markel bell philadelphia eagles fano 39 s tape has been full of high highs and low lows he has struggled against better talent see chase young this past sunday but he played above average against the jets titans and ravens before that fano has performed well enough to believe he can be a long term solution for the browns honorable mention kahlil benson chiefs monroe freeling panthers caleb lomu patriots travis burke chargers jayden williams cardinals interior offensive line first team vega ioane baltimore ravens austin barber cleveland browns francis mauigoa new york giants whether the ravens have needed him at guard or center ioane has been up for the challenge he hasn 39 t given up a sack since week 1 and has been the steadiest run blocker of all rookie offensive linemen barber is coming off arguably his worst game as a pro but there has been far more good than bad on his rookie tape he has been an iron man while battling through injuries and is tied with his teammate fano for the rookie lead in snaps played 588 i had higher hopes for mauigoa a top 10 pick but he has been good enough at right guard second team kadyn proctor miami dolphins jake slaughter los angeles chargers emmanuel pregnon jacksonville jaguars proctor had a strong case for the first team and it won 39 t be a surprise if he 39 s there before the end of the season slaughter has been solid although his rookie missteps have been costly mistakes pregnon leads the jaguars in snaps played but his mistakes are starting to add up nfl high 10 penalties honorable mention nbsp trey zuhn raiders keylan rutledge texans logan taylor chargers fernando carmona titans edge rusher first team david bailey new york jets gabe jacas new england patriots there isn 39 t much debate for the top two spots bailey leads all rookies in sacks 7 5 tackles for loss 11 forced fumbles five also tied for the league lead and pressures 31 he has taken his game to another level over his last four outings including a disruptive afternoon against patrick mahomes and the chiefs on sunday jacas is second among rookie edge rushers in sacks three and pressures 26 and he 39 s added an interception off aaron rodgers no less he needs to show better discipline with missed tackles and damaging penalties two roughing the passer two offsides but jacas has outplayed his draft spot second team dani dennis sutton green bay packers akheem mesidor los angeles chargers despite not being a starter dennis sutton has become a valuable role player on sub downs he ranks third among all rookies in pressures 23 and sacks three and he 39 s made an impact on kick and punt return coverage also coming off the bench mesidor has been one of the better all around rookie defensive linemen making plays both in pass rushing and in stopping the run he posted a career high seven pressures against the texans on sunday honorable mention r mason thomas chiefs cashius howell bengals romello height 49ers rueben bain buccaneers derrick moore lions caden curry colts defensive tackle first team gracen halton san francisco 49ers skyler gill howard detroit lions defensive tackle was not a strong position in the 2026 nfl draft and unsurprisingly it has been light in rookie output the 49ers had d line questions entering the season but halton has helped provide some answers he ranks third among all rookies in tackles for loss five and had one of the coolest rookie moments of the season when he forced a fumble against the seahawks and recovered it for his first nfl touchdown unfortunately halton suffered a broken ankle on sunday which will end his rookie season a subpackage defender gill howard ranks third on the lions and leads all rookie interior linemen in pressures 16 he was a day 3 steal second team lee hunter carolina panthers darrell jackson new york jets hunter is averaging fewer than 25 snaps per game but he is making the most of his playing time even if he isn 39 t dominating the box score you can feel his impact on tape jackson 39 s snap count has steadily increased too as he 39 s earned more trust from the coaching staff he leads all rookie defensive tackles in tackles 26 and has stacked positive reps see his week 8 snaps vs tyler linderbaum honorable mention chris mcclellan packers peter woods chiefs aaron hall panthers caleb banks vikings lt overton cowboys linebacker first team arvell reese new york giants jacob rodriguez miami dolphins reese terrorized the eagles this past sunday to the tune of 12 tackles three sacks and a forced fumble on a sack that took just 2 29 seconds the fastest sack in the nfl since week 7 of last season according to nextgenstats reese was my top ranked player in the 2026 draft and he hasn 39 t disappointed his main appeal as a prospect was his versatility which is also why he is one of the favorites for defensive rookie of the year he is the only nfl player not just among rookies with 65 plus tackles eight plus tackles for loss and at least one interception add in his forced fumble from sunday and 4 5 sacks and reese has made an impact for the nfc east leading giants there are multiple other rookie linebackers with a case to be on the first team but rodriguez has filled up the stat sheet 79 tackles four tackles for loss one forced fumble and one interception his most impressive stat though is an nfl best 33 34 defensive stops 34 reese ranks second with 32 second team anthony hill tennessee titans josiah trotter tampa bay buccaneers sonny styles washington commanders any of these three linebackers easily could have joined reese on the first team it 39 s a loaded year for rookies at the position hill averages 10 3 tackles per game which ranks third in the nfl behind only alex singleton and nakobe dean trotter has always been a hammer looking for a nail against the run but his improvements in coverage are promising styles and roquan smith are the only nfl linebackers with 67 plus tackles eight plus pressures and at least one interception and one forced fumble honorable mention kendal daniels falcons jaishawn barham cowboys harold perkins falcons jaden dugger 49ers bryce boettcher colts cj allen colts cornerback first team brandon cisse green bay packers mansoor delane kansas city chiefs this was a tough category because of the volatility from the rookie cb class cisse who leads all rookie corners in snaps played had some rough moments over the first month of the season but he has been stacking positive outings since the start of october over his last five games cisse has allowed zero touchdowns and just 50 percent completions when targeted along with four passes defended and one interception delane has missed three games because of a right shoulder injury but he performed at a high level in the five games he was on the field despite playing half the number of snaps as cisse he has almost as many passes defended four and the same number of interceptions one it helps that he has been strong as a tackler and has yet to commit a penalty second team davison igbinosun buffalo bills malik muhammad chicago bears igbinosun is one of nine nfl players and the only rookie with at least five pass breakups and one interception he was known for his hands on approach in coverage at ohio state and that has followed him to the nfl but he also does a great job using his length to suffocate passing windows over the past three games he has allowed only two catches with two pass breakups and his first career interception i was ready to put hezekiah masses here because he leads all rookies with three interceptions but his coverage tape over the last month just hasn 39 t been good enough muhammad has been banged up and had some rough patches as well see the packers game but he has played more reliable football honorable mention will lee panthers daylen everette steelers hezekiah masses raiders jermod mccoy raiders colton hood giants nickelback first team keionte scott tampa bay buccaneers scott fell further than expected on draft night because he is a very specific type of player an undersized nickel who is much better downhill than in reverse but when used in the correct role scott can shine and he has played well for a fast and physical bucs defense he has almost as many solo tackles as styles and is tied with caleb downs for the most defensive stops 14 among rookie dbs second team chris johnson miami dolphins nbsp johnson who just turned 22 this week has shown his youth at times but i have been impressed with his resiliency especially given that miami has used him both inside and outside johnson notched his first career interception on sunday off jared goff honorable mention kenneth harris colts keith abney lions avieon terrell falcons chandler rivers ravens d 39 angelo ponds jets safety first team treydan stukes las vegas raiders caleb downs dallas cowboys it can be tough not to have recency bias for an exercise like this but stukes 39 interception on sunday against the 49ers helped land him on the first team stukes now has a pair of interceptions and is tied for the rookie lead with three passes defended there certainly have been ups and downs for downs but he is coming off one of his most impactful games of his young career against the colts and his older brother josh downs he finished with three tackles two passes defended one sack and his first nfl interception to seal a win second team zakee wheatley carolina panthers dillon thieneman chicago bears wheatley has made his presence felt in different ways for the panthers he had a forced fumble in his nfl debut then picked off jordan love in week 8 for his first career interception his consistency in both run support and coverage has been an exciting development thieneman hasn 39 t been as consistent but he leads all rookie safeties in tackles 52 and we have seen an uptick in chicago 39 s willingness to vary his role including letting him loose as a blitzer honorable mention emmanuel mcneil warren browns michael taaffe dolphins genesis smith chargers a j haulcy colts robert spears jennings steelers xavier nwankpa chiefs kicker first team drew stevens washington commanders stevens has been the most consistent of the rookie kickers connecting on 12 of 12 field goal attempts of under 50 yards he had a few missed extra points early in the season but has been more reliable over the past month honorable mention trey smack packers dominic zvada giants punter first team tommy doman buffalo bills doman could have earn this spot solely based on his jarring hit on a kickoff against the vikings to force a fumble but he also ranks third in the nfl in hangtime 4 62 seconds with a respectable 43 2 yard net average honorable mention nbsp ryan eckley ravens brett thorson vikings this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFL midseason All-Rookie Team: Arvell Reese, David Bailey pacing 2026 draft picks
news_mentions.body_text: before the 2026 nfl draft the main debate was over who would be the first non quarterback selected david bailey or arvell reese now at the midway point of the season the debate rages on who is the nfl 39 s rookie of the year is it one of those two defensive stars both have played at extremely high levels with bailey among the most disruptive pass rushers in the league and reese creating a diverse impact using his versatility those two players were easy picks for this exercise other positions weren 39 t as simple our midseason nfl all rookie team quarterback first team jalon daniels tampa bay buccaneers the nfl has yet to see a 2026 draft pick start at quarterback so by default the undrafted daniels retains the spot he held on the quarter mark all rookie team one of the reasons daniels went undrafted was his high turnover rate which has carried over to the nfl he has more interceptions than touchdowns in two of three starts but daniels deserves credit for his week 5 performance as he led the buccaneers to a win over the cowboys he was turnover free that thursday night and used his mobility to avoid negative plays second team joe fagnano baltimore ravens nbsp with all due respect i guess this spot goes to fagnano he is the only other rookie also undrafted to start a game it didn 39 t go well at all but facing the jaguars who rank second in the nfl in scoring defense in your starting debut is a tough ask fagnano ranks second among all rookies in completions and first downs honorable mention fernando mendoza raiders athan kaliakmanis commanders jack strand falcons running back first team jonah coleman denver broncos despite a stint on injured reserve coleman has made a strong case as the nfl 39 s most impactful rookie back he is the only rookie with multiple rushing touchdowns and is tied for the rookie lead with 13 first down carries despite having far fewer attempts than others on the leaderboard coleman has also been productive in the passing game with 13 catches on 14 targets for 128 yards late in the fourth quarter against the chiefs he had a crucial 51 yard catch and run that set up denver 39 s go ahead touchdown a 5 yard run by coleman second team emmett johnson kansas city chiefs johnson ranks seventh among rookies in rushing yards but you can better understand his impact when factoring in receiving production through eight games he has 348 yards of total offense 237 receiving 111 rushing which ranks no 1 among rookie running backs he is also the only rookie back with both a rushing and receiving touchdown honorable mention kaelon black 49ers mike washington raiders jeremiyah love cardinals jadarian price seahawks seth mcgowan colts wide receiver first team denzel boston cleveland browns kc concepcion cleveland browns carnell tate tennessee titans no surprises here the same three names atop the rookie wr rankings at the quarter mark remain in place at the midway point they 39 re led by boston the seventh receiver drafted in april he leads all rookies in receiving yards 507 first down receptions 21 and receiving touchdowns three against the saints on sunday boston recorded his third catch of 50 plus yards which ties him with green bay 39 s christian watson for the nfl lead not far behind is concepcion who scored his first nfl touchdown on sunday in new orleans he ranks no 1 among rookies in receptions 37 and second in receiving yards 437 concepcion also leads all rookie receivers in catches of 20 plus yards eight and yards after the catch 237 which ranks top 20 in the nfl one spot behind amon ra st brown tate slots in just behind the browns 39 rookie duo with 34 catches for 413 yards and one touchdown he was exceptional at ohio state in contested situations and has continued that success in the nfl eight catches on nine contested targets however tate also leads all rookie receivers with four drops and three fumbles second team omar cooper new york jets makai lemon philadelphia eagles germie bernard pittsburgh steelers it has been a small yet impressive sample size from cooper despite almost all his production having come in three games he ranks fifth among rookies in receiving yards 306 and second with a pair of touchdown grabs lemon is tied with concepcion for the rookie lead with 37 receptions while bernard has helped expand the steelers 39 offense using his nose for the sticks honorable mention caleb douglas dolphins antonio williams commanders ted hurst buccaneers kevin coleman dolphins malachi fields giants chris bell dolphins josh cameron jaguars barion brown saints tight end first team kenyon sadiq new york jets the first tight end drafted in 2026 leads all rookie tight ends in catches 21 and receiving yards 235 each game sadiq seems to have a catch on which he is asked to high point and finish showing off his ball skills at different elevations most of his snaps have come in a detached alignment but he has been a capable run blocker when inline 37 7 percent of his snaps second team eli raridon new england patriots with 16 catches for 225 yards raridon joins sadiq as the only rookie tight ends with more than 150 receiving yards raridon leads all rookie tight ends in first down receptions 11 and is one of only two with multiple touchdown catches despite having a brutal drop on a potential walk in touchdown against the packers raridon also leads all rookie tight ends in blocking snaps and has kept his head above water in that area honorable mention nate boerkircher jaguars matthew hibner ravens josh cuevas ravens sam roush bears will kacmarek dolphins offensive tackle first team max iheanachor pittsburgh steelers blake miller detroit lions there isn 39 t a rookie offensive tackle running away with the top spot they 39 ve all been up and down iheanachor has had his share of struggles especially in the run game which was expected considering his inexperience but he hasn 39 t been a liability and the pittsburgh offensive line as a unit has been much better since he became the full time starter at right tackle in week 3 miller has probably been the most consistent rookie ot having allowed just one sack in seven starts at right tackle second team spencer fano cleveland browns markel bell philadelphia eagles fano 39 s tape has been full of high highs and low lows he has struggled against better talent see chase young this past sunday but he played above average against the jets titans and ravens before that fano has performed well enough to believe he can be a long term solution for the browns honorable mention kahlil benson chiefs monroe freeling panthers caleb lomu patriots travis burke chargers jayden williams cardinals interior offensive line first team vega ioane baltimore ravens austin barber cleveland browns francis mauigoa new york giants whether the ravens have needed him at guard or center ioane has been up for the challenge he hasn 39 t given up a sack since week 1 and has been the steadiest run blocker of all rookie offensive linemen barber is coming off arguably his worst game as a pro but there has been far more good than bad on his rookie tape he has been an iron man while battling through injuries and is tied with his teammate fano for the rookie lead in snaps played 588 i had higher hopes for mauigoa a top 10 pick but he has been good enough at right guard second team kadyn proctor miami dolphins jake slaughter los angeles chargers emmanuel pregnon jacksonville jaguars proctor had a strong case for the first team and it won 39 t be a surprise if he 39 s there before the end of the season slaughter has been solid although his rookie missteps have been costly mistakes pregnon leads the jaguars in snaps played but his mistakes are starting to add up nfl high 10 penalties honorable mention nbsp trey zuhn raiders keylan rutledge texans logan taylor chargers fernando carmona titans edge rusher first team david bailey new york jets gabe jacas new england patriots there isn 39 t much debate for the top two spots bailey leads all rookies in sacks 7 5 tackles for loss 11 forced fumbles five also tied for the league lead and pressures 31 he has taken his game to another level over his last four outings including a disruptive afternoon against patrick mahomes and the chiefs on sunday jacas is second among rookie edge rushers in sacks three and pressures 26 and he 39 s added an interception off aaron rodgers no less he needs to show better discipline with missed tackles and damaging penalties two roughing the passer two offsides but jacas has outplayed his draft spot second team dani dennis sutton green bay packers akheem mesidor los angeles chargers despite not being a starter dennis sutton has become a valuable role player on sub downs he ranks third among all rookies in pressures 23 and sacks three and he 39 s made an impact on kick and punt return coverage also coming off the bench mesidor has been one of the better all around rookie defensive linemen making plays both in pass rushing and in stopping the run he posted a career high seven pressures against the texans on sunday honorable mention r mason thomas chiefs cashius howell bengals romello height 49ers rueben bain buccaneers derrick moore lions caden curry colts defensive tackle first team gracen halton san francisco 49ers skyler gill howard detroit lions defensive tackle was not a strong position in the 2026 nfl draft and unsurprisingly it has been light in rookie output the 49ers had d line questions entering the season but halton has helped provide some answers he ranks third among all rookies in tackles for loss five and had one of the coolest rookie moments of the season when he forced a fumble against the seahawks and recovered it for his first nfl touchdown unfortunately halton suffered a broken ankle on sunday which will end his rookie season a subpackage defender gill howard ranks third on the lions and leads all rookie interior linemen in pressures 16 he was a day 3 steal second team lee hunter carolina panthers darrell jackson new york jets hunter is averaging fewer than 25 snaps per game but he is making the most of his playing time even if he isn 39 t dominating the box score you can feel his impact on tape jackson 39 s snap count has steadily increased too as he 39 s earned more trust from the coaching staff he leads all rookie defensive tackles in tackles 26 and has stacked positive reps see his week 8 snaps vs tyler linderbaum honorable mention chris mcclellan packers peter woods chiefs aaron hall panthers caleb banks vikings lt overton cowboys linebacker first team arvell reese new york giants jacob rodriguez miami dolphins reese terrorized the eagles this past sunday to the tune of 12 tackles three sacks and a forced fumble on a sack that took just 2 29 seconds the fastest sack in the nfl since week 7 of last season according to nextgenstats reese was my top ranked player in the 2026 draft and he hasn 39 t disappointed his main appeal as a prospect was his versatility which is also why he is one of the favorites for defensive rookie of the year he is the only nfl player not just among rookies with 65 plus tackles eight plus tackles for loss and at least one interception add in his forced fumble from sunday and 4 5 sacks and reese has made an impact for the nfc east leading giants there are multiple other rookie linebackers with a case to be on the first team but rodriguez has filled up the stat sheet 79 tackles four tackles for loss one forced fumble and one interception his most impressive stat though is an nfl best 33 34 defensive stops 34 reese ranks second with 32 second team anthony hill tennessee titans josiah trotter tampa bay buccaneers sonny styles washington commanders any of these three linebackers easily could have joined reese on the first team it 39 s a loaded year for rookies at the position hill averages 10 3 tackles per game which ranks third in the nfl behind only alex singleton and nakobe dean trotter has always been a hammer looking for a nail against the run but his improvements in coverage are promising styles and roquan smith are the only nfl linebackers with 67 plus tackles eight plus pressures and at least one interception and one forced fumble honorable mention kendal daniels falcons jaishawn barham cowboys harold perkins falcons jaden dugger 49ers bryce boettcher colts cj allen colts cornerback first team brandon cisse green bay packers mansoor delane kansas city chiefs this was a tough category because of the volatility from the rookie cb class cisse who leads all rookie corners in snaps played had some rough moments over the first month of the season but he has been stacking positive outings since the start of october over his last five games cisse has allowed zero touchdowns and just 50 percent completions when targeted along with four passes defended and one interception delane has missed three games because of a right shoulder injury but he performed at a high level in the five games he was on the field despite playing half the number of snaps as cisse he has almost as many passes defended four and the same number of interceptions one it helps that he has been strong as a tackler and has yet to commit a penalty second team davison igbinosun buffalo bills malik muhammad chicago bears igbinosun is one of nine nfl players and the only rookie with at least five pass breakups and one interception he was known for his hands on approach in coverage at ohio state and that has followed him to the nfl but he also does a great job using his length to suffocate passing windows over the past three games he has allowed only two catches with two pass breakups and his first career interception i was ready to put hezekiah masses here because he leads all rookies with three interceptions but his coverage tape over the last month just hasn 39 t been good enough muhammad has been banged up and had some rough patches as well see the packers game but he has played more reliable football honorable mention will lee panthers daylen everette steelers hezekiah masses raiders jermod mccoy raiders colton hood giants nickelback first team keionte scott tampa bay buccaneers scott fell further than expected on draft night because he is a very specific type of player an undersized nickel who is much better downhill than in reverse but when used in the correct role scott can shine and he has played well for a fast and physical bucs defense he has almost as many solo tackles as styles and is tied with caleb downs for the most defensive stops 14 among rookie dbs second team chris johnson miami dolphins nbsp johnson who just turned 22 this week has shown his youth at times but i have been impressed with his resiliency especially given that miami has used him both inside and outside johnson notched his first career interception on sunday off jared goff honorable mention kenneth harris colts keith abney lions avieon terrell falcons chandler rivers ravens d 39 angelo ponds jets safety first team treydan stukes las vegas raiders caleb downs dallas cowboys it can be tough not to have recency bias for an exercise like this but stukes 39 interception on sunday against the 49ers helped land him on the first team stukes now has a pair of interceptions and is tied for the rookie lead with three passes defended there certainly have been ups and downs for downs but he is coming off one of his most impactful games of his young career against the colts and his older brother josh downs he finished with three tackles two passes defended one sack and his first nfl interception to seal a win second team zakee wheatley carolina panthers dillon thieneman chicago bears wheatley has made his presence felt in different ways for the panthers he had a forced fumble in his nfl debut then picked off jordan love in week 8 for his first career interception his consistency in both run support and coverage has been an exciting development thieneman hasn 39 t been as consistent but he leads all rookie safeties in tackles 52 and we have seen an uptick in chicago 39 s willingness to vary his role including letting him loose as a blitzer honorable mention emmanuel mcneil warren browns michael taaffe dolphins genesis smith chargers a j haulcy colts robert spears jennings steelers xavier nwankpa chiefs kicker first team drew stevens washington commanders stevens has been the most consistent of the rookie kickers connecting on 12 of 12 field goal attempts of under 50 yards he had a few missed extra points early in the season but has been more reliable over the past month honorable mention trey smack packers dominic zvada giants punter first team tommy doman buffalo bills doman could have earn this spot solely based on his jarring hit on a kickoff against the vikings to force a fumble but he also ranks third in the nfl in hangtime 4 62 seconds with a respectable 43 2 yard net average honorable mention nbsp ryan eckley ravens brett thorson vikings this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Cardinals' Gardner Minshew likely needs season-ending elbow surgery; Carson Beck in line to start
news_mentions.description: Cardinals quarterback Gardner Minshew is seeking additional medical opinions to confirm that he will likely need season-ending surgery on a torn UCL in his throwing arm, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported.
news_mentions.body_text: round and round the arizona cardinals quarterback carousel goes gardner minshew is seeking additional medical opinions to confirm that he will need season ending surgery on a torn ucl in his throwing arm nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported minshew appeared to suffer the injury on a strip sack by dante fowler in the closing moments of the second quarter during sunday s 17 3 loss to the seattle seahawks he stayed in to finish out the game with 166 yards on 21 of 30 passing should minshew require surgery that puts him on the bench for the duration of the 2026 campaign third round rookie carson beck would be in line to start in week 10 against the los angeles rams and moving forward arizona also signed veteran josh johnson off the cincinnati bengals practice squad per schefter though two undrafted rookies have logged starts this season the tampa bay buccaneers jalon daniels and baltimore ravens joe fagnano beck would become the first signal caller from the 2026 draft class to make a start ahead of first rounders fernando mendoza las vegas raiders and ty simpson rams minshew s injury continues a period of constant change in arizona the cardinals completed a trade sending jacoby brissett the team s starter for the first eight games to the baltimore ravens on friday three days later they could be on to qb no 3 though it is a certainly an unorthodox path to giving the rookie a shot arizona currently sits at the bottom of the nfc west with a 3 6 record so it s beneficial at this point to see what the club has in beck who threw for 11 725 yards 88 touchdowns and 32 interceptions in a long college career that included five seasons at georgia and a final one with miami florida he appeared only in the pro football hall of fame game during the preseason due to injuries hampering him thereafter but he did shine in the one outing going 15 of 19 for 188 yards and a touchdown his next test will be far tougher perhaps the most unfriendly way one could be welcomed to the nfl with no 1 wide receiver michael wilson out for the rest of the season due to a neck injury beck will make his debut against the terrifying defensive line duo of aaron donald and myles garrett the latter of whom returned from injured reserve in week 9 with a three sack statement how he performs against l a and throughout the second half of the season could play a major factor in arizona s future qb plans

material_news_signals.headline: NFL Network: Cardinals' Gardner Minshew likely needs season-ending elbow surgery; Carson Beck in line to start
material_news_signals.description: Cardinals quarterback Gardner Minshew is seeking additional medical opinions to confirm that he will likely need season-ending surgery on a torn UCL in his throwing arm, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported.
material_news_signals.body_text: round and round the arizona cardinals quarterback carousel goes gardner minshew is seeking additional medical opinions to confirm that he will need season ending surgery on a torn ucl in his throwing arm nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported minshew appeared to suffer the injury on a strip sack by dante fowler in the closing moments of the second quarter during sunday s 17 3 loss to the seattle seahawks he stayed in to finish out the game with 166 yards on 21 of 30 passing should minshew require surgery that puts him on the bench for the duration of the 2026 campaign third round rookie carson beck would be in line to start in week 10 against the los angeles rams and moving forward arizona also signed veteran josh johnson off the cincinnati bengals practice squad per schefter though two undrafted rookies have logged starts this season the tampa bay buccaneers jalon daniels and baltimore ravens joe fagnano beck would become the first signal caller from the 2026 draft class to make a start ahead of first rounders fernando mendoza las vegas raiders and ty simpson rams minshew s injury continues a period of constant change in arizona the cardinals completed a trade sending jacoby brissett the team s starter for the first eight games to the baltimore ravens on friday three days later they could be on to qb no 3 though it is a certainly an unorthodox path to giving the rookie a shot arizona currently sits at the bottom of the nfc west with a 3 6 record so it s beneficial at this point to see what the club has in beck who threw for 11 725 yards 88 touchdowns and 32 interceptions in a long college career that included five seasons at georgia and a final one with miami florida he appeared only in the pro football hall of fame game during the preseason due to injuries hampering him thereafter but he did shine in the one outing going 15 of 19 for 188 yards and a touchdown his next test will be far tougher perhaps the most unfriendly way one could be welcomed to the nfl with no 1 wide receiver michael wilson out for the rest of the season due to a neck injury beck will make his debut against the terrifying defensive line duo of aaron donald and myles garrett the latter of whom returned from injured reserve in week 9 with a three sack statement how he performs against l a and throughout the second half of the season could play a major factor in arizona s future qb plans
