news_mentions.headline: NFL trade grades: Evaluating every deal made ahead of the 2026 deadline
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Kevin Patra grades every trade made since the start of the 2026 regular season until Nov. 10's trade deadline.
news_mentions.body_text: with the 2026 nfl trade deadline set for nov 10 nfl com s kevin patra breaks down every trade made since the start of the regular season jags beef up interior d line date of trade nov 9 jacksonville receives dt jordan davis grade c philadelphia receives 2027 first round draft pick 2029 second round draft pick grade a on monday morning gm james gladstone had a big protein full breakfast then he had a light midday snack finally he sat down for a tomahawk steak dinner hold the sides the jags massive move for nose tackle jordan davis comes with huge risk for the gm who took the f them picks mantle from his former boss les snead and sped away if it works out and davis plays a pivotal role in the jags bringing a lombardi to duval no one will give a hoot how much it costs if it backfires davis struggles and jacksonville bows out early it will be a tough pill to swallow i was semi critical of the bears willingness to part ways with a hefty price tag for jeffery simmons that looks like a bargain in comparison to this move simmons is a game wrecker davis is a solid run stuffer with a little bit of push the pocket ability he s not in simmons stratosphere he s not even in quinnen williams realm who went for a similar package last year by most accounts davis was a good soldier and leader in philly but he s also been one of its more disappointing players this season and an epitome of the roller coaster defense when he and jalen carter were on they were a force unfortunately the effort wasn t always there davis has been a good run defender for his career but his 13 5 run stop rate this season ranks 14th among dts with a minimum of 100 run plays defended behind teammate moro ojomo i should add with a 1 8 run stuff percentage t 58th last year before he got paid was his best season with a 16 5 run stop rate fourth among dts with a run stuff rate of 4 3 behind that of davon hamilton whom he s essentially been brought in to replace there is the risk for the jags it feels like a knee jerk reaction to hamilton s injury led to a massive overpay davis can be a good player stuff the middle and can provide a little more pop for a nose tackle in the passing game however a first round pick and a future second we know dts have been scarce in this market but paying that much for a run defender is a lot but what do i know maybe dc anthony campanile sees something in davis that he can unlock maybe the jags really just believe that stuffing the run and eating up blockers so they can get to third and long is worth that investment maybe next to josh hines allen and travon walker we ll get a better version maybe davis having heard all the negative chatter about how the jags overpaid for him will be motivated and bring a wrecking ball attitude to duval and storm his way through the postseason on a mission for me that s a lot of maybes to hang a first and second rounder on the jags are undoubtedly better today than they were yesterday davis fills a void left on the defense gladstone was fearless in filling the holes for that he deserves credit but going all in only works if it pays off with hardware i m not sure howie roseman wanted to move davis after just paying him but when you get a desperate trade partner offering the moon sometimes you just take their cash and hightail it out of there this feels akin to the reaction when the raiders initially got two first round picks from the ravens for maxx crosby before the trade was scuttled given the eagles were losers of seven straight games it makes sense for roseman to cash out on this season and keep stacking chips for the future hey he doesn t even have to wait an extra year on this first rounder the eagles coffers are now stocked with two first rounders in 2027 two first rounders and two second rounders in 2028 and two second rounders in 2029 giddyup jaguars go all in with trade for veteran safety date of trade nov 9 jacksonville receives s jessie bates grade b atlanta receives 2027 second round draft pick 2028 fifth round draft pick grade a the jags went all in following the season ending elbow injury to eric murray the back end of anthony campanile s defense needed aid like a heat seeking missile jessie bates comes flying into duval i absolutely love the fit in jacksonville bates is a ballhawk who fits into this scheme next to antonio johnson like a glove the 29 year old plays the back end with aplomb rarely getting out of position and has the range to make up ground he s also a speeding bullet when he reads the run or a quick screen when he arrives he can dish out punishment and attacks the ball three forced fumbles this season the price is high for a player slated for free agency it s high enough that i wonder despite next year s cap concerns whether jags general manager james gladstone has eyes on signing bates to an extension similar to last year s trade for jakobi meyers which helped stabilize the receiver room for the 2025 playoff run at worst bates walks in the offseason and the cap strapped jags get a fourth or fifth round compensatory pick given the market for veteran safeties ahead of the trade deadline the cost for a playmaker like bates probably increased credit gladstone for not shying away from improving his team the jags are in a win now mode they have a window to not just re capture the afc south and become a cute national story they can make a legit super bowl run with this squad the offense is clicking under liam coen and the defense has been stingy injuries to murray and dt davon hamilton threatened to limit the defense s upside jacksonville needed to make a move to ensure that didn t happen my grade reflects that guts yes the price is high for a shot at a ring worth it i m crediting the falcons for seeing the truth just because they re a half game back from the top of the division in a grotesque nfc south they re still in last place even a run to the postseason doesn t make them championship contenders that s just a recipe for a later draft pick i m not suggesting the falcons should go into full on tank mode but it s a good sign that the current front office understands that getting a second round pick and a fifth rounder in 2028 for a free agent safety who turns 30 in february is excellent business atl isn t a safety away from contending for a lombardi he s worth more to teams like the jags bills or bengals the falcons also couldn t count on a comp pick coming back their way if they let the season play out and watched bates walk with the most cap space next year atlanta is expected to be heavily involved in free agency which would have negated any compensatory selection trading bates for the balance of the season not only ensures they get picks but the reward is much better than any comp pick dealing bates hurts the falcons chances of taking the division down the stretch but it sets them up better to be actual contenders later jaguars make second deal for defensive help date of trade nov 9 jacksonville receives dt davon godchaux grade b new orleans receives 2028 conditional sixth round draft pick grade b the jags are replacing a davon with a davon after the season ending injury to stud dt davon hamilton jacksonville needed help in the middle of its defense snagging davon godchaux from the saints helps fill that void the jags run d which exited week 8 no 1 against the run with hamilton in the lineup slipped while allowing a season high 172 rush yards to the ravens last thursday night perhaps that was simply a product of the third string qb opponent and one massive 65 yard run but the jaguars weren t about to sit around and find out godchaux a former dolphin and patriot has spent 10 years in the league as a run stuffer in 2024 his last year in new england he finished third among dts in run stops 48 before signing with the saints in eight games in 2026 he has generated 15 tackles nine run stops and one stuff it s not a home run move like the acquisition of jessie bates but adding a veteran body in the middle of the defense for a relatively low cost fills a need for jacksonville the jags don t currently have a 2027 sixth round pick still they are unofficially projected to acquire a couple of sixth round compensatory picks per over the cap one of which would then go to new orleans comp picks can t be traded until they re officially awarded in the offseason under the reported terms of the trade jacksonville gm james gladstone headed toward the trade deadline aiming to upgrade safety and defensive tackle he s now done both the jags clearly are all in on making a january push for new orleans godchaux was set to be a free agent after the season so getting a draft pick is solid even an eventual day 3 selection moving the veteran should open up reps for second round pick christian miller who was a healthy scratch on sunday the saints now need the rookie to step up like the falcons the saints were smart to know there is little reason to keep a soon to be 32 year old around for the rest of a campaign when you have three wins halfway through the season even if you re still in the division race snagging a pick is the smart move detroit deals for defensive back date of trade nov 9 detroit receives s andre cisco grade c new york receives 2028 sixth round draft pick grade c the lions added a safety to help fortify the back end of the defense a day before the deadline a former third round pick by jacksonville cisco started 47 games over four seasons with the jags snagging eight ints 1 5 sacks and 154 tackles he signed a one year deal in new york in 2025 and started five games before suffering a torn pec that ended his season the 26 year old re signed with the jets and has started four games this season including a week 3 loss in detroit where he sacked jared goff cisco mostly played a supporting role for the jets this season and has seen his time on defense plummet after week 3 he played zero defensive snaps in sunday s loss in kansas city malachi moore took over in three safety sets making cico expendable a 2028 sixth rounder for a player not in your plans is better than nothing but no one is getting star grades for this bland swap the veteran brings experience to a lions secondary that recently got brian branch back and is still hoping kerby joseph can return from a knee injury that cut short his 2025 season it s not a splash play for brad holmes but it gives detroit another body to throw at the situation for a secondary that has cycled through defenders this season ravens add journeyman qb after jackson huntley injured date of trade nov 6 baltimore receives qb jacoby brissett 2027 fifth round draft pick grade b arizona receives 2027 fourth round draft pick 2028 seventh round draft pick grade b sometimes even in the nfl trades make too much sense not to happen when the ravens lost both lamar jackson and tyler huntley to injury all eyes turned to jacoby brissett whom the arizona cardinals had just benched days later we get a trade baltimore had to make a move jesse minters squad found itself floating up the creek without either paddle forced to steer with a soup spoon it would have been unfair to joe fagnano and the rest of the team to ride the undrafted rookie the rest of the way as we saw thursday night fagnano is simply outmatched right now the free agent options offered little better enter brissett the 33 year old journeyman joins his seventh team in seven seasons he should be able to get up to speed quickly having his former qb coach israel woolfork in baltimore makes the transition easier after sitting out the offseason in an effort to get a reworked contract brissett struggled to fit into mike lafleur s offense he s been a bottom quarter passer this season ranking 18th of 23 qbs in epa per dropback at 0 11 min 200 attempts his stats are down across the board from last season when he finished with 3 366 yards a 23 8 td int ratio a 94 1 passer rating and a 0 05 epa per dropback there is a reason brissett has bounced around there is also a reason he keeps winding up a starter brissett s not the ideal franchise setter but he s a solid addition to a floundering ravens squad that has lost four straight games the hope is that he fits in declan doyle s offense better and gets back to the distributing ways we saw last season the price is about right for a player who was benched the ravens don t currently own any non compensatory fifth or sixth round picks in 2027 so a middle round swap with a 2028 final round sweetener was about as best as they could do it s not great to spend assets to solve a problem on a sinking ship but baltimore couldn t move forward with what it had on the slim chance brissett turns things around and pushes the ravens to the playoffs it was worth the small price the cardinals paid a couple million dollars to move on from their third string qb for a day 3 draft swap and a 2028 dart throw it s not significant capital but it s better than nothing i wonder if they might have received more by waiting until monday to see if another club minnesota jumped into the fray but arizona couldn t let the deadline pass without moving the veteran it was clear brissett was done in the desert after sunday s comeback win from gardner minshew the presence of the mania inducing veteran along with rookie carson beck made brissett superfluous in hindsight arizona probably should have moved on from brissett in the offseason while he was seeking a pay bump i understand why they didn t but he was always going to be a stopgap having two bridges to some unknown land is hardly good asset usage in that view i can t give the cards a rave review but getting even a minor upgrade in the draft is positive and if the ravens continue to spiral even with brissett that fourth rounder could be better bears trade two first rounders for all pro dt date of trade oct 29 chicago receives dt jeffery simmons 2028 fifth round draft pick grade b tennessee receives 2027 first round draft pick 2027 fourth round draft pick 2028 first round draft pick grade a ryan poles finally upgraded the defensive line since may i ve been writing that the bears lack of action along the line whether adding a dt or pass rusher was head scratching the interior was particularly troubling as the bears have been counting on 33 year old grady jarrett and journeymen kentavius street neville gallimore and james lynch coordinator dennis allen has made it work but an upgrade was warranted before the operation collapsed poles never one to sit on his hands made a massive splash simmons is the type of game changing talent who could flip a playoff game in chicago s favor already an nfc favorite to make a postseason run the 5 2 bears have made a move that puts them squarely in the running to hoist a lombardi a beast among beasts simmons leads all defensive tackles with 28 quarterback pressures and is tied for second with four sacks notably he s racked up that production on a titans team that has been behind a lot this season imagine the numbers he d put up in game scripts that force more passes from the offense we re about to find out the 29 year old isn t just a get up the field fly wildly at the quarterback defensive tackle either no no no simmons is a wrecking ball to whatever unfortunate soul might be clutching the pigskin when he s on the warpath in addition to owning the most qb pressures among dts he also is tied for second with 21 run stops and tied for third with seven run stuffs per next gen stats there has been some chatter that his play has waned this season in tennessee i don t buy it if you haven t seen the man with the red armband manically flying around the field in tennessee this season you haven t been watching simmons has been every bit as good as any interior defender this season in the chicago spotlight he could push his way into the dpoy conversation the move could tip the balance of the nfc north and the entire conference in the bears favor that s how good simmons is from a pure player addition standpoint it s a home run for poles the issue is the compensation two first round picks and a fourth rounder is a massive haul it s also notable that the fifth round pick the bears got back with simmons is in 2028 not 2027 two first rounders for a non quarterback is a huge cost i understand why poles was willing to do it with most of his key players on rookie contracts now it was the time to strike however after he pays all those guys including quarterback caleb williams he ll need good players on cheap rookie deals to keep things rolling recent non quarterbacks traded for multiple first round picks include edge rusher micah parsons cornerback sauce gardner offensive tackle laremy tunsil safety jamal adams and edge khalil mack to chicago in 2018 that s a mixed bag of results if i m being kind and some outright cringey mistakes including gardner last year a d lineman isn t a cb but it s still a hefty price for anyone who doesn t sling the oblong the bears doing this twice is notable mack didn t bring the bears a super bowl two playoff appearances however the situation feels different this time chicago has a clear franchise difference maker at quarterback the other recent comparable trade was the dallas cowboys sending a first and second rounder for interior defensive lineman quinnen williams at the deadline last season i should note that simmons is older than every single player i mentioned above was at the time of their trade how the dt ages will factor into what this trade looks like three years from now if there was a parade in downtown chicago before then the locals won t care about the cost of two firsts this was a no brainer for the titans two firsts for a non qb for a team that isn t one player away from contending in a heartbeat simmons was a leader and the squad s pulse but when you have that kind of offer you have to pull the trigger tennessee isn t a jeffery simmons away from being a perennial contender his next few years would have been spent withering away during yet another rebuild and he d have lost trade value it s going to stink for the rest of the locker room this year as robert saleh s team figures to continue struggling however that would be the case with or without simmons until second year qb cam ward morphs into a consistent difference maker not just a sometimes player the titans won t take a step forward if that doesn t happen tennessee will need all the first round picks it can get to find the next guy and give him the best chance to succeed colts part with another pro bowler get pick from 49ers date of trade oct 27 san francisco receives dl deforest buckner grade a indianapolis receives 2027 fourth round draft pick grade b we didn t have to wait long to find out how others in the nfc west would react to the seahawks splash move for quenton nelson hours later the 49ers bolstered their defensive interior by bringing back buckner whom they traded to indy in 2020 the reunion was telegraphed for weeks buckner clearly fed up with the mounting losses in indianapolis began voicing his displeasure couple that with the 49ers need along the defensive line and the move made almost too much sense the niners have the cap space to cover the remainder of buckner s contract assuming it s not adjusted and are all in after their first loss of the season buckner has 47 0 sacks since 2020 tied for second among defensive tackles behind only chris jones 55 122 qb hits 420 tackles and 312 qb pressures the big man can still be a people mover on the interior however the 32 year old is showing some signs of a slide he generated four sacks in 10 games in 2025 his fewest since 2017 his pass rush percentages are also down a tick from the past couple of years he s generated an 8 3 qb pressure rate through seven games buckner was at 10 3 in 2025 and 11 7 in 2024 similarly his run stop rates have dipped as well going from 15 7 in 2024 to 15 6 in 2025 to 12 4 in 2026 is it age or can we just chalk the dips up to playing in a struggling defense for a losing team regardless of whether he s on the downturn buckner represents an upgrade in the middle of the 49ers battered defensive line paired with osa odighizuwa the niners now have two players who can push the pocket if buckner also boosts the interior run d probably the 49ers weakest spot at this point it will be a clear win for the niners the cost might be a tad much for an 11 year pro on the back nine of his career who could be a short term rental but a fourth rounder isn t exorbitant by any stretch it s the type of move a team like the 49ers in a super bowl window should make i ll reward aggression with day 3 draft picks when it nets a good player who can make a difference in a playoff run buckner was probably the most obvious asset the colts had that was going to be moved he was in the final year of his contract clearly unhappy and any compensatory pick they could have received back would have been at most a fifth rounder in 2028 due to how long he s been in the league if he even signs a deal big enough to qualify in 2027 getting a fourth rounder in 2027 out of that is a win for indy the colts need as many lotto tickets as possible for the next general manager i d expect ed dodds to listen to offers on any of his pending free agents and potentially others under contract beyond 2027 the only real issue with the oct 27 deal is that as with nelson the colts might have gotten more for buckner possibly a late round sweetener by shopping him around for another two weeks even with that qualification i still like the return indy got in this swap seahawks acquire eight time pro bowl guard from colts date of trade oct 27 seattle receives g quenton nelson grade a indianapolis receives 2027 third round draft pick 2028 fifth round draft pick grade b the seahawks had some sneaky issues along the offensive line despite entering the season with the same five that helped win a super bowl while the run game concerns have mostly been pinned on the running backs the blocking has struggled to open holes on 184 rb carries the seahawks have just 92 yards before contact this season per next gen stats and they ve been stuffed 37 times that s not the type of offense mike macdonald wants to employ yes getting zach charbonnet and jadarian price back healthy could have helped but general manager john schneider went to cure the root cause nelson is an eight time pro bowl guard who is still playing at a hall of fame level the 30 year old can open holes in the run game is a weapon as a puller and is superior as a pass protector in eight seasons in indy he allowed no more than eight qb hits in a single season per pff the seahawks just added the nfl s most complete guard how will the rest of the nfc west respond the addition will immediately help sam darnold keeping the qb clean will go a long way toward negating some of the wayward interceptions adding nelson also aids whoever lines up at left tackle where starter charles cross is expected to miss a week or two with a high ankle sprain importing the left guard will bump second year player grey zabel to right guard where he played in college and where seattle has had trouble for a while anthony bradford struggled even during the super bowl run the price for seattle is excellent given that it s expected to get a slew of compensatory picks in 2027 nelson being on an expiring deal also helps if he leaves for a big deal the seahawks would be in line for another comp pick in 2028 we ve seen schneider re sign players acquired in season as well leonard williams and rashid shaheed so it s not guaranteed to be a rental for the seahawks either it s not every day you can snag a future hall of famer to fill a significant hole without giving up a pick in the top two rounds i was somewhat surprised indy couldn t get a second round pick back given the overwhelming need across the league along the offensive line but we know that gms are stingier in season then become drunken sailors on draft day so maybe i shouldn t be so amazed i can t blame the colts for moving any and all assets to recoup chris ballard s mistakes but i wonder if they d have gotten more by waiting until closer to the deadline without a first round pick which right now would be in the top 10 and a roster riddled with holes the next general manager needs as much ammo as possible stripping down the roster will only make the sauce gardner trade sting even more given nelson s status as a pending free agent the colts could have waited and let him walk in free agency but the compensation would have been a third round pick max in 2028 this trade allows them to get the pick a year earlier and adds a fifth round sweetener trading away their best player two weeks before the trade deadline suggests a teardown is in play indy should be very active over the next fortnight and you can bet any gm with a need is going to put in a call to colts interim gm ed dodds cards deal former no 4 pick to texans date of trade oct 12 houston receives wr marvin harrison 2027 sixth round draft pick grade c arizona receives 2027 second round draft pick 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b when the trade details came through i assumed it was a typo that the texans shipped a 2027 second round pick for a player who was clearly out of the rotation in arizona my brain rationalized it as a 2028 second rounder or a 2027 fourth rounder nope the texans paid a premium pick in the upcoming draft for a shot at revitalizing harrison s career the cards reportedly had made it known they were holding out for a second round pick the moment the texans upped their bid to a second in 2027 they pounced i don t fault arizona for moving on right now in four games in 2026 harrison caught five passes on 13 targets for 85 yards and one touchdown that s like a half of one game for the upper echelon of wrs harrison has generated 0 6 yards per route run this year the third lowest among players with at least 100 routes per next gen stats basically harrison has been doing little more than a cardio workout on sundays getting a second rounder is solid work the grade isn t higher because the same brass that acquired that asset used the no 4 overall pick on harrison in 2024 monti ossenfort still gets docked for whiffing on a prime selection i understand why the texans would take a swing on harrison like most of the league they probably gave the ohio state product a very high pre draft grade reuniting him with former buckeyes teammate c j stroud could bring out the best in the wideout the texans have struggled mightily to move the ball when nico collins has been injured and given collins history and the hard hits he takes he s not guaranteed to make it through the rest of the season without missing time after laying an egg for four weeks the 1 4 texans don t have any more wiggle room harrison s contract isn t onerous giving houston some insurance if tank dell never returns to form or jayden higgins is delayed next year coming off a season ending injury in the short term this trade is somewhat duplicative of the much cheaper deal in which it acquired kayshon boutte it s more costly but gives the club more control of the future mostly i don t love the price tag for a player who hasn t been who we thought he was for it to make sense to give up a day 2 pick the texans need harrison to finally break out after two mediocre seasons perhaps in improved surroundings and on a team that clearly wants him with a qb he knows and trusts harrison can blossom frankly i probably like many scouts can t figure out the disconnect between a player who looked as polished and well rounded as harrison did at osu and the one we ve seen lope about for two plus years the question is whether you believe the scouting or the two separate coaching staffs who haven t found much use for him the texans are betting on their scouting eagles send pro bowl ol to ravens date of trade oct 7 baltimore receives c cam jurgens 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b philadelphia receives 2027 fifth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade a we should start with the obvious the two time pro bowler was available for a reason especially after the same offensive line saw a future hall of famer lane johnson retire the day prior jurgens is currently a pro bowler in name only after battling through a back injury in 2024 to help the eagles net a super bowl ring jurgens has not been the same player he struggled through last season and has been a liability through four games this year his pass blocking has never been otherworldly but it s particularly crumbled after he was asked to move to left guard the past three weeks blame the previous injuries or the ill fit in the eagles new blocking scheme but jurgens has been borderline unplayable the past few weeks drew kendall played better than jurgens at center in sean mannion s scheme so a move back wasn t in the cards it got so bad that nick sirianni was fending off questions about potentially benching the guard instead philly shipped him out of town we know that howie roseman doesn t care what year he gets his picks famously saying a first round pick is a first round pick regarding the a j brown trade this offseason when philly netted a 28 first however we can dock him ever so slightly for delayed satisfaction otherwise getting a second rounder for a struggling player who was not a fit is a home run in the short term the eagles offensive line is in flux with willie lampkin in line to take over at guard the hope is that landon dickerson returns to form when he eventually comes off injured reserve the trade is jarring coming right after johnson s retirement but getting a significant draft pick back for a player who was on the verge of being benched makes sense philly is now loaded in the 2028 draft with two firsts and two seconds even acknowledging jurgens significant struggles the play makes sense for the ravens the plans to replace tyler linderbaum who signed with the raiders in free agency this summer were wobbly from the start the ones they rode with danny pinter jovaughn gwyn and ethan pocic have all landed on injured reserve counting on pocic coming off injury was always a gamble the ravens crapped out instead of sticking with rookie olaivavega ioane out of position at center baltimore will take a roll of the dice that jurgens can get back to form it s not a terrible gamble and it s conceivable the 27 year old can bounce back with a return to center in a different scheme jurgens contract which has him under team control through 2029 for relatively cheap is also desirable for baltimore injury is always part of the equation and jurgens enters his time in baltimore in the league s concussion protocol nfl network s mike garafolo reported if he s healthy and returns to form this will be an excellent move for baltimore if he continues to struggle or misses a ton of time it will be the latest swing and miss in trying to replace linderbaum porter drama ends in trade to dallas date of trade oct 1 dallas receives cb joey porter grade a pittsburgh receives 2027 sixth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade c the cowboys desperately needed corner help for a defense that has floundered despite the offseason upgrades i ll credit jerry jones for not sitting on his hands instead doing what we have been asking general managers to do for years be bold make moves and don t overvalue your own picks during a season we won t know if the trade pays off in the long term but the cowboys certainly improved in 2026 at his peak porter is a physical cover man who can be sticky on the outside and mirror top receivers he ll slide well into christian parker s scheme allowing dallas to play man coverage on the outside with more physicality than in the first three weeks sure he racks up some penalties but so do most cbs you ll live with the trade off for a corner with jpj s skill set that dallas didn t have to give up a premier pick until 2028 also improved its grade assuming that porter plays the cowboys get a top shelf cb for a relatively cheap up front cost jones seems to be hoping he can copy the success he had with the george pickens trade pushing off the long term talks until down the road it s a needle threading but one that could work if porter plays well dallas could extend him in the offseason use the franchise tag on the cb or let him walk and recoup a potential third round compensatory pick in 2028 possibly moving down one round in 28 and giving up a sixth rounder for a potential pro bowl player in a year when you re all in is a stellar move if porter delivers 14 games of high level play it s worth it of course if porter gets hurt or implodes this all goes for naught however if he continues on this track it is a short term win for the cowboys the long term question can be shelved i don t fault the steelers for not wanting to pay porter top cb money if he were seeking a 30 million type deal in line with christian gonzalez or devon witherspoon i would have balked too jpj is good he s not at that level trading him away relieved pittsburgh of that problem the issue i have is that it appears steelers gm omar khan either overplayed his hand or didn t anticipate porter s gumption when it came to a new deal if khan had never planned to meet the corner s contract demands he should have made a move in the spring or early summer a player of porter s caliber is worth more than a second round pick two drafts down the road the timing of the impasse reduced the compensation now the steelers are without a top corner and find themselves thin and young at the position not a good combo if things spiral in pittsburgh it s fair to wonder if khan will even be around to make that second round pick in 2028 the gm took over in 2022 and received early praise for fleecing the bears in the chase claypool trade that brought back a second rounder that pick became porter khan has now moved him for pennies on the dollar add in a string of so so drafts the pickens trade and other questionable moves and the seat in pittsburgh could get hot for khan if the steelers flounder giants trade for mccarthy after dart injury date of trade sept 28 new york receives qb j j mccarthy grade c minnesota receives 2027 fifth round draft pick grade c minnesota signaled its intent to move on from the former no 10 overall pick by inking kyler murray and bringing back carson wentz in the offseason mccarthy got a slim shot at the starting job during training camp but he couldn t even fend off wentz for the primary backup role a former first rounder turned clipboard holder is a bad look all around had another club made an offer of substance before the season i believe the vikings would have moved on then given mccarthy s rough preseason however it s no surprise it took an injury to a starting qb to move the needle a fifth rounder isn t nothing and the vikings save a few pennies however the reality is they turned a first fourth and late round pick swap into 10 starts and a future fifth rounder that math isn t mathing mccarthy s poor play and injury history left the vikings with no good options for a team in win now mode minnesota didn t have time to let the 23 year old develop on his terms moving on makes sense but the vikings can t get a high grade for the compensation new york took a shot that in a new setting and in an offense keyed on the ground attack john harbaugh and his staff can do what kevin o connell couldn t i don t hate the price for a former first round quarterback who even the stingiest draft graders pegged as a day 2 selection teams use fifth rounders and later as qb dart throws all the time the giants lack of 2027 picks is of concern but they can deal with that later with jaxson dart out for the regular season after knee surgery the giants needed to make some sort of move jameis winston has shown he can hold the fort for a spell but it s a serious question if harbaugh will give the boom or bust passer enough leash for a 15 game run bringing in mccarthy at least gives the giants another alternative if winston crumbles at this stage there aren t a whole lot of other options i m not optimistic that mccarthy can turn his career around but for a fifth round pick it s worth a shot for new york

news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 9 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 9 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below madrid cincinnati bengals 34 atlanta falcons 17 early window denver broncos 26 carolina panthers 21 dallas cowboys 27 indianapolis colts 23 kansas city chiefs 35 new york jets 12 detroit lions 19 miami dolphins 9 new orleans saints 23 cleveland browns 22 ot new york giants 19 philadelphia eagles 11 los angeles rams 20 washington commanders 13 late window houston texans 44 los angeles chargers 22 san francisco 49ers 38 las vegas raiders 17 green bay packers 45 new england patriots 27 seattle seahawks 17 arizona cardinals 3 sunday night chicago bears 27 tampa bay buccaneers 24 jeremy bergman s takeaways cincy s stars sizzle in espana few teams have had better 10 quarter stretches than the bengals over the past three weeks since being shut out in the first half against baltimore in week 7 cincinnati has responded with 112 points over two and a half games leading the way is joe burrow staking a strong claim in the mvp race burrow was lethal again on sunday in the first half leading cincy s offense to four scoring drives on 9 3 yards per play and completing 82 of his passes for 239 yards eight of those completions went to ja 39 marr chase who set a career high with 142 yards in the first half finishing with 155 and a score on 10 catches showcasing his dynamic ability on an international stage for the first time tee higgins boxed out c j henderson and atlanta s defensive backs for two tds even chase brown season high 6 3 ypc and cincinnati s anemic run game season best 123 yards showed some explosion after sunday s romp cincinnati has now won four straight games with at least 30 points scored for the first time in franchise history if the bengals are capable of this type of production weekly do they even need to swing big for a piece possibly at running back at the trade deadline that s a question for tuesday maybe atlanta will have an answer for cincy s offensive onslaught by then another big bijan day undone by atlanta errors a week after losing to a tampa team that didn t complete a pass the falcons found a more traditional way to fall sunday morning play leaky defense commit penalties repeat in pristine climate controlled conditions inside madrid s bernabeu there were no excuses for atlanta s performance first the positives michael penix threw three fewer interceptions than he did a week prior and scrambled for a career high 50 yards looking svelte and nimble on the spanish pitch bijan robinson who loves an exclusive window rushed for 100 again totaling 147 yards from scrimmage and one td on the day the elusive dynamo was right at home at the home of real madrid s galacticos but jeff ulbrich s defense was a sieve against the nfl s hottest attack allowing 7 1 yards per play and forcing just two punts on the day atlanta also committed 12 accepted penalties for 88 yards repeatedly setting back the offense the falcons o line committed two fouls in the red zone on their second drive leading to the first field goal of a touchdown fight its most critical error though came at the start of the fourth quarter when down two tds at the bengals 10 yard line atlanta was called for offensive holding on a third and 2 incompletion cincy accepted the penalty and forced a fourth and 12 settling for cutting a two score lead to a two score lead nick folk instead shanked a 38 yard field goal and the bengals lead held at 14 the falcons never got closer a tale of two divisions despite the result cincinnati and atlanta will both return to the states tied in the win column for leads in their respective divisions the bengals victory moved them into a 6 2 tie atop the afc north with the steelers setting up a critical sunday night football showdown on the banks of the ohio river in week 10 having already lost this season to pittsburgh the bengals need a home win against aaron rodgers and co to improve their division record and ensure no favor in the head to head tiebreaker down in the cursed nfc south the falcons at 3 6 are nowhere near out of it but are at risk of falling behind hotter clubs after sunday s slate atlanta is essentially tied with carolina 3 5 new orleans 3 5 and tampa bay 3 6 a needed bye awaits for the falcons after a week 10 matchup with patrick mahomes chiefs next gen stats insight for bengals falcons via nfl pro joe burrow was pressured on nine of 32 dropbacks 28 1 against the falcons completing 20 of 23 passes for 237 yards and two touchdowns when kept clean his time to pressure of 3 26 seconds was the longest of his career and the falcons defense had just one quick pressure in the game nfl research joe burrow and ja marr chase connected for their 19th touchdown of at least 40 yards in sunday s win tied with joe montana and jerry rice for the third most by any qb receiver duo since 1980 the only duos with more are peyton manning and marvin harrison 21 tds and steve young and jerry rice 20 tds their first quarter touchdown was the 58th score by the duo overall including playoffs which passed daunte culpepper and randy moss for second most by any qb receiver duo before age 30 trailing only dan marino and mark clayton 68 tds back to top nick shook s takeaways broncos win a game of runs it wasn t quite an avalanche but as is often the case in basketball sunday s game became a tale of runs what began as a one sided contest in favor of denver reversed course just before halftime sunday when the panthers turned an interception into a scoring possession to claw back into the competition that shift in momentum saw bryce young enter a flow state dotting the field with precise confident passes and leading a second scoring drive to double up between halves and put the panthers in a 14 13 lead he appeared poised to extend that lead in the fourth too but a wacky interception snagged by denver safety devon key stopped the panthers in their tracks and swung momentum back in favor of the broncos who rattled off two straight touchdown drives to take a 26 14 lead in the final period good for their latest fourth quarter comeback effort denver had to hang on for dear life in the final minutes after carolina mounted one final push and it s not exactly a resounding victory but it s the latest example of a contending team finding a way to win a back and forth contest by coming through in the most important moments and finishing in a style that fits the team s strengths with edge rusher nik bonitto strip sacking young to stop the panthers final drive in its tracks bo nix looked more like the passer we ve known him to be too a small but encouraging sign as the calendar creeps toward thanksgiving panthers defensive changes fail to produce improvement defensive coordinator ejiro evero became the fall guy when coach dave canales relieved him of his duties following carolina s week 8 loss to green bay installing an interim dc with the hopes it might improve the panthers inconsistent defense in short it didn t the panthers allowed denver to break 300 yards of total offense and mount two touchdown drives that appeared vastly different but produced the same result the first fourth quarter scoring march covered 80 yards over 14 plays while the other needed just six plays to gain 61 yards and finish with a wide open touchdown pass to pat bryant as a result of a blown coverage a symptom of a defense that is still scrambling to take care of the details carolina stood tall late buying its offense a chance to compile a game winning drive but the earlier breakdowns represent a persistent issue had cornerback corey thornton not made an incredibly athletic play on the ball to pick off nix this game might have snowballed out of control in the first half long before the panthers offense was able to climb back into the game had jaylen waddle not exited due to a head injury denver might have continued to rely on the playmaker to break open for big gains this unit was never going to be completely fixed in one week but sunday told us there s still plenty to correct nix begins to break out of his shell it didn t last throughout the entire game but seemingly for the first time in ages bo nix took the training wheels off his own bicycle and let himself play a bit more instinctively proof existed in his decisions made while rolling out in which nix twice opted to throw back against his body to open targets underneath instead of accepting a small scramble gain or throwing it away his bullet ripped through traffic to courtland sutton for a touchdown was another encouraging sign because he was willing to take a minor risk and when bryant streaked open through the carolina secondary nix didn t hesitate to put the ball on him for a score the results are evident in his stat line 25 of 37 237 yards two touchdowns one interception it s not a massive change in performance but it s a start broncos fans have been yearning to see for weeks we ll see if it s a sign of things to come next gen stats insight for broncos panthers via nfl pro bo nix posted a 124 2 passer rating against single high coverage 20 of 26 for 202 yards and two touchdowns but a 15 3 passer rating against split safety coverage 5 of 11 for 35 yards and an interception his 15 3 passer rating against split safety looks was his lowest in a game since his nfl debut in week 1 2024 nfl research the broncos won 26 21 in week 9 against the panthers after trailing by one point entering the fourth quarter their fifth win of the season after trailing at any point in the fourth that is tied with the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings for the most wins after trailing in the fourth quarter in a team s first nine games of a season since 2000 both the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings lost their first playoff game that season in the wild card round back to top kevin patra s takeaways cowboys survive collapse to secure a much needed win over colts brian schottenheimer s squad tried to give the game away luckily the cowboys opponent did a better job dallas built a 10 point lead deep into the third quarter mistakes then gave indianapolis life ceedee lamb fumbled late the cowboys second turnover of the day to wipe out a chance to put the game away despite putting up stats with george pickens out lamb had a mistake filled day in addition to the fumble he was called for offensive pass interference twice and couldn t toe tap a td that cost the cowboys four points in the red zone dallas couldn t get out of its own way for much of the contest dak prescott was far more off the mark than we re used to leading to stalled drives schotty s club was called for 14 penalties for a whopping 153 yards turned the ball over twice and missed a late go ahead field goal that s how you let an opponent amid a fire sale stay in a game despite being outgained 508 271 dallas should have run away with the game instead it trailed late until ryan flournoy the best no 3 wr in the league made a massive play for a 46 yard gain to set up the game winning td a loss would have all but doomed the cowboys who still have a big hill to climb in the nfc east colts offense can t kick it into gear until late facing a bad cowboys defense daniel jones and co couldn t take advantage for long stretches indy went three and out five times including on four of its first five drives the other was a 19 yard td drive following a dak prescott fumble jones was inconsistent and often off the mark completing 20 of 34 passes for 180 yards with a td and an interception the cowboys d entered the game allowing a league high 385 4 yards per game and 5 9 yards per play 29th indy generated just 271 yards and 4 6 yards per play while going 3 for 13 on third down ashton dulin s 55 yard catch and run td was indy s only pass play longer than 16 yards jones averaged 2 6 air yards per completion in the game third fewest of his career minimum 10 completions per next gen stats against a dallas d that s been ripped up jones needed to do more the rushing attack did some solid work generating 105 total yards on the ground with seth mcgowan earning 7 5 yards per carry on six totes with a td if sunday was jonathan taylor s final game in indy mcgowan flashed some upside to take over the bulk of the workload downs calls game when javonte williams scored the go ahead touchdown with a little over a minute remaining the big question was whether a sieve dallas d could hold on caleb downs ensured it would by stepping in front of a daniel jones pass sealing the win over his brother josh downs squad the int capped a game in which downs generated a sack three tackles a qb hit a tackle for loss and two passes defensed allowing just one reception on four targets sunday marked the first time all season that the cowboys defense allowed fewer than 318 total yards doing so against a team that s begun a mid season teardown is one thing the cowboys will have a stiffer test against kyle shanahan and the 49ers in week 10 next gen stats insight for cowboys colts via nfl pro ceedee lamb caught six of 12 targets for 180 yards and a touchdown on downfield throws 10 plus air yards in week 9 against the colts the most receiving yards he has recorded on downfield throws in his career nfl research sunday marked dak prescott s first game with 300 plus passing yards multiple passing touchdowns no interceptions and a game winning drive since 2018 in a week 17 win against the giants prescott had one such game in each of his first three career seasons but none from 2019 2025 back to top bobby kownack s takeaways k9 scores touchdowns kenneth walker s reign of terror over the rest of the league took a couple weeks break as the running back was held to 105 rushing yards and no touchdowns over the previous two contests after torching opponents for 665 rushing yards and eight total scores in his first five outings as a chief unfortunately for the jets his dominance s brief hiatus ended sunday walker was a man on a mission versus gang green almost singlehandedly keeping kansas city afloat amid a slow start that included two fumbles a three and out and a missed field goal over the opening two quarters kansas city s other two first half drives ended a bit differently on 7 and 25 yard touchdown receptions by walker he provided the offensive spark while patrick mahomes worked to piece together a consistent passing game using anyone else and after the rest of the operation caught up to walker s heroics to start pulling away from the jets he added a 2 yard td run in the third quarter walker finished with 102 rushing yards a 5 7 per carry average and four runs of 10 plus yards as well as four catches for 41 yards that s after he was able to take a rest midway through the fourth quarter due to a blowout he helped create he now has five games with multiple scrimmage touchdowns the most in the nfl this season and the most by a chiefs running back since larry johnson eight in 2005 wilson is sorely missed by jets there was a lot of intrigue surrounding new york s offense heading into week 9 how would the jets mix breece hallback into the rotation after braelon allen excelled to such a degree during the starter s four game absence how would the passing offense operate without garrett wilson after omar cooper and adonai mitchell recently took turns breaking out for new york as far as the running backs hall saw 18 touches to allen s 10 with hall turning his into 87 yards and allen totaling 54 both running backs averaged 4 1 yards per carry as for the passing offense it was ugly wilson had appeared frustrated in recent weeks as he produced smaller numbers than his counterparts hauling in 12 catches for 153 yards without a score over his previous three games before sustaining a concussion but it s clear he makes the offense go without the star there to demand attention from kansas city s secondary the chiefs had little problem shutting down geno smith smith threw for only 165 yards cooper led the way with 58 yards on eight receptions while mitchell went from 142 yards on seven catches last week to zero catches on seven looks a game later new york got nothing going settling for four field goals in the first half tied for the most over the last 10 seasons in the second half the jets didn t even get the opportunity to settle smith and co managed 58 yards over five drives on the other side of intermission forced to watch their two point halftime deficit unravel into a 23 point loss chiefs come alive for much needed blowout kansas city rode a two game losing streak into week 9 with a 22 fourth quarter point differential that ranked 31st in the league over the past two games if there s one thing patrick mahomes is going to do though it s beat up on bad teams by defeating the jets he moved to 18 0 in his career against teams entering a matchup four plus games under 500 the best by any quarterback since 1970 minimum 15 starts per nfl research he went 23 of 31 for 242 yards and two touchdowns with a 117 9 passer rating but most importantly seemed ok after a strip sack by david bailey late in the second quarter bent his elbow awkwardly and forced him to receive medical attention on the sideline he returned and overcame a frustrating offensive stupor to blow the doors off the jets while the chiefs defense minimized damage early and inflicted plenty of it throughout kansas city pressured geno smith on half of his dropbacks chris jones and george karlaftis led the team with six pressures and two sacks apiece while drue tranquill logged 13 tackles and nick bolton had 12 plus a forced fumble detractors will point out it s only the jets and there are still some issues to work out think harrison butker missing a 56 yard field goal and the subsequent 51 yarder after getting a reprieve due to an offsides penalty just before half but the chiefs can only play who is in front of them in this case they demolished them next gen stats insight for jets chiefs via nfl pro travis kelce caught four of six targets for 72 yards accounting for two of the chiefs five explosive passes 40 0 nfl research kenneth walker had his first career game with multiple receiving touchdowns to go along with a rushing touchdown in the chiefs win over the jets his second career game with three touchdowns back to top bobby kownack s takeaways usual suspects lift detroit to tightly contested win sunday s victory over miami was not your typical lions affair jared goff and the offense took forever to get going and it seemed as if they knew things weren t quite clicking the lions pulled out all the stops against their one win opponent they went for it on fourth down on the first drive a few plays later jahmyr gibbs took a direct snap and faked a pitch to goff before streaking around the edge for 16 yards two plays into the second quarter detroit converted a fake punt throw by jack fox on fourth and 7 from its own 30 the lions constantly stalled out failing to score a touchdown until 1 20 remained in the third quarter and that was a run by gibbs on fourth down too luckily they had a couple stars to lean on to help guide them through their struggles amon ra st brown was the main source of the team s passing offense deep into the final frame at the start of the lions seventh drive of the game he had seven catches while the rest of detroit s pass catchers had combined for six st brown drew a third down pass interference penalty early on that possession and a few plays later hauled in a key 17 yard catch on third and 8 to keep the chains moving with a perilous seven point lead he eventually finished with 86 yards on eight receptions every other lion combined for 10 catches and 95 yards and though gibbs was frequently met by a pod of dolphins in the backfield he still broke off a number of clutch gainers including the aforementioned 8 yard td run he finished with a game high 74 rushing yards that was about it for offensive highlights but it was enough miami wastes strong defensive performance jeff hafley s defense fought valiantly against the league s no 3 scoring offense if only the rest of the team had been able to repay the group s efforts the dolphins consistently crashed into detroit s backfield to locate jahmyr gibbs containing the electric back who had been averaging 4 9 yards per carry entering week 9 to 3 7 yards per attempt on 20 rushes jared goff struggled to find and hit open passers throwing for a season low 170 yards he was sacked three times and tossed just his second pick of the season to rookie corner chris johnson after josh uche hit his arm during the throwing motion the dolphins didn t bend to the point of allowing a touchdown the only one of the game until the waning minutes of the third quarter malik willis and the offense could do nothing with their opportunities however willis threw for only 128 yards and an interception and seemed hesitant to open it up on the ground two carries for 7 yards while ollie gordon was held to 55 rushing yards when the fins had a chance to make it a tie game heading into halftime they instead committed a holding penalty and missed a 38 yard field goal on the final two plays of the second quarter toward the start of the fourth quarter down 10 with the ball at detroit s 7 yard line willis took two sacks over the next three plays before miami settled for a three points gut wrenching mistakes are no way to beat a contender like the lions and the dolphins certainly made their share of them ugly game all around one of the biggest concerns for any 5 2 team traveling to face a 1 6 opponent is typically avoiding playing down to the lesser squad s level the lions absolutely joined the dolphins in the doldrums for a messy matchup that will have neither side coming away feeling particularly happy the lions and dolphins combined for 20 accepted penalties with detroit committing nine to miami s 11 they went 7 for 24 on third down collectively detroit managed only 270 yards nearly 100 fewer than its previous low on the season 355 miami posted its second lowest yardage total of the year with 228 thanks to the offensive ineptitude a few of the most exciting plays of the matchup were actually fake punts both teams ran one and both teams converted on passes one by lions punter jack fox and another by dolphins punter bradley pinion it was the first time since at least 1950 that multiple punters have completed a pass in the same game per nfl research give credit to the lions defense for showing up and making life miserable for the dolphins but detroit didn t exactly put an exclamation point on this one despite running its winning streak to four next gen stats insight for lions dolphins via nfl pro aidan hutchinson matched up against austin jackson 16 times in week 9 all one on one recording six pressures 37 5 pressure rate including two quick pressures under 2 5 seconds nfl research jahmyr gibbs recorded his 60th career touchdown tying hall of famer ladainian tomlinson for the second most by any player in their first four seasons in nfl history trailing only hall of famer terrell davis with 61 back to top nick shook s takeaways saints come alive to earn much needed win by all accounts sunday was an ugly display of football between two middling teams for most of the afternoon a field goal fest including a charlie smyth first half miss set up for what appeared to be a likely 9 6 finish until the browns finally hit a big play for a touchdown when shedeur sanders connected with rookie kc concepcion for a 64 yard passing touchdown the score seemed to position the browns for another fourth quarter comeback win but instead it awoke the saints with just enough time for chaos to ensue new orleans covered 55 yards in six plays and 50 seconds to take a 16 13 lead allowed the browns to tie the game with 0 08 left then embarked on an efficient relentless 74 yard scoring drive that required 11 plays and ended with a pretty touchdown pass from tyler shough to juwan johnson for a 23 16 lead in overtime the stop of cleveland s two point try in overtime sealed the win but it was only made possible by some late success that must have felt for saints fans like the thawing of an offense that spent far too long frozen within a glacier at 3 5 the saints are back in the thick of a race for an nfc south crown that might only require nine wins to secure if they re going to get there sunday s late push toward a victory was essential browns show clear weaknesses in brutal defeat cleveland has lost its ability to stop the run since losing maliek collins to injury and delivered an embarrassing effort against the saints low ceiling rushing attack sunday allowing audric estim 233 who was a member of the browns less than a month ago tyler shough and alvin kamara to run for 155 yards on 31 attempts pacing an offense that came to life thanks to this newfound balance in the second half even worse cleveland s pass coverage unit struggled losing one on one matchups all afternoon grant delpit ronnie hickman and tyson campbell each struggled in such matchups and especially in the game s most crucial moments e g juwan johnson s overtime touchdown and a 33 yard completion from shough to chris olave late in the fourth quarter paired with an offense that wasn t threatening for most of the afternoon with sanders at quarterback cleveland was guaranteed to be locked in a four quarter battle with a team most expected it to defeat without a major struggle instead the browns fell in a fashion that is a strong competitor with their week 1 blowout loss to jacksonville for worst defeat of the season that s not a good place to be in in week 9 shough finds his stride new orleans offense has lacked juice for some time now draining the saints of their early season optimism that was tied to the trajectory of tyler shough in his second nfl season that finally changed in the fourth quarter sunday when cleveland stunned the superdome crowd with an explosive touchdown pass from shedeur sanders to kc concepcion new orleans offense woke up stringing together well designed passing plays with a rushing attack that finally showed some life to move down the field with relative ease against a browns defense that had limited it all afternoon shough was at the center of all of it calmly dropping dimes on chris olave juwan johnson and even rookie jordyn tyson to propel the offense to two clutch touchdown drives in a wild fourth quarter and overtime period we saw the return of a composed accurate shough whose clutch gene sure anyone is going to overtake current favorite josh allen in the mvp race this season but as i predicted he would jordan love planted his flag firmly in the conversation with his performance on sunday love completed 23 of 29 passes for 372 yards with three touchdowns in three and a half quarters of work backup tyrod taylor entered the blowout win in the fourth quarter love remains the league leader in passing yards with 2 618 232 yards more than any other qb sunday was yet another game where love received almost no help from the league s least productive running game and he also faced a lot of heat with the patriots pressuring him on 13 of his 33 dropbacks 39 4 it didn t matter love was locked in and dropping dimes to christian watson and matthew golden making a talented new england secondary look silly at times watson finished with a career high 171 receiving yards on seven catches while golden led the team with 10 grabs for a career high 164 yards the packers were the underdogs entering sunday s game but matt lafleur s crew controlled the contest from start to finish with its 1 2 start to the season feeling like a distant memory green bay gets a rematch at home against the nfc north leading vikings next week one storyline to follow leading up to that battle will be the status of running back josh jacobs who suffered a fractured finger on sunday maye s turnovers too much for patriots to overcome progress isn t always linear and sunday offered pats fans a stark reminder of that fact after drake maye shook off a turnover plagued start to the season to compile a touchdown to interception ratio of 11 1 in his previous four games sunday marked a step back for the third year qb he threw three interceptions in the first half and was lucky to avoid a fourth on a pass that was nearly picked off by the packers kamal hadden new england fell behind 24 7 in the second quarter and the rout was on maye was without wr1 a j brown but brown s only played in three games all season making a total of nine catches for 101 yards the patriots can t count on him to solve all their problems they were also without rb2 treveyon henderson on sunday and it s not clear when he will be back after being hospitalized recently with what he described as a medical emergency to make matters worse rb1 rhamondre stevenson exited the game with a knee injury there were more injuries to a banged up offensive line on sunday too it s all far from ideal for a team with playoff aspirations after winning the afc title last season now the patriots will go overseas for a munich matchup with the lions who have won four games in a row packers defense has something special brewing green bay s offense deserves plenty of praise for its performance but we should not overlook the team s defensive showing yes the packers gave up 27 points but the patriots two second half touchdowns were scored in garbage time when the game was out of hand jonathan gannon s defense had drake maye out of sorts from the jump finishing with four sacks and four takeaways all three of maye s ints ended up in the hands of safeties with xavier mckinney picking him off twice and evan williams snagging one on a deflection maye was pressured on 51 2 of his dropbacks the highest pressure rate he has faced in a regular season game just below the 52 8 he faced in the super bowl against the seahawks per next gen stats and we might not have seen green bay s best on defense yet with three time first team all pro apparently micah parsons getting closer to making his 2026 debut next gen stats insight for surpass 90 rushing yards in any of their first eight games of the 2026 season back to top nick shook s takeaways seahawks grind out another win seattle s offense still leaves plenty to be desired but and maintaining possession over the final 4 35 to secure a 17 3 win seattle accomplished this with backup drew lock playing in place of sam darnold while also dealing with his own elbow injury and sustaining an oblique injury during sunday s game generating enough offense to build a satisfactory lead for the defense to protect for the remainder of the game perhaps most importantly the seahawks won a game without receiving a massive contribution from jaxon smith njigba who finished with seven catches for 51 yards and didn t need to become the game breaking weapon he s been in most of seattle s triumphs this season it wasn t a performance that will take any heat off embattled offensive coordinator brian fleury but the win will quiet critics for the next week and a 5 4 record looks better than a 500 mark at this stage it was also equally important for seattle to keep pace in an nfc west that now features three teams above 500 minshew magic runs out gardner minshew s insertion into the lineup sparked a frantic comeback effort in a thrilling win over dallas in week 8 clearing the way for minshew to take over as starter for arizona to trade jacoby brissett to baltimore and for the cardinals to proceed with another veteran who seemed to have a better rapport with his targets and a higher willingness to take calculated risks in order to jump start the offense that gave cardinals fans reason to believe mike lafleur s offense might finally produce a quality day offensively even against one of the nfl s best defenses instead arizona encountered a familiar experience in its rematch with seattle struggling to generate offense and falling well short of competing with the seahawks in a loss that truly wasn t as close as the score suggested making matters worse was a hit minshew took to his right arm while throwing which seemed to sap him of the arm strength necessary to find open targets in the second half even when arizona flirted with another fourth quarter comeback minshew and the cardinals offense ran aground inside seattle s 10 extinguishing their fading hope of climbing back into the game and reminding arizona of the uphill battle it will face in most matchups going forward does this mean we might see rookie carson beck soon no not yet unless minshew s arm ends up being hurt worse than what was detectable sunday but the thrill of minshew s arrival and instant success proved to be unreliable dropping the cardinals to 3 6 in a season that s likely already starting to look toward april charbonnet shows some juice zach charbonnet the other half of seattle s past two headed backfield finally returned to the field in week 8 but didn t generate much in terms of production or pop it wasn t surprising given the nature of the knee injury that kept him out until his midseason arrival but with the seahawks desperate for ground game consistency they could use a notable contribution from the power back and finally received one sunday charbonnet rushed 16 times for 77 yards made a handful of defenders miss broke some tackles and looked much more like the runner he was in previous seasons bringing a welcome level of balance to an offense that already relied too heavily on sam darnold and was expected to do the same with backup drew lock jadarian price flashed in the passing game too making a fantastic sideline catch as part of his four receptions for 54 yards it s far from a guarantee that they ve suddenly rediscovered their ability to run the ball opponent must be considered in these small sample sizes but at least it s an encouraging sign for an offense that still hasn t found much of a rhythm next gen stats insight for cardinals seahawks via nfl pro seattle entered week 9 ranked 24th in rushing success rate 37 3 and bears down the field thanks mostly to a 38 yard hook up with a wide open colston loveland the final drive set up cairo santos for a game winning 38 yard field goal with zeroes on the clock it wasn t in the realm of possibility that the game would end in such fashion after williams had hit luther burden on a crosser for a 56 yard touchdown that led to a 14 0 lead at the conclusion of the first quarter williams had completed six of his eight pass attempts for 105 yards and two touchdowns each of the incompletions coming on drops thereafter williams was an atrocious 16 of 29 for 174 yards zero touchdowns a career worst four interceptions and a 33 5 rating in all the bears had five turnovers with williams first three picks coming on ill advised balls in which he appeared to be trying to throw the ball away while fading back and going airborne his fourth was off a deflection and the fifth giveaway was a burden fumble that set up the game tying score burden looked to have potentially gone limp on the hit that forced him to drop possession and suffered a concussion chicago s defense was truly the catalyst for the victory but it wouldn t be possible without williams brilliance early and his final drive dramatics ahead of this one the bears were getting crowned as the new super bowl darlings nothing comes easy in the nfl though and if chicago is to fulfill some high expectations williams must recover get his swagger back and be able to balance it without making the never before seen errors he did on a night in which he and his bears escaped with a w bucky defense have bucs flirting with comeback nine minutes into sunday s proceedings the buccaneers were down 14 points the bears running roughshod on both sides of the ball somehow someway tampa bay made a game of this and came oh so close to a stunning win the somehow was the bucs defense and the someway was bucky irving the defense had the aforementioned quintet of takeaways and held the bears offense to six points after giving up touchdowns on the first two drives zyon mccollum had a pair of picks alex anzalone had an interception and four qb pressures and josiah trotter brought the hat all night long leading a hard hitting defensive effort offensively irving did his best to do it all the squiggly runner had a game high 97 yards on 20 carries and both of tampa s touchdowns he added a team high four receptions for 28 yards it was irving who scored from 6 yards out with 2 51 to go to bring the score to 24 22 baker mayfield then ran in the tying two point conversion mayfield was limping throughout much of the game and it s been made clear that just as the defense is the hallmark of tampa s success irving is the motor driving the bucs offense with tampa sitting at 3 0 this season when irving hits 100 yards rushing he fell just short this night and so did the bucs fortunately at 3 6 the bucs are in the nfc south and right in the thick of the race for the division crown defense saves bears brutalizing baker mayfield and a jaylon johnson interception return for a touchdown keying the win the simmons effect is real so far with the acquisition of the pro bowl defensive tackle having booker sack four qb pressures johnson the high priced pro bowler has been terrible for most of the season as his 38 1 pro football focus grade would attest however with the bears clinging to a 17 13 lead and the buccaneers driving johnson jumped on a mayfield pass and weaved 67 yards the other way for a touchdown for a team to have five turnovers and still come out with a victory is next door to astonishing and the bears defense allowing the buccaneers to score just 10 points off those turnovers is the biggest reason why next gen stats insight for buccaneers bears via nfl pro the buccaneers
