news_mentions.headline: NFL midseason All-Rookie Team: Arvell Reese, David Bailey pacing 2026 draft picks
news_mentions.body_text: before the 2026 nfl draft the main debate was over who would be the first non quarterback selected david bailey or arvell reese now at the midway point of the season the debate rages on who is the nfl 39 s rookie of the year is it one of those two defensive stars both have played at extremely high levels with bailey among the most disruptive pass rushers in the league and reese creating a diverse impact using his versatility those two players were easy picks for this exercise other positions weren 39 t as simple our midseason nfl all rookie team quarterback first team jalon daniels tampa bay buccaneers the nfl has yet to see a 2026 draft pick start at quarterback so by default the undrafted daniels retains the spot he held on the quarter mark all rookie team one of the reasons daniels went undrafted was his high turnover rate which has carried over to the nfl he has more interceptions than touchdowns in two of three starts but daniels deserves credit for his week 5 performance as he led the buccaneers to a win over the cowboys he was turnover free that thursday night and used his mobility to avoid negative plays second team joe fagnano baltimore ravens nbsp with all due respect i guess this spot goes to fagnano he is the only other rookie also undrafted to start a game it didn 39 t go well at all but facing the jaguars who rank second in the nfl in scoring defense in your starting debut is a tough ask fagnano ranks second among all rookies in completions and first downs honorable mention fernando mendoza raiders athan kaliakmanis commanders jack strand falcons running back first team jonah coleman denver broncos despite a stint on injured reserve coleman has made a strong case as the nfl 39 s most impactful rookie back he is the only rookie with multiple rushing touchdowns and is tied for the rookie lead with 13 first down carries despite having far fewer attempts than others on the leaderboard coleman has also been productive in the passing game with 13 catches on 14 targets for 128 yards late in the fourth quarter against the chiefs he had a crucial 51 yard catch and run that set up denver 39 s go ahead touchdown a 5 yard run by coleman second team emmett johnson kansas city chiefs johnson ranks seventh among rookies in rushing yards but you can better understand his impact when factoring in receiving production through eight games he has 348 yards of total offense 237 receiving 111 rushing which ranks no 1 among rookie running backs he is also the only rookie back with both a rushing and receiving touchdown honorable mention kaelon black 49ers mike washington raiders jeremiyah love cardinals jadarian price seahawks seth mcgowan colts wide receiver first team denzel boston cleveland browns kc concepcion cleveland browns carnell tate tennessee titans no surprises here the same three names atop the rookie wr rankings at the quarter mark remain in place at the midway point they 39 re led by boston the seventh receiver drafted in april he leads all rookies in receiving yards 507 first down receptions 21 and receiving touchdowns three against the saints on sunday boston recorded his third catch of 50 plus yards which ties him with green bay 39 s christian watson for the nfl lead not far behind is concepcion who scored his first nfl touchdown on sunday in new orleans he ranks no 1 among rookies in receptions 37 and second in receiving yards 437 concepcion also leads all rookie receivers in catches of 20 plus yards eight and yards after the catch 237 which ranks top 20 in the nfl one spot behind amon ra st brown tate slots in just behind the browns 39 rookie duo with 34 catches for 413 yards and one touchdown he was exceptional at ohio state in contested situations and has continued that success in the nfl eight catches on nine contested targets however tate also leads all rookie receivers with four drops and three fumbles second team omar cooper new york jets makai lemon philadelphia eagles germie bernard pittsburgh steelers it has been a small yet impressive sample size from cooper despite almost all his production having come in three games he ranks fifth among rookies in receiving yards 306 and second with a pair of touchdown grabs lemon is tied with concepcion for the rookie lead with 37 receptions while bernard has helped expand the steelers 39 offense using his nose for the sticks honorable mention caleb douglas dolphins antonio williams commanders ted hurst buccaneers kevin coleman dolphins malachi fields giants chris bell dolphins josh cameron jaguars barion brown saints tight end first team kenyon sadiq new york jets the first tight end drafted in 2026 leads all rookie tight ends in catches 21 and receiving yards 235 each game sadiq seems to have a catch on which he is asked to high point and finish showing off his ball skills at different elevations most of his snaps have come in a detached alignment but he has been a capable run blocker when inline 37 7 percent of his snaps second team eli raridon new england patriots with 16 catches for 225 yards raridon joins sadiq as the only rookie tight ends with more than 150 receiving yards raridon leads all rookie tight ends in first down receptions 11 and is one of only two with multiple touchdown catches despite having a brutal drop on a potential walk in touchdown against the packers raridon also leads all rookie tight ends in blocking snaps and has kept his head above water in that area honorable mention nate boerkircher jaguars matthew hibner ravens josh cuevas ravens sam roush bears will kacmarek dolphins offensive tackle first team max iheanachor pittsburgh steelers blake miller detroit lions there isn 39 t a rookie offensive tackle running away with the top spot they 39 ve all been up and down iheanachor has had his share of struggles especially in the run game which was expected considering his inexperience but he hasn 39 t been a liability and the pittsburgh offensive line as a unit has been much better since he became the full time starter at right tackle in week 3 miller has probably been the most consistent rookie ot having allowed just one sack in seven starts at right tackle second team spencer fano cleveland browns markel bell philadelphia eagles fano 39 s tape has been full of high highs and low lows he has struggled against better talent see chase young this past sunday but he played above average against the jets titans and ravens before that fano has performed well enough to believe he can be a long term solution for the browns honorable mention kahlil benson chiefs monroe freeling panthers caleb lomu patriots travis burke chargers jayden williams cardinals interior offensive line first team vega ioane baltimore ravens austin barber cleveland browns francis mauigoa new york giants whether the ravens have needed him at guard or center ioane has been up for the challenge he hasn 39 t given up a sack since week 1 and has been the steadiest run blocker of all rookie offensive linemen barber is coming off arguably his worst game as a pro but there has been far more good than bad on his rookie tape he has been an iron man while battling through injuries and is tied with his teammate fano for the rookie lead in snaps played 588 i had higher hopes for mauigoa a top 10 pick but he has been good enough at right guard second team kadyn proctor miami dolphins jake slaughter los angeles chargers emmanuel pregnon jacksonville jaguars proctor had a strong case for the first team and it won 39 t be a surprise if he 39 s there before the end of the season slaughter has been solid although his rookie missteps have been costly mistakes pregnon leads the jaguars in snaps played but his mistakes are starting to add up nfl high 10 penalties honorable mention nbsp trey zuhn raiders keylan rutledge texans logan taylor chargers fernando carmona titans edge rusher first team david bailey new york jets gabe jacas new england patriots there isn 39 t much debate for the top two spots bailey leads all rookies in sacks 7 5 tackles for loss 11 forced fumbles five also tied for the league lead and pressures 31 he has taken his game to another level over his last four outings including a disruptive afternoon against patrick mahomes and the chiefs on sunday jacas is second among rookie edge rushers in sacks three and pressures 26 and he 39 s added an interception off aaron rodgers no less he needs to show better discipline with missed tackles and damaging penalties two roughing the passer two offsides but jacas has outplayed his draft spot second team dani dennis sutton green bay packers akheem mesidor los angeles chargers despite not being a starter dennis sutton has become a valuable role player on sub downs he ranks third among all rookies in pressures 23 and sacks three and he 39 s made an impact on kick and punt return coverage also coming off the bench mesidor has been one of the better all around rookie defensive linemen making plays both in pass rushing and in stopping the run he posted a career high seven pressures against the texans on sunday honorable mention r mason thomas chiefs cashius howell bengals romello height 49ers rueben bain buccaneers derrick moore lions caden curry colts defensive tackle first team gracen halton san francisco 49ers skyler gill howard detroit lions defensive tackle was not a strong position in the 2026 nfl draft and unsurprisingly it has been light in rookie output the 49ers had d line questions entering the season but halton has helped provide some answers he ranks third among all rookies in tackles for loss five and had one of the coolest rookie moments of the season when he forced a fumble against the seahawks and recovered it for his first nfl touchdown unfortunately halton suffered a broken ankle on sunday which will end his rookie season a subpackage defender gill howard ranks third on the lions and leads all rookie interior linemen in pressures 16 he was a day 3 steal second team lee hunter carolina panthers darrell jackson new york jets hunter is averaging fewer than 25 snaps per game but he is making the most of his playing time even if he isn 39 t dominating the box score you can feel his impact on tape jackson 39 s snap count has steadily increased too as he 39 s earned more trust from the coaching staff he leads all rookie defensive tackles in tackles 26 and has stacked positive reps see his week 8 snaps vs tyler linderbaum honorable mention chris mcclellan packers peter woods chiefs aaron hall panthers caleb banks vikings lt overton cowboys linebacker first team arvell reese new york giants jacob rodriguez miami dolphins reese terrorized the eagles this past sunday to the tune of 12 tackles three sacks and a forced fumble on a sack that took just 2 29 seconds the fastest sack in the nfl since week 7 of last season according to nextgenstats reese was my top ranked player in the 2026 draft and he hasn 39 t disappointed his main appeal as a prospect was his versatility which is also why he is one of the favorites for defensive rookie of the year he is the only nfl player not just among rookies with 65 plus tackles eight plus tackles for loss and at least one interception add in his forced fumble from sunday and 4 5 sacks and reese has made an impact for the nfc east leading giants there are multiple other rookie linebackers with a case to be on the first team but rodriguez has filled up the stat sheet 79 tackles four tackles for loss one forced fumble and one interception his most impressive stat though is an nfl best 33 34 defensive stops 34 reese ranks second with 32 second team anthony hill tennessee titans josiah trotter tampa bay buccaneers sonny styles washington commanders any of these three linebackers easily could have joined reese on the first team it 39 s a loaded year for rookies at the position hill averages 10 3 tackles per game which ranks third in the nfl behind only alex singleton and nakobe dean trotter has always been a hammer looking for a nail against the run but his improvements in coverage are promising styles and roquan smith are the only nfl linebackers with 67 plus tackles eight plus pressures and at least one interception and one forced fumble honorable mention kendal daniels falcons jaishawn barham cowboys harold perkins falcons jaden dugger 49ers bryce boettcher colts cj allen colts cornerback first team brandon cisse green bay packers mansoor delane kansas city chiefs this was a tough category because of the volatility from the rookie cb class cisse who leads all rookie corners in snaps played had some rough moments over the first month of the season but he has been stacking positive outings since the start of october over his last five games cisse has allowed zero touchdowns and just 50 percent completions when targeted along with four passes defended and one interception delane has missed three games because of a right shoulder injury but he performed at a high level in the five games he was on the field despite playing half the number of snaps as cisse he has almost as many passes defended four and the same number of interceptions one it helps that he has been strong as a tackler and has yet to commit a penalty second team davison igbinosun buffalo bills malik muhammad chicago bears igbinosun is one of nine nfl players and the only rookie with at least five pass breakups and one interception he was known for his hands on approach in coverage at ohio state and that has followed him to the nfl but he also does a great job using his length to suffocate passing windows over the past three games he has allowed only two catches with two pass breakups and his first career interception i was ready to put hezekiah masses here because he leads all rookies with three interceptions but his coverage tape over the last month just hasn 39 t been good enough muhammad has been banged up and had some rough patches as well see the packers game but he has played more reliable football honorable mention will lee panthers daylen everette steelers hezekiah masses raiders jermod mccoy raiders colton hood giants nickelback first team keionte scott tampa bay buccaneers scott fell further than expected on draft night because he is a very specific type of player an undersized nickel who is much better downhill than in reverse but when used in the correct role scott can shine and he has played well for a fast and physical bucs defense he has almost as many solo tackles as styles and is tied with caleb downs for the most defensive stops 14 among rookie dbs second team chris johnson miami dolphins nbsp johnson who just turned 22 this week has shown his youth at times but i have been impressed with his resiliency especially given that miami has used him both inside and outside johnson notched his first career interception on sunday off jared goff honorable mention kenneth harris colts keith abney lions avieon terrell falcons chandler rivers ravens d 39 angelo ponds jets safety first team treydan stukes las vegas raiders caleb downs dallas cowboys it can be tough not to have recency bias for an exercise like this but stukes 39 interception on sunday against the 49ers helped land him on the first team stukes now has a pair of interceptions and is tied for the rookie lead with three passes defended there certainly have been ups and downs for downs but he is coming off one of his most impactful games of his young career against the colts and his older brother josh downs he finished with three tackles two passes defended one sack and his first nfl interception to seal a win second team zakee wheatley carolina panthers dillon thieneman chicago bears wheatley has made his presence felt in different ways for the panthers he had a forced fumble in his nfl debut then picked off jordan love in week 8 for his first career interception his consistency in both run support and coverage has been an exciting development thieneman hasn 39 t been as consistent but he leads all rookie safeties in tackles 52 and we have seen an uptick in chicago 39 s willingness to vary his role including letting him loose as a blitzer honorable mention emmanuel mcneil warren browns michael taaffe dolphins genesis smith chargers a j haulcy colts robert spears jennings steelers xavier nwankpa chiefs kicker first team drew stevens washington commanders stevens has been the most consistent of the rookie kickers connecting on 12 of 12 field goal attempts of under 50 yards he had a few missed extra points early in the season but has been more reliable over the past month honorable mention trey smack packers dominic zvada giants punter first team tommy doman buffalo bills doman could have earn this spot solely based on his jarring hit on a kickoff against the vikings to force a fumble but he also ranks third in the nfl in hangtime 4 62 seconds with a respectable 43 2 yard net average honorable mention nbsp ryan eckley ravens brett thorson vikings this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Rams activate Myles Garrett (knee) from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game vs. Commanders
news_mentions.description: The Rams have activated pass rusher Myles Garrett (knee) from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game against the Commanders, setting up the reigning Defensive Player of the Year to return to the lineup for the first time since Week 1.
news_mentions.body_text: for once this season it is good news on the injury front for the rams los angeles has activated pass rusher myles garrett knee from injured reserve ahead of sunday s game against the commanders setting up the reigning defensive player of the year to return to the lineup for the first time since week 1 garrett carries no designation into the matchup and rams coach sean mcvay told reporters friday that he is expected to play versus washington barring any setbacks glad to be back on the field with my teammates garrett said friday making an impact feeling their presence and just integrating back with them again garrett who helped make the rams the story of the offseason thanks to his blockbuster trade from the browns to l a has been unable to make his usual impact on the regular season with the campaign already in november following the team s season opening loss to the 49ers during which garrett logged five pressures but failed to add a sack tackle or anything else to the stat sheet the five time all pro underwent knee surgery and was placed on ir he missed the past seven contests before being designated to return practicing in limited fashion twice and taking a rest day friday now he s officially back garrett rejoins a rams squad that has far underperformed expectations billed as a superteam after aaron donald unretired to join forces with garrett and other additions such as cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson on a defense that suddenly appeared every bit as good as an offense that led the league in points and yards in 2025 the rams are 4 4 sitting in third place in the nfc west at the midway point of the season they have dealt with myriad injuries beyond garrett star wide receiver puka nacua has missed two games and his counterpart davante adams is on ir as are other big names such as kobie turner and poona ford watson one of l a s aforementioned additions alongside garrett suffered a season ending shoulder injury last week and on saturday was placed on ir despite the disappointment thus far the rams still rank 10th in points scored and 12th in points allowed and they re top five in yards both offensively and defensively los angeles defense also ranks third in quarterback pressure percentage 41 0 though it has resulted in only 12 sacks which sits tied for 26th outside of the sacks those are all good respectable numbers but garrett was expected to help elevate the rams to an otherworldly level on the active roster again with a clean bill of health he can restart his pursuit of that aim which hardly got started in one injury affected outing before surgery i think the offenses really have to pick their poison garrett said ahead of playing his first nfl game with donald who was inactive for the season opener who is going to be freed up this play i think either of us are pretty good at winning one on ones so we ll have some fun garrett donald and the rams kick off against the commanders at 1 p m et on sunday

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 9 Sunday aftermath: Myles Garrett's return buoys Rams; Jordan Love, Joe Burrow shine
news_mentions.description: Kevin Patra breaks down the key storylines from Week 9's slate of games on Sunday, including Myles Garrett's return to action for the Rams and the explosive outings from Jordan Love and Joe Burrow.
news_mentions.body_text: we re at the season s halfway point and sunday saw a number of teams and quarterbacks make loud statements as we gear up for 2026 s stretch run the nfc north continues to be an absolute buzzsaw of a division going 3 0 on sunday with the vikings set to face the bills on monday night the afc north is shaping up to be a two team race and the seahawks got back over 500 with sam darnold sidelined let s examine some key storylines in sunday s aftermath including prolific packers attack fueled by deep ball burrow marching toward first mvp another one score win for payton s broncos giants overcome adversity once again stroud s historic afternoon in los angeles but first we start with the rams who saw the return of their prized offseason acquisition and immediately reaped the benefits garrett to the rams rescue welcome back myles garrett the nfl sack champion returned from a seven game stint on injured reserve to bolster the rams pass rush which had struggled to pester signal callers without the two time defensive player of the year garrett didn t just return to the lineup on sunday no no no he blasted off like a heat seeking missile at commanders quarterback jayden daniels first there was the second quarter strip sack that set up points then in the fourth quarter garrett walloped daniels twice for two pivotal sacks that helped seal the win on a day the offense couldn t find a groove man it was a weight off my shoulders garrett said of the three sacks that helped key l a s 20 13 win in his return from september knee surgery just getting back to who i am i m nowhere near where i want to be as far as like my performance and the things i know i can do how i can move but this is a confidence booster for sure just try to boost the confidence of the guys around me as well garrett played 35 of 58 defensive snaps 60 3 in his return from injury he generated six pressures and three sacks on 27 pass rushes 22 2 pressure rate per next gen stats getting the dominant edge rusher back will also make aaron donald more menacing sunday was the first time this season that garrett and donald were active together with both on the field 23 plays the rams defense allowed 5 0 yards per play and recorded four sacks per ngs on all other plays the defense allowed 8 1 yards per play and one touchdown with zero sacks as the duo plays together more the upside is enormous garrett s return is massive for a rams squad that has struggled this season they re finally on the right side of 500 at 5 4 but still have work to do to get into playoff positioning with puka nacua s reported knee injury adding uncertainty to sean mcvay s offense the l a d might need to carry the load for the next few weeks editor s update sean mcvay told reporters monday that wr puka nacua has mcl and pcl sprains and a turf toe injury and will probably be placed on injured reserve packers air it out to demolish pats many offenses prefer to dink and dunk their way down the field executing the kind of safe approach that doesn t put the ball at risk and keeps the attack in advantageous down and distance situations and then there is green bay jordan love entered sunday already leading the league in splash plays then he dropped dime after dime after deep dime on a bewildered patriots defense in foxborough the packers qb along with burner christian watson 7 171 1 and ascending second year wideout matthew golden 10 164 1 made pats star cb christian gonzalez look like a sixth round scrub putting himself squarely in the mvp conversation love generated 372 passing yards three passing touchdowns and a regular season career high 153 2 passer rating in green bay s 45 27 shellacking of the patriots he joined aaron rodgers as the only packers quarterbacks with multiple passing touchdowns in at least eight of the first nine games of a season with rodgers doing so in 2011 and 2020 winning mvp in each of those seasons love s 153 2 passer rating in week 9 is the highest by any packers quarterback in a regular season start since rodgers had a perfect 158 3 against the raiders in 2019 it really doesn t matter who it is on defense love said after the game we trust the game plan and trust guys are gonna get open and make plays it s the nfl we see great dbs every week our mindset is we gotta keep attacking attack they did love was flawless and his deep shots were on the freaking money when he s driving the ball downfield hitting receivers in stride there isn t a prettier sight in the game right now love completed 10 of his 12 downfield pass attempts 10 air yards for 294 yards and two touchdowns against the patriots the third most downfield passing yards by a quarterback this season per next gen stats he averaged 24 5 yards per attempt on those downfield passes the fifth most in a single game since 2018 he completed six of his eight deep attempts 20 air yards for 235 yards and one touchdown better still love was pressured on nine pass attempts he completed six of those for 153 yards averaging a whopping 17 0 ypa when pressured per ngs those numbers are pure comedy but it s crazy because i know there s probably a lot more in there golden said we ve still got so many more plays out there to make there are still aspects to clean up with the offensive line still somewhat of a mess and the ground game not getting into gear until late with josh jacobs now dealing with a fractured finger the pack could use some rb help jonathan taylor anyone but when love is on the money and his two dynamic receivers aren t flubbing passes the pack can score with anyone with the lions escaping miami on sunday with a 19 9 win over the fighting fins and the bears overcoming five turnovers to best the buccaneers at home the nfc north continues to be the hottest division in the league is anyone playing better than burrow jordan love is on fire but joe burrow has been blazing for a month the bengals quarterback in sunday s 34 17 win over the falcons generated his fourth straight game with at least four passing rushing touchdowns tied for the second longest streak since 1970 behind only peyton manning s five game streak in his 2004 mvp season per nfl research over the past four tilts burrow has a thrown hilarious 16 touchdown passes while completing 77 of his passes becoming just the fourth qb fifth instance overall to pull off that feat joining tom brady 2007 manning 2013 and russell wilson 2015 and 2020 joe is playing at an unbelievably high level right now bengals head coach zac taylor said joe doesn t force the ball he takes the ball where it needs to go based on the looks and even if sometimes they re leaning into a guy or doubling a guy he s still going to give him an opportunity and some of those opportunities came up big for us so that s just something we re used to it helps to have ja 39 marr chase 10 155 1 and tee higgins 5 32 2 on your side as they did at lsu burrow and chase toasted falcons corner a j terrell with a 47 yard td bomb to get the ball rolling on a 24 point first half that all but sealed a win in madrid before the break chase was asked after the game if burrow is playing like an mvp i can t answer that because i ve been playing with him my whole life so it s kind of hard for me to sit up here and say that chase said but i ve been thinking he should have won the mvp i said this when we went to the super bowl that year and he didn t get it that year i mean he s up for it every year broncos magic in one score games continues credit sean payton s squad for continuing to come up clutch streaking to their fifth consecutive victory on sunday four of which have come by less than a touchdown sunday s 26 21 win over the panthers came after trailing by one point entering the fourth quarter the broncos fifth win of the season after trailing at any point in the fourth that ties the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings for the most wins after trailing in the fourth quarter in a team s first nine games of a season since 2000 per nfl research both the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings lost their first playoff game on wild card weekend i think it s just the character of our guys the toughness competitiveness of our guys broncos quarterback bo nix said after the game we re just comfortable in that moment when things get close there at the end of the game whatever it is we have had a couple scores and then we always want to make it one score just glad we re on this side and winning em the broncos jumped out to a 10 0 advantage before the panthers got back in the game and took a third quarter lead carolina controlled the middle portion of the game but nix and co took over late with two fourth quarter touchdown drives capped by a 26 yard strike from nix to pat bryant after the offense failed to get a game sealing first down late the defense stepped up and forced a fumble to squash the panthers final drive i just think we ve been there before so we know how to handle the situation nik bonitto who had the game sealing strip sack of bryce young said at the end of the day it was our job as a defense to just go out and finish the victory set an nfl record with their 16th consecutive regular season win in a one score contest broncos games are rarely normal sunday s included a miraculous interception in the end zone that took a replay review of when payton s challenge flag was thrown before it could be reviewed we could say the magic will eventually run out and the broncos will regress to the mean in one score games however there have been enough of them to admit it s part of the makeup of payton s broncos maybe it will never be pretty but that win column sure looks nice right now for the 7 2 squad harbaugh s giants keep finding ways to win it s not just that john harbaugh has guided the giants to the top of the nfc east with a 5 2 1 record it s how they ve morphed into a reliable steady team that stands in stark contrast to the past decade plus of ineptitude for the most part the giants haven t beaten themselves sure there was cam skattebo s fumble against washington that led to a week 5 tie and jameis winston s early turnover barrage in their week 6 loss to new orleans but big blue has become better at not letting things unravel on sunday against a reeling eagles squad in a place lincoln financial field that has been a bugaboo for new york for a dozen years things could have spiraled out of control particularly when j j mccarthy exited due to a hip injury instead winston entered and calmly converted a third down and a fourth down to lead the giants only td drive of the game he then handed the reins back to mccarthy who finished out the win it was a prime example of all 46 active players doing their part to secure a victory perhaps more important than the offense doing just enough is a defense coming on strong under coordinator dennard wilson in previous years new york s offensive struggles got most of the attention despite the fact that the limp d had been equally or more disappointing given the up front talent under wilson this unit is a bullying menace stopping a sleepy eagles offense that saw joe milton start his first career game on sunday isn t anything to write home about on the surface but how new york did it is very noteworthy most notable arvell reese was a dominant force the rookie earned a career high three sacks and led the giants with 12 tackles becoming the first rookie since at least 1994 to record three sacks and at least 10 tackles in a game per nfl research reese joins fellow top five pick david bailey of the jets as the only rookies with at least three sacks in a game this season defensive rookie of the year that s set in stone cornerback greg newsome said of reece per the new york daily news now we re looking at defensive player of the year the superlatives for the rookie linebacker are just starting i don t know any young players that can do the things he does i m gonna be honest with you veteran defensive tackle d j reader said maybe the kid in seattle no 3 nick emmanwori because you don t find a kid that can cover the way he can cover come down and fill gaps in the run game rush the passer doesn t miss tackles kid s serious man it s special to watch he s really special the offense will come and go especially if the rushing attack is slowed like sunday but if big blue can rest its hat on a defense led by a dynamic rookie linebacker the giants can still run away with the nfc east week 9 sunday spotlight

news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 9 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 9 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below madrid cincinnati bengals 34 atlanta falcons 17 early window denver broncos 26 carolina panthers 21 dallas cowboys 27 indianapolis colts 23 kansas city chiefs 35 new york jets 12 detroit lions 19 miami dolphins 9 new orleans saints 23 cleveland browns 22 ot new york giants 19 philadelphia eagles 11 los angeles rams 20 washington commanders 13 late window houston texans 44 los angeles chargers 22 san francisco 49ers 38 las vegas raiders 17 green bay packers 45 new england patriots 27 seattle seahawks 17 arizona cardinals 3 sunday night chicago bears 27 tampa bay buccaneers 24 jeremy bergman s takeaways cincy s stars sizzle in espana few teams have had better 10 quarter stretches than the bengals over the past three weeks since being shut out in the first half against baltimore in week 7 cincinnati has responded with 112 points over two and a half games leading the way is joe burrow staking a strong claim in the mvp race burrow was lethal again on sunday in the first half leading cincy s offense to four scoring drives on 9 3 yards per play and completing 82 of his passes for 239 yards eight of those completions went to ja 39 marr chase who set a career high with 142 yards in the first half finishing with 155 and a score on 10 catches showcasing his dynamic ability on an international stage for the first time tee higgins boxed out c j henderson and atlanta s defensive backs for two tds even chase brown season high 6 3 ypc and cincinnati s anemic run game season best 123 yards showed some explosion after sunday s romp cincinnati has now won four straight games with at least 30 points scored for the first time in franchise history if the bengals are capable of this type of production weekly do they even need to swing big for a piece possibly at running back at the trade deadline that s a question for tuesday maybe atlanta will have an answer for cincy s offensive onslaught by then another big bijan day undone by atlanta errors a week after losing to a tampa team that didn t complete a pass the falcons found a more traditional way to fall sunday morning play leaky defense commit penalties repeat in pristine climate controlled conditions inside madrid s bernabeu there were no excuses for atlanta s performance first the positives michael penix threw three fewer interceptions than he did a week prior and scrambled for a career high 50 yards looking svelte and nimble on the spanish pitch bijan robinson who loves an exclusive window rushed for 100 again totaling 147 yards from scrimmage and one td on the day the elusive dynamo was right at home at the home of real madrid s galacticos but jeff ulbrich s defense was a sieve against the nfl s hottest attack allowing 7 1 yards per play and forcing just two punts on the day atlanta also committed 12 accepted penalties for 88 yards repeatedly setting back the offense the falcons o line committed two fouls in the red zone on their second drive leading to the first field goal of a touchdown fight its most critical error though came at the start of the fourth quarter when down two tds at the bengals 10 yard line atlanta was called for offensive holding on a third and 2 incompletion cincy accepted the penalty and forced a fourth and 12 settling for cutting a two score lead to a two score lead nick folk instead shanked a 38 yard field goal and the bengals lead held at 14 the falcons never got closer a tale of two divisions despite the result cincinnati and atlanta will both return to the states tied in the win column for leads in their respective divisions the bengals victory moved them into a 6 2 tie atop the afc north with the steelers setting up a critical sunday night football showdown on the banks of the ohio river in week 10 having already lost this season to pittsburgh the bengals need a home win against aaron rodgers and co to improve their division record and ensure no favor in the head to head tiebreaker down in the cursed nfc south the falcons at 3 6 are nowhere near out of it but are at risk of falling behind hotter clubs after sunday s slate atlanta is essentially tied with carolina 3 5 new orleans 3 5 and tampa bay 3 6 a needed bye awaits for the falcons after a week 10 matchup with patrick mahomes chiefs next gen stats insight for bengals falcons via nfl pro joe burrow was pressured on nine of 32 dropbacks 28 1 against the falcons completing 20 of 23 passes for 237 yards and two touchdowns when kept clean his time to pressure of 3 26 seconds was the longest of his career and the falcons defense had just one quick pressure in the game nfl research joe burrow and ja marr chase connected for their 19th touchdown of at least 40 yards in sunday s win tied with joe montana and jerry rice for the third most by any qb receiver duo since 1980 the only duos with more are peyton manning and marvin harrison 21 tds and steve young and jerry rice 20 tds their first quarter touchdown was the 58th score by the duo overall including playoffs which passed daunte culpepper and randy moss for second most by any qb receiver duo before age 30 trailing only dan marino and mark clayton 68 tds back to top nick shook s takeaways broncos win a game of runs it wasn t quite an avalanche but as is often the case in basketball sunday s game became a tale of runs what began as a one sided contest in favor of denver reversed course just before halftime sunday when the panthers turned an interception into a scoring possession to claw back into the competition that shift in momentum saw bryce young enter a flow state dotting the field with precise confident passes and leading a second scoring drive to double up between halves and put the panthers in a 14 13 lead he appeared poised to extend that lead in the fourth too but a wacky interception snagged by denver safety devon key stopped the panthers in their tracks and swung momentum back in favor of the broncos who rattled off two straight touchdown drives to take a 26 14 lead in the final period good for their latest fourth quarter comeback effort denver had to hang on for dear life in the final minutes after carolina mounted one final push and it s not exactly a resounding victory but it s the latest example of a contending team finding a way to win a back and forth contest by coming through in the most important moments and finishing in a style that fits the team s strengths with edge rusher nik bonitto strip sacking young to stop the panthers final drive in its tracks bo nix looked more like the passer we ve known him to be too a small but encouraging sign as the calendar creeps toward thanksgiving panthers defensive changes fail to produce improvement defensive coordinator ejiro evero became the fall guy when coach dave canales relieved him of his duties following carolina s week 8 loss to green bay installing an interim dc with the hopes it might improve the panthers inconsistent defense in short it didn t the panthers allowed denver to break 300 yards of total offense and mount two touchdown drives that appeared vastly different but produced the same result the first fourth quarter scoring march covered 80 yards over 14 plays while the other needed just six plays to gain 61 yards and finish with a wide open touchdown pass to pat bryant as a result of a blown coverage a symptom of a defense that is still scrambling to take care of the details carolina stood tall late buying its offense a chance to compile a game winning drive but the earlier breakdowns represent a persistent issue had cornerback corey thornton not made an incredibly athletic play on the ball to pick off nix this game might have snowballed out of control in the first half long before the panthers offense was able to climb back into the game had jaylen waddle not exited due to a head injury denver might have continued to rely on the playmaker to break open for big gains this unit was never going to be completely fixed in one week but sunday told us there s still plenty to correct nix begins to break out of his shell it didn t last throughout the entire game but seemingly for the first time in ages bo nix took the training wheels off his own bicycle and let himself play a bit more instinctively proof existed in his decisions made while rolling out in which nix twice opted to throw back against his body to open targets underneath instead of accepting a small scramble gain or throwing it away his bullet ripped through traffic to courtland sutton for a touchdown was another encouraging sign because he was willing to take a minor risk and when bryant streaked open through the carolina secondary nix didn t hesitate to put the ball on him for a score the results are evident in his stat line 25 of 37 237 yards two touchdowns one interception it s not a massive change in performance but it s a start broncos fans have been yearning to see for weeks we ll see if it s a sign of things to come next gen stats insight for broncos panthers via nfl pro bo nix posted a 124 2 passer rating against single high coverage 20 of 26 for 202 yards and two touchdowns but a 15 3 passer rating against split safety coverage 5 of 11 for 35 yards and an interception his 15 3 passer rating against split safety looks was his lowest in a game since his nfl debut in week 1 2024 nfl research the broncos won 26 21 in week 9 against the panthers after trailing by one point entering the fourth quarter their fifth win of the season after trailing at any point in the fourth that is tied with the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings for the most wins after trailing in the fourth quarter in a team s first nine games of a season since 2000 both the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings lost their first playoff game that season in the wild card round back to top kevin patra s takeaways cowboys survive collapse to secure a much needed win over colts brian schottenheimer s squad tried to give the game away luckily the cowboys opponent did a better job dallas built a 10 point lead deep into the third quarter mistakes then gave indianapolis life ceedee lamb fumbled late the cowboys second turnover of the day to wipe out a chance to put the game away despite putting up stats with george pickens out lamb had a mistake filled day in addition to the fumble he was called for offensive pass interference twice and couldn t toe tap a td that cost the cowboys four points in the red zone dallas couldn t get out of its own way for much of the contest dak prescott was far more off the mark than we re used to leading to stalled drives schotty s club was called for 14 penalties for a whopping 153 yards turned the ball over twice and missed a late go ahead field goal that s how you let an opponent amid a fire sale stay in a game despite being outgained 508 271 dallas should have run away with the game instead it trailed late until ryan flournoy the best no 3 wr in the league made a massive play for a 46 yard gain to set up the game winning td a loss would have all but doomed the cowboys who still have a big hill to climb in the nfc east colts offense can t kick it into gear until late facing a bad cowboys defense daniel jones and co couldn t take advantage for long stretches indy went three and out five times including on four of its first five drives the other was a 19 yard td drive following a dak prescott fumble jones was inconsistent and often off the mark completing 20 of 34 passes for 180 yards with a td and an interception the cowboys d entered the game allowing a league high 385 4 yards per game and 5 9 yards per play 29th indy generated just 271 yards and 4 6 yards per play while going 3 for 13 on third down ashton dulin s 55 yard catch and run td was indy s only pass play longer than 16 yards jones averaged 2 6 air yards per completion in the game third fewest of his career minimum 10 completions per next gen stats against a dallas d that s been ripped up jones needed to do more the rushing attack did some solid work generating 105 total yards on the ground with seth mcgowan earning 7 5 yards per carry on six totes with a td if sunday was jonathan taylor s final game in indy mcgowan flashed some upside to take over the bulk of the workload downs calls game when javonte williams scored the go ahead touchdown with a little over a minute remaining the big question was whether a sieve dallas d could hold on caleb downs ensured it would by stepping in front of a daniel jones pass sealing the win over his brother josh downs squad the int capped a game in which downs generated a sack three tackles a qb hit a tackle for loss and two passes defensed allowing just one reception on four targets sunday marked the first time all season that the cowboys defense allowed fewer than 318 total yards doing so against a team that s begun a mid season teardown is one thing the cowboys will have a stiffer test against kyle shanahan and the 49ers in week 10 next gen stats insight for cowboys colts via nfl pro ceedee lamb caught six of 12 targets for 180 yards and a touchdown on downfield throws 10 plus air yards in week 9 against the colts the most receiving yards he has recorded on downfield throws in his career nfl research sunday marked dak prescott s first game with 300 plus passing yards multiple passing touchdowns no interceptions and a game winning drive since 2018 in a week 17 win against the giants prescott had one such game in each of his first three career seasons but none from 2019 2025 back to top bobby kownack s takeaways k9 scores touchdowns kenneth walker s reign of terror over the rest of the league took a couple weeks break as the running back was held to 105 rushing yards and no touchdowns over the previous two contests after torching opponents for 665 rushing yards and eight total scores in his first five outings as a chief unfortunately for the jets his dominance s brief hiatus ended sunday walker was a man on a mission versus gang green almost singlehandedly keeping kansas city afloat amid a slow start that included two fumbles a three and out and a missed field goal over the opening two quarters kansas city s other two first half drives ended a bit differently on 7 and 25 yard touchdown receptions by walker he provided the offensive spark while patrick mahomes worked to piece together a consistent passing game using anyone else and after the rest of the operation caught up to walker s heroics to start pulling away from the jets he added a 2 yard td run in the third quarter walker finished with 102 rushing yards a 5 7 per carry average and four runs of 10 plus yards as well as four catches for 41 yards that s after he was able to take a rest midway through the fourth quarter due to a blowout he helped create he now has five games with multiple scrimmage touchdowns the most in the nfl this season and the most by a chiefs running back since larry johnson eight in 2005 wilson is sorely missed by jets there was a lot of intrigue surrounding new york s offense heading into week 9 how would the jets mix breece hallback into the rotation after braelon allen excelled to such a degree during the starter s four game absence how would the passing offense operate without garrett wilson after omar cooper and adonai mitchell recently took turns breaking out for new york as far as the running backs hall saw 18 touches to allen s 10 with hall turning his into 87 yards and allen totaling 54 both running backs averaged 4 1 yards per carry as for the passing offense it was ugly wilson had appeared frustrated in recent weeks as he produced smaller numbers than his counterparts hauling in 12 catches for 153 yards without a score over his previous three games before sustaining a concussion but it s clear he makes the offense go without the star there to demand attention from kansas city s secondary the chiefs had little problem shutting down geno smith smith threw for only 165 yards cooper led the way with 58 yards on eight receptions while mitchell went from 142 yards on seven catches last week to zero catches on seven looks a game later new york got nothing going settling for four field goals in the first half tied for the most over the last 10 seasons in the second half the jets didn t even get the opportunity to settle smith and co managed 58 yards over five drives on the other side of intermission forced to watch their two point halftime deficit unravel into a 23 point loss chiefs come alive for much needed blowout kansas city rode a two game losing streak into week 9 with a 22 fourth quarter point differential that ranked 31st in the league over the past two games if there s one thing patrick mahomes is going to do though it s beat up on bad teams by defeating the jets he moved to 18 0 in his career against teams entering a matchup four plus games under 500 the best by any quarterback since 1970 minimum 15 starts per nfl research he went 23 of 31 for 242 yards and two touchdowns with a 117 9 passer rating but most importantly seemed ok after a strip sack by david bailey late in the second quarter bent his elbow awkwardly and forced him to receive medical attention on the sideline he returned and overcame a frustrating offensive stupor to blow the doors off the jets while the chiefs defense minimized damage early and inflicted plenty of it throughout kansas city pressured geno smith on half of his dropbacks chris jones and george karlaftis led the team with six pressures and two sacks apiece while drue tranquill logged 13 tackles and nick bolton had 12 plus a forced fumble detractors will point out it s only the jets and there are still some issues to work out think harrison butker missing a 56 yard field goal and the subsequent 51 yarder after getting a reprieve due to an offsides penalty just before half but the chiefs can only play who is in front of them in this case they demolished them next gen stats insight for jets chiefs via nfl pro travis kelce caught four of six targets for 72 yards accounting for two of the chiefs five explosive passes 40 0 nfl research kenneth walker had his first career game with multiple receiving touchdowns to go along with a rushing touchdown in the chiefs win over the jets his second career game with three touchdowns back to top bobby kownack s takeaways usual suspects lift detroit to tightly contested win sunday s victory over miami was not your typical lions affair jared goff and the offense took forever to get going and it seemed as if they knew things weren t quite clicking the lions pulled out all the stops against their one win opponent they went for it on fourth down on the first drive a few plays later jahmyr gibbs took a direct snap and faked a pitch to goff before streaking around the edge for 16 yards two plays into the second quarter detroit converted a fake punt throw by jack fox on fourth and 7 from its own 30 the lions constantly stalled out failing to score a touchdown until 1 20 remained in the third quarter and that was a run by gibbs on fourth down too luckily they had a couple stars to lean on to help guide them through their struggles amon ra st brown was the main source of the team s passing offense deep into the final frame at the start of the lions seventh drive of the game he had seven catches while the rest of detroit s pass catchers had combined for six st brown drew a third down pass interference penalty early on that possession and a few plays later hauled in a key 17 yard catch on third and 8 to keep the chains moving with a perilous seven point lead he eventually finished with 86 yards on eight receptions every other lion combined for 10 catches and 95 yards and though gibbs was frequently met by a pod of dolphins in the backfield he still broke off a number of clutch gainers including the aforementioned 8 yard td run he finished with a game high 74 rushing yards that was about it for offensive highlights but it was enough miami wastes strong defensive performance jeff hafley s defense fought valiantly against the league s no 3 scoring offense if only the rest of the team had been able to repay the group s efforts the dolphins consistently crashed into detroit s backfield to locate jahmyr gibbs containing the electric back who had been averaging 4 9 yards per carry entering week 9 to 3 7 yards per attempt on 20 rushes jared goff struggled to find and hit open passers throwing for a season low 170 yards he was sacked three times and tossed just his second pick of the season to rookie corner chris johnson after josh uche hit his arm during the throwing motion the dolphins didn t bend to the point of allowing a touchdown the only one of the game until the waning minutes of the third quarter malik willis and the offense could do nothing with their opportunities however willis threw for only 128 yards and an interception and seemed hesitant to open it up on the ground two carries for 7 yards while ollie gordon was held to 55 rushing yards when the fins had a chance to make it a tie game heading into halftime they instead committed a holding penalty and missed a 38 yard field goal on the final two plays of the second quarter toward the start of the fourth quarter down 10 with the ball at detroit s 7 yard line willis took two sacks over the next three plays before miami settled for a three points gut wrenching mistakes are no way to beat a contender like the lions and the dolphins certainly made their share of them ugly game all around one of the biggest concerns for any 5 2 team traveling to face a 1 6 opponent is typically avoiding playing down to the lesser squad s level the lions absolutely joined the dolphins in the doldrums for a messy matchup that will have neither side coming away feeling particularly happy the lions and dolphins combined for 20 accepted penalties with detroit committing nine to miami s 11 they went 7 for 24 on third down collectively detroit managed only 270 yards nearly 100 fewer than its previous low on the season 355 miami posted its second lowest yardage total of the year with 228 thanks to the offensive ineptitude a few of the most exciting plays of the matchup were actually fake punts both teams ran one and both teams converted on passes one by lions punter jack fox and another by dolphins punter bradley pinion it was the first time since at least 1950 that multiple punters have completed a pass in the same game per nfl research give credit to the lions defense for showing up and making life miserable for the dolphins but detroit didn t exactly put an exclamation point on this one despite running its winning streak to four next gen stats insight for lions dolphins via nfl pro aidan hutchinson matched up against austin jackson 16 times in week 9 all one on one recording six pressures 37 5 pressure rate including two quick pressures under 2 5 seconds nfl research jahmyr gibbs recorded his 60th career touchdown tying hall of famer ladainian tomlinson for the second most by any player in their first four seasons in nfl history trailing only hall of famer terrell davis with 61 back to top nick shook s takeaways saints come alive to earn much needed win by all accounts sunday was an ugly display of football between two middling teams for most of the afternoon a field goal fest including a charlie smyth first half miss set up for what appeared to be a likely 9 6 finish until the browns finally hit a big play for a touchdown when shedeur sanders connected with rookie kc concepcion for a 64 yard passing touchdown the score seemed to position the browns for another fourth quarter comeback win but instead it awoke the saints with just enough time for chaos to ensue new orleans covered 55 yards in six plays and 50 seconds to take a 16 13 lead allowed the browns to tie the game with 0 08 left then embarked on an efficient relentless 74 yard scoring drive that required 11 plays and ended with a pretty touchdown pass from tyler shough to juwan johnson for a 23 16 lead in overtime the stop of cleveland s two point try in overtime sealed the win but it was only made possible by some late success that must have felt for saints fans like the thawing of an offense that spent far too long frozen within a glacier at 3 5 the saints are back in the thick of a race for an nfc south crown that might only require nine wins to secure if they re going to get there sunday s late push toward a victory was essential browns show clear weaknesses in brutal defeat cleveland has lost its ability to stop the run since losing maliek collins to injury and delivered an embarrassing effort against the saints low ceiling rushing attack sunday allowing audric estim 233 who was a member of the browns less than a month ago tyler shough and alvin kamara to run for 155 yards on 31 attempts pacing an offense that came to life thanks to this newfound balance in the second half even worse cleveland s pass coverage unit struggled losing one on one matchups all afternoon grant delpit ronnie hickman and tyson campbell each struggled in such matchups and especially in the game s most crucial moments e g juwan johnson s overtime touchdown and a 33 yard completion from shough to chris olave late in the fourth quarter paired with an offense that wasn t threatening for most of the afternoon with sanders at quarterback cleveland was guaranteed to be locked in a four quarter battle with a team most expected it to defeat without a major struggle instead the browns fell in a fashion that is a strong competitor with their week 1 blowout loss to jacksonville for worst defeat of the season that s not a good place to be in in week 9 shough finds his stride new orleans offense has lacked juice for some time now draining the saints of their early season optimism that was tied to the trajectory of tyler shough in his second nfl season that finally changed in the fourth quarter sunday when cleveland stunned the superdome crowd with an explosive touchdown pass from shedeur sanders to kc concepcion new orleans offense woke up stringing together well designed passing plays with a rushing attack that finally showed some life to move down the field with relative ease against a browns defense that had limited it all afternoon shough was at the center of all of it calmly dropping dimes on chris olave juwan johnson and even rookie jordyn tyson to propel the offense to two clutch touchdown drives in a wild fourth quarter and overtime period we saw the return of a composed accurate shough whose clutch gene reappeared after going into hiding over the last month the timing couldn t be better for this saints team which will be in a weekly fight for survival in an nfc south that remains wide open there s no guarantee their rushing success carries over but getting shough back on track was a massively important development for coach kellen moore who was able to demonstrate some of his expertise in how he to through the end mccarthy got popped on a qb keeper and exited in the third quarter with a hip injury he d return to help close out the road win a stymied run game led to a trove of third and long situations mccarthy went 6 of 7 on the key down for 88 yards with two sacks it was an ugly offensive affair with neither team reaching the 250 yard mark mccarthy didn t flash as well as he had in his t care that the win wasn t pretty notching another win to keep a significant nfc east lead is all that matters milton can t jump start eagles offense philly s offense remains a slog even with the athletic joe milton under center the qb added a few good runs leading the eagles with 64 yards on nine rushes milton completed 18 of 32 passes for 169 yards while taking seven sacks milton owns a whip but the issue is his accuracy too often the young qb was off the mark leading to stalled drives the eagles who entered sunday with a league high 34 1 three and out rate went three and out seven times too many free rushers at the qb saquon barkley generated just 22 yards on 13 carries 1 7 yards per carry with a td that s not enough to help a young qb in his first start reese is a menace giants rookie linebacker arvell reese was all over the field mashing the eagles with ferocity and bad intentions reese gobbled up three sacks a team high 12 tackles three tackles for loss a forced fumble coordinator dennard wilson lines up his rookie reese proves he can hunt the pigskin reese became the only player in the nfl this season with two or more sacks aligned at ilb in a game per next gen with 49 punts and 22 punts inside the 20 yard line this season back to top dan parr s takeaways welcome back myles garrett two time defensive player of the year myles garrett wasted no time making his presence felt in his first game since week 1 in his return from a knee injury garrett recorded three sacks and a forced fumble including a pivotal sack of jayden daniels on third down with two minutes remaining garrett played 35 of 58 defensive snaps 60 3 generating six total pressures sunday marked los angeles first game with both garrett and three time dpoy aaron donald in the lineup donald who came out of retirement in august did not play in garrett s rams debut in week 1 and washington s offensive line struggled against the pressure all afternoon the rams were the darlings of the summer after the blockbuster trade to acquire garrett from the browns but the vibes shifted dramatically during the team s disappointing 2 4 start to the season three straight wins later the rams are above 500 for the first time despite an injury plagued first half they are a win over the cardinals away from hitting the bye week at 6 4 it might not be exactly what so many envisioned for sean mcvay s squad in 2026 but it feels like the season has been rescued from the brink of disaster commanders crushed by failure to capitalize on opportunities to provide some perspective on how rough the last season and a half has been for washington the team had a chance to win two games in a row for the first time since jayden daniels rookie year 2024 on sunday they scored first taking a 3 0 lead early but the rams tied the game later in the first quarter and washington never led again twice the commanders started drives in rams territory and they only managed to turn those possessions into a total of three points daniels was 24 of 35 passing for 274 yards and the team s lone touchdown but he also had a costly fumble in the second quarter the qb had little help from the running game with rachaad white and austin ekeler combining for 44 yards on 15 carries 2 9 per with their hopes continuing to dim the commanders now face a road game on a short week they ll visit the nfc east leading giants on thursday night the division rivals tied when they met in week 5 dominant nacua carries the rams offense los angeles wr1 puka nacua finished with 170 yards accounting for nearly 50 percent of the team s total offense on sunday the team must be holding its collective breath right now though with espn s adam schefter and nfl network s mike garafolo reporting nacua suffered a knee injury on the offense s final snap of the game the rams do not believe nacua has an acl tear but he will undergo an mri on monday to determine the severity of the injury per the report the all pro made 14 catches for a season high 150 yards and a touchdown on 19 targets also he had two carries for 20 yards washington played zone on 84 1 of nacua s routes and he caught 12 of 17 targets for 128 yards against it his most yards against zone coverage in a game this season per next gen stats he did lose a fumble but jayden daniels fumbled the ball right back to the rams on the next possession it was still far from easy sledding for the rams offense which started the game 0 for 9 on third down matthew stafford threw an interception on a pass to nacua and was not at his sharpest as a passer the rams scored their fewest points in a game since their last loss an 18 16 defeat against the cardinals the team stafford and co will visit in week 10 next gen stats insight for rams commanders via nfl pro the rams
