news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.description: With the start of NFL training camps just around the corner, Grant Gordon provides a refresher on the San Francisco 49ers' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the san francisco 49ers offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 15 rookies july 22 veterans location sap performance facility santa clara california fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs denver broncos 8 30 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at las vegas raiders 4 p m et on saturday aug 16 nfl network week 3 vs los angeles chargers 8 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note san francisco doesn t face a team that made the 2024 playoffs in the final eight weeks of the upcoming season nfl research what you need to know 1 after a four year sojourn in jersey as the new york jets head coach robert saleh has returned to the bay as defensive coordinator but his house isn t as he left it the 49ers were fifth in yards allowed and 17th in points in 2020 saleh s last with the squad in 2024 they were still eighth in yards but an awful 29th in points given up san francisco underwent myriad roster changes with plenty of departures on the defensive side dre greenlaw talanoa hufanga and charvarius ward among them the cupboard is hardly bare though as saleh can rely on dominant mainstays nick bosa and fred warner among the big questions to be answered this summer is how his ex jets pass rusher bryce huff acclimates out west after a trying 2024 with the philadelphia eagles and how fast no 11 overall pick mykel williams gets going there are plenty more quandaries for saleh to address though williams is likely to be among three rookie starters along with defensive tackle alfred collins and linebacker nick martin and the 49ers produced just 37 sacks a season ago tied for 23rd in the nfl saleh s got plenty of reconstruction at hand amid his return 2 unlike last summer christian mccaffrey is set for training camp and set to be all systems go originally thought to be precautionary mccaffrey missed camp last year with an achilles and calf injury that extended to him missing the first eight games of the season after finally getting back on the field mccaffrey s campaign concluded with a pcl injury in total he played only four games during a disastrous 2024 season cmc has proclaimed himself healthy from his pcl and had no restrictions during offseason workouts his health will remain a concern though it s a given following the third season in his eight year career in which he played seven games or less due to injury the coming weeks will also be worth seeing if mccaffrey 29 resembles his 2023 rushing champion self since he was traded from the panthers whom he s slated to face for the first time in week 12 to the 49ers mccaffrey has propelled san francisco to a 23 8 record when he s on the field the niners are 8 12 without him plain and simple mccaffrey is one of the nfl s elite when he s healthful and so are the 49ers 3 finally the 49ers were in line for a drama less training camp then reports surfaced that wide receiver jauan jennings was disenchanted with his contract a two year 15 39 million pact signed in the spring of 2024 brock purdy george kittle and fred warner each worked out lengthy and lucrative new deals already in a stark contrast from past offseasons when brandon aiyuk and trent williams 2024 nick bosa 2023 and deebo samuel 2022 had dilemmas dominate summer headlines just how large jennings contract dismay looms over camp remains to be seen regardless it illuminates an already existing concern for the 49ers their wide receiver corps samuel was one of plenty notable departures for the team the wideback s trade to washington coupled with aiyuk s recovery from a 2024 knee injury put the position in question jennings stepped up and into the wr1 role last season and will likely get tabbed as such again but there s now a wrinkle to those best laid plans 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall has a big camp ahead and a larger role to take after that ex los angeles ram demarcus robinson second year wideout jacob cowing and rookies jordan watkins and junior bergen will be vying to make contributions

davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.headline: Bills-Vikings on 'Monday Night Football': What We Learned from Buffalo's 23-6 win over Minnesota
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Bobby Kownack breaks down the Bills' victory over the Vikings on Monday night.
news_mentions.body_text: allen weathers minnesota s blitz for win the league s no 1 scoring offense faced off against the no 1 scoring defense on monday night and for most of the first half the defense won soundly vikings defensive coordinator brian flores did his thing sending blitzers screaming toward josh allen with reckless abandon to great success through buffalo s first six drives which netted the bills 63 yards three points and an interception allen went 4 of 9 for 31 yards an interception and a 13 9 passer rating against the blitz he was pressured on seven of those dropbacks facing a blitz and sacked thrice and at times seemed capable only of chucking it deep in the face of a relentless rush but as time went on the bills began to get to the vikings both through a shorter hitting offense and perhaps mentally as buffalo erased any good minnesota s defense did by dominating its outclassed offense the bills gutted out an eight play 80 yard drive on their seventh possession allen finished it by dancing around for 6 07 seconds per next gen stats before heaving a 25 yard touchdown strike to a wide open keleki latu the tight end s first target of the season and first score of his career in a sense that s exactly how the bills won they waited out and wore out the vikings defense during a grueling night winning the time of possession battle 42 32 to 17 28 james cook jumped from 33 yards on 15 carries at halftime to 107 yards and a score on 31 totes by game s end while allen added 112 yards on his 11 second half throws after managing only 122 over his first 20 the vikings defense didn t do much wrong they just couldn t do everything right all night without a semblance of help on the other side wentz disaster class wastes flores masterclass kyler murray s hamstring injury opened up the possibility that carson wentz might step up in prime time and prove himself a more effective quarterback for minnesota s offense which had struggled to find much traction under the two time pro bowler he did the exact opposite of that ridding vikings fans of any notion that there was a qb on the bench who represented a better option facing the 30th ranked defense against the pass wentz delivered a miserable performance he missed pass catchers short high and wide he threw one interception deep to t j hockenson where only bills linebacker dorian williams could catch it and another one directly to lb terrel bernard while trying to hit justin jefferson he went 3 of 8 on short throws 0 9 yards air yards and 3 of 13 on anything deeper than that finishing 8 of 25 overall for 81 yards and an 8 9 passer rating the lowest by any qb to attempt at least 25 passes in a game since sam darnold s 3 6 passer rating during his 2019 seeing ghosts outing per nfl research despite all that minnesota s tremendous defense kept it to a one possession game until 6 17 remained a two play first quarter sequence perhaps most accurately represents how brutally wentz offset his team s defensive efforts byron murphy made a stellar interception playing center field on a josh allen end zone prayer to kill buffalo s second drive he even returned it to midfield to put wentz and co on the doorstep of field goal range instead on the very next snap wentz carelessly whipped a wide receiver screen to jefferson that went both backward and too high jefferson couldn t corral it and the bills recovered the fumble to get the ball right back that set the tone for a most disappointing day the qb position has been a massive problem for the vikings in 2026 they overcame it in their first six games but an inept offense has now cost them two straight they must fix it either in house or before the trade deadline before it s too late arrow pointing up for buffalo s defense it s been a rare occurrence this season but the bills d won them the game they completely overwhelmed minnesota and while it s fair to point to the vikings ranking 29th in yards entering week 9 it s nevertheless impressive to hold them to their fewest yards of the season even with an offense that had struggled to play its part opposite the league s best defense the vikings hadn t yet failed to eclipse 200 yards in a game they only hit 178 against the bills and that s counting a 52 yard drive led by third stringer max brosmer with the result already decided for all of the talk about minnesota s pass rush buffalo actually had a better pressure percentage against carson wentz 42 3 than the vikings did on josh allen 37 1 and did so despite blitzing on only 11 5 of wentz dropbacks antithetical to the aggressive much hyped vikes defensive approach and with better results as allen and co took time to find holes to exploit the bills defense poked them in minnesota s offensive game plan all night they allowed only nine first downs limited the vikings to five or fewer plays on 10 separate possessions and didn t give up a third down conversion buffalo s defense had allowed 28 5 points per game heading into the week 7 bye the obvious achilles heel for a team with serious super bowl aspirations the bills have now allowed 16 combined points in two games after the bye those outings were against undrafted rookie joe fagnano and wentz but this is where the foundation for a turnaround begins the confidence is building now is the time to put it to use against tougher opponents down the road bills sitting pretty in afc east the good news buffalo just rattled off its fourth straight victory besting its previous season high of a three game winning streak that began the campaign if you re waiting for the bad news there is none the rest of the afc east lost in week 9 the dolphins are now 1 7 and the jets are 2 7 six and 5 5 games back of the bills respectively which feels insurmountable given the quality of the teams and although the patriots 5 4 currently hold the head to head tiebreaker thanks to handing the bills their only loss in week 4 new england is staring at a three game deficit in the loss column with some massive issues to work through the bills still have a tough stretch ahead on the schedule playing the chiefs pats packers bears and broncos in weeks 12 16 but they also have four games remaining against the lowly jets and fins looking beyond the division history also appears to be on their side monday night marked the fifth matchup between teams tied for the nfl s best record in a november game or later over the last 15 seasons the winner of those games went on to play in the super bowl in three of four instances can the bills become the fourth such squad they re 7 1 for the first time since 1993 the last time they reached the game s biggest stage vikings head start on rest of division disappears minnesota entered week 8 as the lone unbeaten team remaining in the league after dropping two straight while the rest of the division went a collective 6 0 kevin o connell s bunch exits week 9 having officially fallen to third place in the nfc north it s only a hypothetical at this point but should the vikings fail to stop the bleeding against the packers at lambeau field this coming sunday they will plummet from the top to the bottom of the division in the span of 14 days that s how brutal the nfc north is it s currently the only division with every team sitting above 500 the sky isn t falling minnesota is a healthy 6 2 but there are problems for as incredible as the vikings defense is their offense is among the worst in the nfl their quarterback room is currently comprised of an injured underperforming kyler murray a turnover prone carson wentz who looked lost versus buffalo and max brosmer considering their next two games come on the road against the packers 6 3 and 49ers 7 1 the vikes must turn it back on soon the cushion they had is officially gone next gen stats insight for bills vikings via nfl pro josh allen was blitzed on 68 6 of his dropbacks the highest blitz rate he has faced in his career he completed 9 of 11 passes for 126 yards and a touchdown against four or fewer pass rushers nfl research the nfc north is a combined 20 4 in non division games the best such record by any division through week 9 of a season in over 40 years two of those four losses have come against the bills

news_mentions.headline: Josh Allen, Bills offense have no peer after taking everything the Vikings' defense had
news_mentions.body_text: minneapolis the buffalo bills thought they knew they even had an extra day to study the minnesota vikings 39 wicked defense to talk through the best possible strategies to simulate it in practice as best they could then came 8 16 p m monday night the bills won the coin flip and had the gall to take the ball first that meant they welcomed the vikings 39 defense onto the u s bank stadium field come get some buffalo thought 34 the mike tyson quote comes to mind 34 bills right tackle spencer brown said 34 everybody has a plan until you start getting punched in the mouth it 39 s like 39 f ok 133 remember the game plan remember what you talked about 39 34 the vikings fired uppercuts hooks and haymakers from the opening bell but the bills absorbed the blows and kept marching forward eventually stepping over their slumped opponents the 23 6 victory didn 39 t prove much about the bills 39 defense because they only had to shadowbox all night but we did learn the offense has no peer 34 that 39 s the type of game it was a grind it out game a bloody game 34 bills running back james cook said 34 we stuck with it stuck with it 34 then eventually we broke them 34 vikings defensive coordinator brian flores attacked from every angle minnesota crammed the run kept allen in the pocket knocked him around good he was hit 11 times while throwing and sacked a season high four times the bills committed five false starts amid the pressure and before an animated crowd through it all bills coach joe brady didn 39 t panic and allen the mvp favorite didn 39 t flinch unlike during the collapse allen couldn 39 t overcome while losing to the denver broncos last postseason he walked the vikings down it helped of course that vikings quarterback carson wentz played worse than the undrafted rookie emergency quarterback in his pro debut the bills beat last week but the bills also strung together dominant second half drives to keep the ball for 42 32 their longest time of possession in 37 years 34 it 39 s just a mindset of going out there and not being result driven 34 allen said 34 going out there and being process driven and understanding what they 39 re trying to do and at the end of the day having fun playing football 34 had a bad play early on wipe it next drive let 39 s go and finding joy in the game itself 34 at the end of the first quarter the bills had completed four possessions allen 39 s passer rating was 18 4 seventh lowest of his career after 15 minutes he was penalized for intentional grounding and threw an end zone interception allen didn 39 t compensate with his legs either nor did cook who carried 11 times for 17 yards nobody had more than one catch i asked allen and cook what it was like to go from watching minnesota 39 s defense on film to being immersed in it 34 that s 39 s crazy 34 cook replied 34 it 39 s seeing ghosts 34 34 you can be as prepared as possible 34 said allen 34 but those guys on that side of the ball are coming and they 39 re coming fast 34 adding to the chaos was that both starters on the offensive line 39 s left side were unable to play pro bowl left tackle dion dawkins suffered a rib injury while defeating the baltimore ravens last week while left guard alec anderson hurt his right ankle one of the most trusted backups on buffalo 39 s roster is veteran guard austin corbett the former carolina panthers starter and captain third year pro tylan grable who made his third nfl start last week at right tackle for spencer brown flipped to dawkins 39 spot on allen 39 s blind side 34 he also told me last week was the first game he 39 s ever played at right tackle the whole time 34 brown said 34 which for me if i had to play left tackle the whole time i 39 d be s ting my pants a little bit 34 as vicious as the vikings 39 defense was it eroded little by little as wentz couldn 39 t keep the offense on the field and the bills refused to yield nine of cook 39 s first dozen carries were for two yards or shorter then he went for five then seven then three then nine allen started to find enough space to throw the windows remained tight but on buffalo 39 s final possession of the first half he completed all six of his throws for 71 yards and the only touchdown buffalo would need he rolled right to buy time and fired into the back of the end zone for tight end keleki latu 39 s first nfl score the old paradox about the unstoppable force versus the immovable object vanished in the second half bills linebacker dorian williams made a spectacular catch to deny tight end t j hockenson up the seam and kill the vikings 39 best chance to get back into the game on the next play cook ran off right guard the vikings swarmed him at the line cook was so enveloped that he couldn 39 t be seen in the crowd but the pile kept moving and moving and moving brown most notably shoved the pile forward for nine yards 34 my favorite play of the day 34 corbett said 34 our run was stuffed they got us boom we kept pushing it first down 34 the game wasn 39 t won but it felt over minnesota 39 s offense was flaccid while buffalo found confidence and traction even as flores unleashed hellfire seven vikings collected 11 quarterback hits andrew van ginkel was the biggest nuisance with four of them and nearly pulled a strip sack recovery at the bills 39 goal line the play was overturned by replay because allen 39 s shin was down a millisecond before the ball dislodged but after his feeble first quarter allen completed 16 of 20 passes for 191 yards and a touchdown with no turnovers not counting an end of half kneeldown he ran five times for 16 yards enough to eclipse the 5 000 yard milestone cook finished with 31 attempts one shy of his career high for 107 yards and a touchdown with 6 17 remaining he has at least 75 rushing yards and a td in seven straight games the longest such streak in bills history and the longest in the nfl since ladainian tomlinson 39 s eight games in 2006 buffalo 39 s first drive after halftime lasted 14 plays and the third went 15 ending in a field goal and a touchdown respectively 34 that defense is one of the best in the league in any year 34 allen said 34 i don 39 t care going back a long time a really tough defense to go against we stuck in there 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Minnesota Vikings training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Kevin Patra provides a refresher on the Minnesota Vikings' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the minnesota vikings offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 20 rookies july 22 veterans location tco performance center eagan minnesota fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs houston texans saturday aug 9 at 4 p m et nfl network week 2 vs new england patriots saturday aug 16 at 1 p m et week 3 at tennessee titans friday aug 22 at 8 p m et cbs 2025 schedule note the vikings will be the first team in nfl history to play a game in multiple international countries in the same season week 4 in ireland and week 5 in england nfl research what you need to know 1 it s all about j j mccarthy in minnesota the second year quarterback will be under the microscope as he takes over an offense that rejuvenated sam darnold s career last season the vikings decided not to buffer mccarthy with a veteran backup after daniel jones opted to sign with indianapolis apologies to the sam howell stans but he s not a threat to mccarthy the former first round pick inherited the porsche of offenses which has made almost every driver look good kevin o connell is a proven qb whisperer so the assumption is that mccarthy should have little trouble keeping things afloat with justin jefferson jordan addison t j hockenson and a remade offensive line the vikes offer weapons to aid the young signal caller minnesota is a 14 win club that on paper improved entering 2025 the loudest question is mccarthy and whether he can keep the engine humming after missing all of 2024 it s not hyperbole to suggest that mccarthy is the pendulum that could swing the course of the entire nfc north 2 the top camp battle in minnesota comes in the secondary heretofore the vikings have yet to add a veteran to the mix who could push for a starting gig next to byron murphy it feels as though the club could be waiting to see how mekhi blackmon bounces back after missing the entire 2024 season due to an acl tear isaiah rodgers blackmon and jeff okudah are in line to battle for the cb2 role elsewhere in the vikings secondary the club didn t replace no 3 safety camryn bynum who left for indianapolis this offseason defensive coordinator brian flores used three safeties liberally last season if he does so again would he trust the likes of theo jackson in that role could a veteran be added closer to the season 3 will the interior offensive line upgrades pay off the internal pressure proved to be sam darnold s undoing last year general manager kwesi adofo mensah set out to fix the issue signing veterans ryan kelly and will fries from indy then he drafted guard donovan jackson in the first round in theory the moves should solidify a leaky interior however kelly and fries are both coming off injury plagued seasons those concerns are coupled with star left tackle christian darrisaw coming off a season ending knee injury the offseason overhaul is excellent from a starter s perspective but there are questions among the second string crew should injuries strike again

news_mentions.headline: NFL midseason All-Rookie Team: Arvell Reese, David Bailey pacing 2026 draft picks
news_mentions.body_text: before the 2026 nfl draft the main debate was over who would be the first non quarterback selected david bailey or arvell reese now at the midway point of the season the debate rages on who is the nfl 39 s rookie of the year is it one of those two defensive stars both have played at extremely high levels with bailey among the most disruptive pass rushers in the league and reese creating a diverse impact using his versatility those two players were easy picks for this exercise other positions weren 39 t as simple our midseason nfl all rookie team quarterback first team jalon daniels tampa bay buccaneers the nfl has yet to see a 2026 draft pick start at quarterback so by default the undrafted daniels retains the spot he held on the quarter mark all rookie team one of the reasons daniels went undrafted was his high turnover rate which has carried over to the nfl he has more interceptions than touchdowns in two of three starts but daniels deserves credit for his week 5 performance as he led the buccaneers to a win over the cowboys he was turnover free that thursday night and used his mobility to avoid negative plays second team joe fagnano baltimore ravens nbsp with all due respect i guess this spot goes to fagnano he is the only other rookie also undrafted to start a game it didn 39 t go well at all but facing the jaguars who rank second in the nfl in scoring defense in your starting debut is a tough ask fagnano ranks second among all rookies in completions and first downs honorable mention fernando mendoza raiders athan kaliakmanis commanders jack strand falcons running back first team jonah coleman denver broncos despite a stint on injured reserve coleman has made a strong case as the nfl 39 s most impactful rookie back he is the only rookie with multiple rushing touchdowns and is tied for the rookie lead with 13 first down carries despite having far fewer attempts than others on the leaderboard coleman has also been productive in the passing game with 13 catches on 14 targets for 128 yards late in the fourth quarter against the chiefs he had a crucial 51 yard catch and run that set up denver 39 s go ahead touchdown a 5 yard run by coleman second team emmett johnson kansas city chiefs johnson ranks seventh among rookies in rushing yards but you can better understand his impact when factoring in receiving production through eight games he has 348 yards of total offense 237 receiving 111 rushing which ranks no 1 among rookie running backs he is also the only rookie back with both a rushing and receiving touchdown honorable mention kaelon black 49ers mike washington raiders jeremiyah love cardinals jadarian price seahawks seth mcgowan colts wide receiver first team denzel boston cleveland browns kc concepcion cleveland browns carnell tate tennessee titans no surprises here the same three names atop the rookie wr rankings at the quarter mark remain in place at the midway point they 39 re led by boston the seventh receiver drafted in april he leads all rookies in receiving yards 507 first down receptions 21 and receiving touchdowns three against the saints on sunday boston recorded his third catch of 50 plus yards which ties him with green bay 39 s christian watson for the nfl lead not far behind is concepcion who scored his first nfl touchdown on sunday in new orleans he ranks no 1 among rookies in receptions 37 and second in receiving yards 437 concepcion also leads all rookie receivers in catches of 20 plus yards eight and yards after the catch 237 which ranks top 20 in the nfl one spot behind amon ra st brown tate slots in just behind the browns 39 rookie duo with 34 catches for 413 yards and one touchdown he was exceptional at ohio state in contested situations and has continued that success in the nfl eight catches on nine contested targets however tate also leads all rookie receivers with four drops and three fumbles second team omar cooper new york jets makai lemon philadelphia eagles germie bernard pittsburgh steelers it has been a small yet impressive sample size from cooper despite almost all his production having come in three games he ranks fifth among rookies in receiving yards 306 and second with a pair of touchdown grabs lemon is tied with concepcion for the rookie lead with 37 receptions while bernard has helped expand the steelers 39 offense using his nose for the sticks honorable mention caleb douglas dolphins antonio williams commanders ted hurst buccaneers kevin coleman dolphins malachi fields giants chris bell dolphins josh cameron jaguars barion brown saints tight end first team kenyon sadiq new york jets the first tight end drafted in 2026 leads all rookie tight ends in catches 21 and receiving yards 235 each game sadiq seems to have a catch on which he is asked to high point and finish showing off his ball skills at different elevations most of his snaps have come in a detached alignment but he has been a capable run blocker when inline 37 7 percent of his snaps second team eli raridon new england patriots with 16 catches for 225 yards raridon joins sadiq as the only rookie tight ends with more than 150 receiving yards raridon leads all rookie tight ends in first down receptions 11 and is one of only two with multiple touchdown catches despite having a brutal drop on a potential walk in touchdown against the packers raridon also leads all rookie tight ends in blocking snaps and has kept his head above water in that area honorable mention nate boerkircher jaguars matthew hibner ravens josh cuevas ravens sam roush bears will kacmarek dolphins offensive tackle first team max iheanachor pittsburgh steelers blake miller detroit lions there isn 39 t a rookie offensive tackle running away with the top spot they 39 ve all been up and down iheanachor has had his share of struggles especially in the run game which was expected considering his inexperience but he hasn 39 t been a liability and the pittsburgh offensive line as a unit has been much better since he became the full time starter at right tackle in week 3 miller has probably been the most consistent rookie ot having allowed just one sack in seven starts at right tackle second team spencer fano cleveland browns markel bell philadelphia eagles fano 39 s tape has been full of high highs and low lows he has struggled against better talent see chase young this past sunday but he played above average against the jets titans and ravens before that fano has performed well enough to believe he can be a long term solution for the browns honorable mention kahlil benson chiefs monroe freeling panthers caleb lomu patriots travis burke chargers jayden williams cardinals interior offensive line first team vega ioane baltimore ravens austin barber cleveland browns francis mauigoa new york giants whether the ravens have needed him at guard or center ioane has been up for the challenge he hasn 39 t given up a sack since week 1 and has been the steadiest run blocker of all rookie offensive linemen barber is coming off arguably his worst game as a pro but there has been far more good than bad on his rookie tape he has been an iron man while battling through injuries and is tied with his teammate fano for the rookie lead in snaps played 588 i had higher hopes for mauigoa a top 10 pick but he has been good enough at right guard second team kadyn proctor miami dolphins jake slaughter los angeles chargers emmanuel pregnon jacksonville jaguars proctor had a strong case for the first team and it won 39 t be a surprise if he 39 s there before the end of the season slaughter has been solid although his rookie missteps have been costly mistakes pregnon leads the jaguars in snaps played but his mistakes are starting to add up nfl high 10 penalties honorable mention nbsp trey zuhn raiders keylan rutledge texans logan taylor chargers fernando carmona titans edge rusher first team david bailey new york jets gabe jacas new england patriots there isn 39 t much debate for the top two spots bailey leads all rookies in sacks 7 5 tackles for loss 11 forced fumbles five also tied for the league lead and pressures 31 he has taken his game to another level over his last four outings including a disruptive afternoon against patrick mahomes and the chiefs on sunday jacas is second among rookie edge rushers in sacks three and pressures 26 and he 39 s added an interception off aaron rodgers no less he needs to show better discipline with missed tackles and damaging penalties two roughing the passer two offsides but jacas has outplayed his draft spot second team dani dennis sutton green bay packers akheem mesidor los angeles chargers despite not being a starter dennis sutton has become a valuable role player on sub downs he ranks third among all rookies in pressures 23 and sacks three and he 39 s made an impact on kick and punt return coverage also coming off the bench mesidor has been one of the better all around rookie defensive linemen making plays both in pass rushing and in stopping the run he posted a career high seven pressures against the texans on sunday honorable mention r mason thomas chiefs cashius howell bengals romello height 49ers rueben bain buccaneers derrick moore lions caden curry colts defensive tackle first team gracen halton san francisco 49ers skyler gill howard detroit lions defensive tackle was not a strong position in the 2026 nfl draft and unsurprisingly it has been light in rookie output the 49ers had d line questions entering the season but halton has helped provide some answers he ranks third among all rookies in tackles for loss five and had one of the coolest rookie moments of the season when he forced a fumble against the seahawks and recovered it for his first nfl touchdown unfortunately halton suffered a broken ankle on sunday which will end his rookie season a subpackage defender gill howard ranks third on the lions and leads all rookie interior linemen in pressures 16 he was a day 3 steal second team lee hunter carolina panthers darrell jackson new york jets hunter is averaging fewer than 25 snaps per game but he is making the most of his playing time even if he isn 39 t dominating the box score you can feel his impact on tape jackson 39 s snap count has steadily increased too as he 39 s earned more trust from the coaching staff he leads all rookie defensive tackles in tackles 26 and has stacked positive reps see his week 8 snaps vs tyler linderbaum honorable mention chris mcclellan packers peter woods chiefs aaron hall panthers caleb banks vikings lt overton cowboys linebacker first team arvell reese new york giants jacob rodriguez miami dolphins reese terrorized the eagles this past sunday to the tune of 12 tackles three sacks and a forced fumble on a sack that took just 2 29 seconds the fastest sack in the nfl since week 7 of last season according to nextgenstats reese was my top ranked player in the 2026 draft and he hasn 39 t disappointed his main appeal as a prospect was his versatility which is also why he is one of the favorites for defensive rookie of the year he is the only nfl player not just among rookies with 65 plus tackles eight plus tackles for loss and at least one interception add in his forced fumble from sunday and 4 5 sacks and reese has made an impact for the nfc east leading giants there are multiple other rookie linebackers with a case to be on the first team but rodriguez has filled up the stat sheet 79 tackles four tackles for loss one forced fumble and one interception his most impressive stat though is an nfl best 33 34 defensive stops 34 reese ranks second with 32 second team anthony hill tennessee titans josiah trotter tampa bay buccaneers sonny styles washington commanders any of these three linebackers easily could have joined reese on the first team it 39 s a loaded year for rookies at the position hill averages 10 3 tackles per game which ranks third in the nfl behind only alex singleton and nakobe dean trotter has always been a hammer looking for a nail against the run but his improvements in coverage are promising styles and roquan smith are the only nfl linebackers with 67 plus tackles eight plus pressures and at least one interception and one forced fumble honorable mention kendal daniels falcons jaishawn barham cowboys harold perkins falcons jaden dugger 49ers bryce boettcher colts cj allen colts cornerback first team brandon cisse green bay packers mansoor delane kansas city chiefs this was a tough category because of the volatility from the rookie cb class cisse who leads all rookie corners in snaps played had some rough moments over the first month of the season but he has been stacking positive outings since the start of october over his last five games cisse has allowed zero touchdowns and just 50 percent completions when targeted along with four passes defended and one interception delane has missed three games because of a right shoulder injury but he performed at a high level in the five games he was on the field despite playing half the number of snaps as cisse he has almost as many passes defended four and the same number of interceptions one it helps that he has been strong as a tackler and has yet to commit a penalty second team davison igbinosun buffalo bills malik muhammad chicago bears igbinosun is one of nine nfl players and the only rookie with at least five pass breakups and one interception he was known for his hands on approach in coverage at ohio state and that has followed him to the nfl but he also does a great job using his length to suffocate passing windows over the past three games he has allowed only two catches with two pass breakups and his first career interception i was ready to put hezekiah masses here because he leads all rookies with three interceptions but his coverage tape over the last month just hasn 39 t been good enough muhammad has been banged up and had some rough patches as well see the packers game but he has played more reliable football honorable mention will lee panthers daylen everette steelers hezekiah masses raiders jermod mccoy raiders colton hood giants nickelback first team keionte scott tampa bay buccaneers scott fell further than expected on draft night because he is a very specific type of player an undersized nickel who is much better downhill than in reverse but when used in the correct role scott can shine and he has played well for a fast and physical bucs defense he has almost as many solo tackles as styles and is tied with caleb downs for the most defensive stops 14 among rookie dbs second team chris johnson miami dolphins nbsp johnson who just turned 22 this week has shown his youth at times but i have been impressed with his resiliency especially given that miami has used him both inside and outside johnson notched his first career interception on sunday off jared goff honorable mention kenneth harris colts keith abney lions avieon terrell falcons chandler rivers ravens d 39 angelo ponds jets safety first team treydan stukes las vegas raiders caleb downs dallas cowboys it can be tough not to have recency bias for an exercise like this but stukes 39 interception on sunday against the 49ers helped land him on the first team stukes now has a pair of interceptions and is tied for the rookie lead with three passes defended there certainly have been ups and downs for downs but he is coming off one of his most impactful games of his young career against the colts and his older brother josh downs he finished with three tackles two passes defended one sack and his first nfl interception to seal a win second team zakee wheatley carolina panthers dillon thieneman chicago bears wheatley has made his presence felt in different ways for the panthers he had a forced fumble in his nfl debut then picked off jordan love in week 8 for his first career interception his consistency in both run support and coverage has been an exciting development thieneman hasn 39 t been as consistent but he leads all rookie safeties in tackles 52 and we have seen an uptick in chicago 39 s willingness to vary his role including letting him loose as a blitzer honorable mention emmanuel mcneil warren browns michael taaffe dolphins genesis smith chargers a j haulcy colts robert spears jennings steelers xavier nwankpa chiefs kicker first team drew stevens washington commanders stevens has been the most consistent of the rookie kickers connecting on 12 of 12 field goal attempts of under 50 yards he had a few missed extra points early in the season but has been more reliable over the past month honorable mention trey smack packers dominic zvada giants punter first team tommy doman buffalo bills doman could have earn this spot solely based on his jarring hit on a kickoff against the vikings to force a fumble but he also ranks third in the nfl in hangtime 4 62 seconds with a respectable 43 2 yard net average honorable mention nbsp ryan eckley ravens brett thorson vikings this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL fantasy football waiver wire, Week 10: Jordyn Tyson, Tank Dell headline top 15 targets
news_mentions.description: Which players should you scoop up to give your fantasy team a boost heading into Week 10? Matt Okada spotlights the best waiver-wire targets at each position, with rookie Jordyn Tyson topping the board at wide receiver.
news_mentions.body_text: nine sundays of fantasy football are in the books time for the week 10 waiver wire some of the names listed below might end up winning leagues at the very least several of them could be difference makers in the immediate future do not take the waiver wire for granted this is where the rubber meets the road in our imaginary game i ll be here every week from now until fantasy championships hope to have you along for the full ride let s win some hardware notes players must be rostered in less than 60 of espn leagues to be eligible for the column all statistics come courtesy of next gen stats unless otherwise noted top 15 overall waiver wire targets this ranking is conditional depending on the seriousness of rhamondre stevenson s knee injury this ranking is a prospective bet on jonathan taylor being traded before tuesday s 4 p m et deadline and here are my top waiver wire targets by position quarterbacks running backs wide receivers tight ends note new england s hunter henry is rostered in 61 of leagues making him barely ineligible for this column but he should be the top te priority if he s available ahead of a week 10 matchup with the lions in munich germany defenses

news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Jeremy Bergman breaks down the top AFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and New York Jets.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines news_mentions.headline: NFL midseason All-Rookie Team: Arvell Reese, David Bailey pacing 2026 draft picks
news_mentions.body_text: before the 2026 nfl draft the main debate was over who would be the first non quarterback selected david bailey or arvell reese now at the midway point of the season the debate rages on who is the nfl 39 s rookie of the year is it one of those two defensive stars both have played at extremely high levels with bailey among the most disruptive pass rushers in the league and reese creating a diverse impact using his versatility those two players were easy picks for this exercise other positions weren 39 t as simple our midseason nfl all rookie team quarterback first team jalon daniels tampa bay buccaneers the nfl has yet to see a 2026 draft pick start at quarterback so by default the undrafted daniels retains the spot he held on the quarter mark all rookie team one of the reasons daniels went undrafted was his high turnover rate which has carried over to the nfl he has more interceptions than touchdowns in two of three starts but daniels deserves credit for his week 5 performance as he led the buccaneers to a win over the cowboys he was turnover free that thursday night and used his mobility to avoid negative plays second team joe fagnano baltimore ravens nbsp with all due respect i guess this spot goes to fagnano he is the only other rookie also undrafted to start a game it didn 39 t go well at all but facing the jaguars who rank second in the nfl in scoring defense in your starting debut is a tough ask fagnano ranks second among all rookies in completions and first downs honorable mention fernando mendoza raiders athan kaliakmanis commanders jack strand falcons running back first team jonah coleman denver broncos despite a stint on injured reserve coleman has made a strong case as the nfl 39 s most impactful rookie back he is the only rookie with multiple rushing touchdowns and is tied for the rookie lead with 13 first down carries despite having far fewer attempts than others on the leaderboard coleman has also been productive in the passing game with 13 catches on 14 targets for 128 yards late in the fourth quarter against the chiefs he had a crucial 51 yard catch and run that set up denver 39 s go ahead touchdown a 5 yard run by coleman second team emmett johnson kansas city chiefs johnson ranks seventh among rookies in rushing yards but you can better understand his impact when factoring in receiving production through eight games he has 348 yards of total offense 237 receiving 111 rushing which ranks no 1 among rookie running backs he is also the only rookie back with both a rushing and receiving touchdown honorable mention kaelon black 49ers mike washington raiders jeremiyah love cardinals jadarian price seahawks seth mcgowan colts wide receiver first team denzel boston cleveland browns kc concepcion cleveland browns carnell tate tennessee titans no surprises here the same three names atop the rookie wr rankings at the quarter mark remain in place at the midway point they 39 re led by boston the seventh receiver drafted in april he leads all rookies in receiving yards 507 first down receptions 21 and receiving touchdowns three against the saints on sunday boston recorded his third catch of 50 plus yards which ties him with green bay 39 s christian watson for the nfl lead not far behind is concepcion who scored his first nfl touchdown on sunday in new orleans he ranks no 1 among rookies in receptions 37 and second in receiving yards 437 concepcion also leads all rookie receivers in catches of 20 plus yards eight and yards after the catch 237 which ranks top 20 in the nfl one spot behind amon ra st brown tate slots in just behind the browns 39 rookie duo with 34 catches for 413 yards and one touchdown he was exceptional at ohio state in contested situations and has continued that success in the nfl eight catches on nine contested targets however tate also leads all rookie receivers with four drops and three fumbles second team omar cooper new york jets makai lemon philadelphia eagles germie bernard pittsburgh steelers it has been a small yet impressive sample size from cooper despite almost all his production having come in three games he ranks fifth among rookies in receiving yards 306 and second with a pair of touchdown grabs lemon is tied with concepcion for the rookie lead with 37 receptions while bernard has helped expand the steelers 39 offense using his nose for the sticks honorable mention caleb douglas dolphins antonio williams commanders ted hurst buccaneers kevin coleman dolphins malachi fields giants chris bell dolphins josh cameron jaguars barion brown saints tight end first team kenyon sadiq new york jets the first tight end drafted in 2026 leads all rookie tight ends in catches 21 and receiving yards 235 each game sadiq seems to have a catch on which he is asked to high point and finish showing off his ball skills at different elevations most of his snaps have come in a detached alignment but he has been a capable run blocker when inline 37 7 percent of his snaps second team eli raridon new england patriots with 16 catches for 225 yards raridon joins sadiq as the only rookie tight ends with more than 150 receiving yards raridon leads all rookie tight ends in first down receptions 11 and is one of only two with multiple touchdown catches despite having a brutal drop on a potential walk in touchdown against the packers raridon also leads all rookie tight ends in blocking snaps and has kept his head above water in that area honorable mention nate boerkircher jaguars matthew hibner ravens josh cuevas ravens sam roush bears will kacmarek dolphins offensive tackle first team max iheanachor pittsburgh steelers blake miller detroit lions there isn 39 t a rookie offensive tackle running away with the top spot they 39 ve all been up and down iheanachor has had his share of struggles especially in the run game which was expected considering his inexperience but he hasn 39 t been a liability and the pittsburgh offensive line as a unit has been much better since he became the full time starter at right tackle in week 3 miller has probably been the most consistent rookie ot having allowed just one sack in seven starts at right tackle second team spencer fano cleveland browns markel bell philadelphia eagles fano 39 s tape has been full of high highs and low lows he has struggled against better talent see chase young this past sunday but he played above average against the jets titans and ravens before that fano has performed well enough to believe he can be a long term solution for the browns honorable mention kahlil benson chiefs monroe freeling panthers caleb lomu patriots travis burke chargers jayden williams cardinals interior offensive line first team vega ioane baltimore ravens austin barber cleveland browns francis mauigoa new york giants whether the ravens have needed him at guard or center ioane has been up for the challenge he hasn 39 t given up a sack since week 1 and has been the steadiest run blocker of all rookie offensive linemen barber is coming off arguably his worst game as a pro but there has been far more good than bad on his rookie tape he has been an iron man while battling through injuries and is tied with his teammate fano for the rookie lead in snaps played 588 i had higher hopes for mauigoa a top 10 pick but he has been good enough at right guard second team kadyn proctor miami dolphins jake slaughter los angeles chargers emmanuel pregnon jacksonville jaguars proctor had a strong case for the first team and it won 39 t be a surprise if he 39 s there before the end of the season slaughter has been solid although his rookie missteps have been costly mistakes pregnon leads the jaguars in snaps played but his mistakes are starting to add up nfl high 10 penalties honorable mention nbsp trey zuhn raiders keylan rutledge texans logan taylor chargers fernando carmona titans edge rusher first team david bailey new york jets gabe jacas new england patriots there isn 39 t much debate for the top two spots bailey leads all rookies in sacks 7 5 tackles for loss 11 forced fumbles five also tied for the league lead and pressures 31 he has taken his game to another level over his last four outings including a disruptive afternoon against patrick mahomes and the chiefs on sunday jacas is second among rookie edge rushers in sacks three and pressures 26 and he 39 s added an interception off aaron rodgers no less he needs to show better discipline with missed tackles and damaging penalties two roughing the passer two offsides but jacas has outplayed his draft spot second team dani dennis sutton green bay packers akheem mesidor los angeles chargers despite not being a starter dennis sutton has become a valuable role player on sub downs he ranks third among all rookies in pressures 23 and sacks three and he 39 s made an impact on kick and punt return coverage also coming off the bench mesidor has been one of the better all around rookie defensive linemen making plays both in pass rushing and in stopping the run he posted a career high seven pressures against the texans on sunday honorable mention r mason thomas chiefs cashius howell bengals romello height 49ers rueben bain buccaneers derrick moore lions caden curry colts defensive tackle first team gracen halton san francisco 49ers skyler gill howard detroit
